Anastasia’s interest piqued but she showed no sign of it.

The miko continued, “Some of the other victims were known witch cult sympathizers. Others were unknown and may have been attacked in retaliation. The council is currently uninterested in the events of a serial killer though there are discussions of suspicious activity to the south, near the border of Vollachia. Regarding the companies you mentioned…”

We need to be careful, given Subaru’s track record for being mistaken for an Archbishop, I doubt a serial killer will leave us alone. We may need to bump up the priority on that bodyguard.

Otherwise, Vollachia must be preparing for some kind of battle. Maybe we can smuggle weapons later, it would turn a huge profit quickly. Nothing of note from the companies I was worried about, with Subaru’s inventions, we can gain an advantage without immediate competition.

“…and finally, Hoshin Trading Company. Their operations have not changed. However, we’ve noticed an increase in communication between the company headquarters here and the family in Lugunica. Additionally, resources have increased in transit to the Iron Fang, which is still stationed in Lugunica as well.”

That is weird. The name change aside, is Julius planning something? I should keep tabs on him and the rest.

“…Please keep an eye on Hoshin Trading Company and all auxiliaries. Let me know if anything else is discovered about their recent activity.”

“Of course, should we expect consistent donations from you?”

“Naturally.”

Both women smiled at each other and continued on their way.

“…Now if you put in a good word with your friend-“

“He’s a serial player with two women occupying his heart,” Anastasia bluntly stated.

Doesn’t take a genius to know that given his stories about his candidate and the maid.

Surprisingly, the miko just laughed. “Ha! Then that just makes things more excitin’.”

“You're not deterred, at all?”

“Oh please. How did Hoshin himself put it, ‘Love is a constant auction.’ It doesn’t matter who begins the bid, all that matters is who can win it all.”

“…”

The miko was lost in thought for a few seconds, deciding whether it was worth saying, before smiling.

“A bit of advice considerin’ how entertainin’ you’ve been: negotiatin’ with love is pointless. Like a force of nature, it has the freedom to come and go as it pleases.”

Anastasia was incredibly confused, “What?”

The miko rolled her eyes, “You’ll understand soon enough.”

Confusion turned into annoyance, they walked the rest of the way in silence. Anastasia was hoping the last part of the day would hold no more surprises.

She was wrong.

What do you mean my mana levels are normal?!

Anastasia was immediately suspicious. She injected so much mana, her body was forced into the Flow Method. There’s no way that amount can just decrease naturally. Something is wrong. She needed to check on Subaru.

Thanking the miko kindly, she started walking back. Some priestesses were running past her, towards an emergency: apparently some guy got castrated after harassing a girl.

 

Perhaps Subaru’s mana levels are also strange. He must be almost done with his check-up.

She was right.

Okay so his mana levels are also normal. Which is still suspicious but at least it’s consistent with mine.

But she was also wrong again.

But what do you mean he didn’t contract a spirit? And where the hell is he?!

“Apologies, but the young man said he had somethin’ important he needed to do. So after quickly gettin’ only his mana checked, he ran out of here,” the miko explained as Anastasia’s face was stone cold but smiling.

“Honestly, that idiot,” sighing in faux exasperation, “he must have been too excited to see the city. Did he say where he was going?”

I swear if he went after whatever caught his eye before, he’s a dead man.

“No but he did leave a note for you,” the miko handed her a small piece of paper.

My dearest Anastasia~,

Anastasia paused, pinched her nose, and then returned to reading.

If you are reading this, then that means you most likely have finished your appointment. Unfortunately, I think I have a lead on that ‘person’ and will be leaving first. Please stay here.

Sincerely, your beloved Atlas.

Yup, I’m killing him. If he dies, I’m killing him again.

She neatly folded the paper and pocketed it before turning to leave. Just as she did, the miko stopped her with another note.

“He mentioned if you started leaving after reading the first note, to give you this second one.”

Anastasia stared at the note, her smile slightly brittle, “And why didn’t ya give this to me with the other.”

“He was very specific about the order of notes.”

As the miko adjusted her dress, Anastasia could hear the faint rustling of coins from her.

She simply sighed and grabbed the note.

My most wonderful Ana-chan,

I hate him so much.

If you are reading this, that means you disregarded the end of my previous note, as expected.

How did he even predict this?!

Please. Stay here. At the very least, stay at least for two hours as I should be back soon.

Love, your incredibly handsome companion, Atlas.

Internally screaming, again for the third time today, she simply shoved the note into her pocket and went to sit at a nearby bench.

“…”

“…”

“Would you like some refreshments?”

“…,” Anastasia sighed, “…Yes.”

 

 

 

An hour passed, Anastasia’s patience ran thin. It was getting late and she was getting worried. She opted to simply leave and try to find him now.

He barely knows the city, he’s more likely to get lost and captured as a slave than find his target. I need to go find him.

Until she got intercepted by another note.

“…” She was glaring at the paper now, all semblance of her friendly persona nearly gone.

“…He was very specific-“

“Just. Give. It.”

My adorably greedy and most impatient merchant,

She almost tore the paper in half.

If you are reading this, then you must have gotten worried waiting for me and started to leave only after one hour. Thankfully, by now my business should be done. Please come find me at this location in an hour:

…Note to self: ask Subaru if he has some sort of future seer sight that he has been hiding from me.

Second note to self: ask him this before killing him.

With all my adoration, your greatest ex-knight and most beloved-

She stopped reading at this point, crumpled the note, and simply started stomping her way out of the temple.

 

Anastasia was currently making her way through the crowded streets of Banan.

Alright let’s summarize our situation: we have a serial killer who may or may not have an itch to scratch with Subaru’s name on it.

She turned a corner. Quickening her pace.

Not only that, someone who Subaru recognizes who seems to also be after him considering they were chasing us.

She turned another corner, slowing her pace.

And finally, Subaru and I have normal mana levels. Considering our gates, there is really only one logical possibility: someone is following us and draining our mana. Possible ally? Would explain Patrasche suddenly appearing. But why? Doesn’t matter, we have three separate individuals hot on our trail.

She turned another corner and returned to her normal pace.

…Speaking of three stalkers, those three guys have been following me for the past few turns. They matched my pace and maintained the same distance.

Anastasia’s face stayed the same but her hands tensed.

Slave traders. Must have noticed we were new in town and stalked me since the temple. Running away is an option but…

Anastasia walked into a nearby alley, if her predictions were correct, they’ll assume she is randomly walking to find her way. She heard their footsteps.

Jackpot. We’re right next to a few mercenary hotspots, specifically Demi-humans. If I scream, some would definitely hear me and find an easy way to make bodyguard money.

“Are you lost, little miss? We noticed you were wandering aimlessly and would be happy to help find your way,” a tall gangly fellow said with a smirk.

He was accompanied by a short fat one and a brutish looking gangster.

Anastasia slowly turned around, putting on her best damsel in distress mask.

Get a bodyguard, punish some disgusting wastes of space, and gain some reputation. Three birds with one stone, isn’t that right Subaru?

“W-well-“
“Oi.”

She was interrupted, for what felt like the eighth time today, by another arriving figure.

An incredibly beautiful woman with white hair, pale skin, and a white kimono with green and black accents. Her body radiated a muted malice, accentuated by her otherworldly beauty. 

The figure spoke again, “The three maggots and the frilly purple female,” she pointed at each of them as she spoke.

The three slavers tensed while Anastasia kept her posture.

A rich high class lady? Doesn’t act like a courtesan. No, I can sense a powerful confidence beneath her words. Maybe a mercenary. Either way, maybe I hit a bigger jackpot than I thought.

“Drop your pants, all of you. Show me where the light ball is or I’ll kill you all,” she said, pointing her hand as if holding them at knifepoint.

…

 

Or maybe she’s an insane pervert. Just my luck.

Anastasia was getting an incredible sense of Deja vu.

Notes:

EN1: The original plan for this chapter was to extend the ending and quicken the pace. Then I realized, fuck that, I wanna write more Tia. So now we have a slight cliffhanger and more extensive interactions planned next chapter.

EN2:what do yall think of the miko addition? Part of me feels it’s a bit too filler, another part of me likes the idea of fleshing out Kararagi a bit more.

Chapter 6: Cutting Bargains

Summary:

Anastasia starts her first negotiation of the day while Subaru has a surprise waiting for her...

Notes:

Nearing 900 kudos, I'm honestly surprised I got this far. The exciting part is whether I can keep writing well. Ah but it would be so fun to fail. And then win. And then fail again. Etc. Anyways, enjoy the chapter!

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Anastasia Hoshin was starting to get a sense of déjà vu. Subaru explained it to her once as the feeling you get when you think you’ve experienced a similar situation in the past. In this case, getting potentially mugged by a white-haired phantom dressed in funeral garb was reminding her an awful lot about a certain incident barely a month ago.

At least I’m not getting threatened by a knife right now.

“Oi, Miss albino bitch, I recommend you leave-URGHK!“ The lanky maggot got cut off right as his throat did. He dropped to the floor, bleeding out.

“OH FUCK!” said the short fat one.

…I prefer the knife.

“Wrong answer asshole,” the white-haired lady said with pungent irritation exuding off her, “Again, drop the pants or die.”

Okay seriously, what is with her and public nudity?! Wait, she said light ball earlier. Maybe…maybe she has a preference.

“…You heard the lady, y’all better drop your pants,” Anastasia bluntly stated to the two remaining slavers with possible light balls.

Both slavers nervously looked at each other before gulping. Before they could start unbuckling, the lady got more irritated.

“I said all of you! That includes the purple female,” she said as she pointed a finger at Anastasia.

I was wrong. I was very wrong.

“…But I’m a woman?” Anastasia said with a brow raised.

Now the lady looked confused, “Why would you being a female matter?”

 

…Am I an idiot or is she an idiot? Wait don’t tell me…

Anastasia remembered how the mikoes were running to help a man who got castrated earlier.

I need to dig for information, let’s see if she’ll take the bait, she hasn’t killed me yet which means questions are safe, being rude isn’t.

“It matters since biologically I do not have testicles,” Anastasia decided to go for a cooler and more intellectual persona.

The lady in white looked even more irritated and slightly flustered to Anastasia’s surprise.

“Why are we talking about male sex organs?!” she narrowed her eyes, “You’re just trying to confuse me, like the last one.”

The air slightly shifted.

Shit.

“Wait!”

The air paused.

Anastasia quickly continued, “I am just as confused as you are, I just wanted to know exactly what you were talkin’ about so there was no misunderstandin’. I wouldn’t want to make you spend any unwanted energy.”

Mentally sweating, Anastasia felt her nerves fire on all cylinders, knowing she was just seconds from death.

 

The lady in white paused, contemplating, the air shifting ever so slightly.

Finally, she spoke, “That’s fair. I’d rather not have to waste more time on assholes.”

Her eyes shifted towards the two slavers, who were trying to inch away from the scene during the conversation. They stopped immediately under her gaze.

Okay, good. The first part of negotiations achieved: establish friendly relations. Or as friendly as I could get. Let’s see if I can reach the next step: recognizing values and desires.

“Can you explain what a light ball is?”

“It’s a rock that is very important to me.”

“… And?”

“That’s it.”

 

Calm down. You’ve dealt with Subaru for the past month. This is not even close to that.

“If it’s a rock, I don’t understand how that relates to us needin’ to ‘drop our pants.’”

The lady started getting angry, “You’re lying. The guy from before said everyone holds their ‘family jewels under their pants.’ But all the bastard did was flash his dick in front of me!”

“Pfft-URGHK!” One of the slavers couldn’t help but laugh and got promptly executed for it.

Well, that explains why the guy at the temple earlier got his little man taken away. I think I can work with this.

“Apologies. I wasn’t lyin’, was only ignorant of what you meant. And as for the ‘family jewels.’ That’s a euphemism he used to sexually harass you. He didn’t mean anything about your light ball, unfortunately.”

“…”

The lady was silent, pensive, and then immediately her face went red.

“…”

“…No. I’m not wrong. There’s no way I’m wrong.”

Anastasia raised an eyebrow, “Well everyone can misunderstand-“

“I didn’t misunderstand shit!” she said as she stomped her foot and pouted.

Huh, reminds me when Tivey got in a fight with Mimi about Liger food preferences. He would pout and stomp in the same way when Mimi was right about Ligers liking cooked meat over raw.

Switching to a motherly tone, “Hey, it’s alright. You weren’t wrong, you were just misled. Wasn’t your fault.”

The lady’s face slightly softened, “Yeah, well, guess I was,” she then refocused, “Doesn’t matter though, even if you don’t have it, you must know something. You smell just like them.” She pointed her finger at Anastasia.

Smell?

Anastasia quickly tried to identify what kind of scent the lady was talking about, bringing her nose to her robes, she didn’t notice anything besides the lingering scent of trash and grass.

Wait, grass? I haven’t been near any gardens for days.

She quickly patted herself and felt something in her robe pocket. It was a flower, the bulb specifically with blue petals spanning outward and thin stamens interspersed that appeared like a spider. There was also a fine layer of dust surrounding it, almost imperceptible. Anastasia recognized this flower and dust.

Necrosoul flowers. They grow over dead animal bodies. They have another use: they can mask the scent of dead corpses and blood. Even Ligers and other sensitive animals can’t track the scents.

And the dust: Karnago powder. Hard to see, but it reflects off sunlight in a certain way. It can remove a person’s body odor, as well as the powder’s smell itself, when applied to someone.

Shit. Ricardo taught me about both. Used in assassinations or just to hide a body. Whose trash bin did we end up in?

Before Anastasia, could say anything, the lady in white became alerted, “There! That’s the smell that bastard had. I’ve been tracking them for weeks all over Banan and suddenly they started smelling like that flower.”

She then got closer to Anastasia, “So, ‘fess up. No one else smells like that recently besides you. So, it means you met them.”

Trying not to perspire, Anastasia started putting together the dots.

Is she one of the stalkers? No, she’s been tracking them all over Banan for a supposed while. We just arrived here. But if I’m correct that I picked this up in the trash…

“I haven’t met them, but I have seen them, and I think they want something I have.”

Whoever was chasing us was desperate to find Subaru, given that they rummaged through the other trash aggressively. And an enemy of an enemy is a potential ally.

Anastasia laid out her deal, “I have an offer in mind: I can help you find whoever took your light ball.”

The lady’s eyes widened before narrowing in suspicion, “In exchange for what? And how do I know this isn’t a trick? You look rather scrawny for someone who wants to offer ‘help.’”

“Protection. I’m new to this city and as you could see,” she pointed at the two corpses and scared-as-shit survivor, “My ‘scrawny’ self can’t defend shit. As a result, there is no benefit tricking you, I’ll just die. So, I need you and you need me. And frankly, I need you more.”

No need to mention Subaru.

“…”

The lady seemed pensive, calculating.

Anastasia held out her hand, smiling, “My name is Anastasia.”

During negotiation, offering one’s name seems formal but it often provides a foundation for trust. It’s a bit late, but I need every advantage to get out of this alive.

The lady stared at her hand, with crossed arms, before reaching out as well and clasping hand over hand, “…Tia. Tia shall be my name.”

A pseudo-

Before even finishing that thought, Tia pulled Anastasia sharply towards her, baring down on her with muted ferocity.

“But I won’t accept your offer, however.”

Anastasia tried to keep a calm façade but she couldn’t help but shudder under Tia’s sharp gaze.

Tia continued, “Don’t misunderstand, I may not know some things but I am not an idiot. My instincts are never wrong. And you know what they are telling me right now?”

With her free hand, she pointed at Anastasia’s chest, as the air picked up with gales around them.

“You’re a predator. Watching, listening, waiting. You take advantage of any and all opportunities. Like a camouflaging mabeast, you adapt to every individual you meet. Playing whatever role you need to get what you want. I saw what you’ve been doing this entire time. Changing your tone, your body language, and even your expressions in order to coax me.”

The air felt dense, the winds picked up. The remaining slaver got knocked out and killed as the wild winds tossed trash and debris all around. Yet still, Tia kept staring straight into Anastasia’s soul.

“I know your type. You’ll cut off all the useful bits from whatever victim you target. Then you’ll throw away the scraps, barely caring for whoever you left in your wake. Weak but cunning. Friendly but insincere. Rabbit in appearance but in fact a fox. I should kill you where you stand.”

The wind kept picking up, a mini hurricane in this very alley, as both women stood in the epicenter. Anastasia felt her body trembling yet stood firm. She felt like she was witnessing the embodiment of nature herself.

“…”

And then suddenly, the wind died.

“But I won’t, I’m not in the mood. You’re right, I do need you. You’re the only lead I have on quickly catching the thief and getting my light ball back. And since you have something, they want, they’ll be trying to track you like I’ve been tracking them. So, here’s a new deal: you’re going to be bait.”

Tia let go as Anastasia stood there, trembling but still making eye contact. Walking past Anastasia, she looked over her shoulder and made one last comment.

“I’ll be watching you. I won’t kill you but if you even think about betraying me like sir ‘family jewels,’ or you run from Banan before I get my light ball back, I will gut you like poiison.”

And just like the wind, Tia was gone.

For a second, Anastasia stood there, still trembling. Before her knees then buckled and she collapsed on the ground, gasping for breath.

…That was too close. I didn’t get a bodyguard but being bait is certainly better than being killed on the spot. It was strange though, despite the damage and the threats, why did her words feel half-hearted?

She finally caught her breath and tried to steady herself.

Whatever, at least this day can’t get any worse.

“Hey! What’s going on over there- oh Od! What the fuck happened here?!”

…When I see Subaru, I’m punching him.

 

It took Anastasia quite a bit of time and money to placate the guards. No one would have believed the excuse that an inexplicable woman in white came in, killed three people with wind powers, and left soon after. So, Anastasia came in with the more believable excuse that the infamous serial killer struck again. The use of crocodile tears helped as well.

Now weary as well as depleted in both sustenance and spare funds, Anastasia finally made it to her destination: a tenement house. The address was written on the note, though why specifically should they meet here eluded her.

In any case, she was welcomed by the sight of Subaru. Who was once again pacing a hole in the ground right in front of the entrance to the house.

Some things never change.

She was about to give him a piece of her mind, until she started hearing his usual muttering, but this time a bit more frantic and jumbled,

“…where is she? ShouldIhavegonewithher?Thisdidn’thappenlasttime,sheshouldhavebeensafenow.MaybeIshouldgofindher.Butwhatifshe’salreadyalmosthereandifIleavenow,shewon’tseeme.Whatifshepanicsagain?Ican’tmakethesamemistake.ShitwhatdoIdo?IfIyellmaybeIcangettheirattentionandthey...”

She couldn’t make out anything after the first few words.

Scratch. Scratch. Scratch.

Her eyes widened, she quickened her pace and immediately grabbed his arm before he could do any significant damage. Subaru reacted quickly, tensing and positioning himself to fight, his eyes slightly feral. He then noticed who she was, and his body language softened significantly.

Before she could even put a word out, Subaru immediately hugged her, “Oh thank god you're safe.”

Her heart began to warm, and she aimed to return the hug but froze.

“You’ll cut off all the useful bits from whatever victim you target. Then you’ll throw away the scraps, barely caring for whoever you left in your wake.”

…I’m getting too attached. There’s no need for this anymore. Better start now before it’s too late.

Her mind cooling, she opted to simply pat him on the back. Ignoring how empty it felt.

Subaru, meanwhile let go, only to start looking over Anastasia extensively.

“What happened? Did you run into any trouble? How did things go at the temple?”

“Well-“

“Why did it take so long for you to get here? Did you get lost?”

“No I-“

“Are you hungry? Did you grab food while getting here? Did you need to go to the bathroom-“

She immediately started pinching his cheeks while internally sighing.

Maybe not.

She glared at him, “Listen to me. I am okay, I did run into trouble but it was resolved, things went well, trouble took a while, I didn’t get lost, I am hungry, no I did not get food, and it’s not polite to ask a lady that question! Little. Shit.” Each set of words were punctuated by more pinching.

Subaru’s cheeks were red, “Sowwy…”

Anastasia let go, “You're lucky I’m more tired than pissed, especially after all of those notes.”

“Oh, did you like them?” Subaru said with a cheeky smile.

Her glared deepened, “Oh yeah, I liked it so much, I’m going to return them to sender with extreme prejudice.”

“Wait wait wait, hold on before you stamp me into submission,” Anastasia swiped at him for the pun, he dodged, “What did you mean by trouble?”

Anastasia, still pissed, explained everything that happened in the last hour.

Subaru’s emotions ran through the whole spectrum: from angry, to afraid, to confused, to concerned, and then finally to pensive. He was actively thinking while looking at the ground for some time before looking up at Anastasia.

“…Could you describe how she looked like?”

Anastasia raised an eyebrow but complied, “White short hair, beautiful, a bit tall, wears a white kimono that cuts off at the thighs, with green and black accents.”
“Green? Not reddish purple?”

“What, like magenta? No, it was definitely green.”

“…And she talked, a lot? She didn’t mention any twin at all?”

“No, she didn’t. Subaru, what’s going on? Who was chasing us? Why did you leave the temple early without even contracting a spirit? What are you hiding from me?”

Anastasia was actively tugging at Subaru’s arm while Subaru looked vaguely guilty.

“I-“

“Su-san! Has your friend arrived yet?” Someone in the house interrupted them.

Annoyed that none of her questions were answered, she gave a look towards Subaru that implied this was not over. Subaru slightly nodded in acknowledgement.

“Hal-san, she just came, please come and meet her!”

Anastasia’s eyebrows raised in intrigue before her eyes bulged out at the arriving figure. Her mouth gaped in shock.

Tall, wearing a black kimono with fading purple accents, a wolf-face, with slitted eyes and a lit kiseru, standing right at the entrance of the house was the one known as:

“Halibel the Admirer!!” Anastasia screamed.

Subaru looked vaguely confused as he gazed at Halibel, “Admirer, that’s your job?”

Halibel just smiled and posed in faux bravado, “Yep yep, from liquor to pretty women, I have a tendency to admire.”

Anastasia quickly realized the situation and started panicking.

It’s been too long of a day, I can’t believe I just did that!

Subaru kept talking, “See this is why I called you a playboy!”

Halibel just started laughing at that.

Anastasia looked at Subaru as if he was insane, she quickly gripped his arm to get his attention, “Subaru, that’s Halibel, the strongest of Kararagi,” she aggressively whispered.

She motioned with her eyes silently, “Show. Some. Respect.”

Subaru’s eyes widened and looked back towards Halibel with some sort of newfound appreciation.

Except, it was given the Subaru treatment, “Well then, I was wrong, you can definitely beat Hugh Hefner and always be the front of Playboy Magazine. Be some kind of eternal playboy.”

Anastasia’s jaw dropped hard. Meanwhile, Halibel began laughing harder.

“Hahaha! Halibel, the Eternal Playboy. Yep yep! I like that a lot.”

He, I, wha, I can’t, how the, where the hell, why-

Anastasia’s mind started short-circuiting shortly before it finally blew a fuse, causing her to start screaming internally for a good minute. Subaru meanwhile was smiling proudly while Halibel was still laughing, doubling over, partially because he noticed what was happening to the poor girl.

Her mind finally silent, she slowly reached over and placed her head on his chest.

Subaru, confused and a little flustered, just scratched the back of his neck, “Oh come on, no need to act all shy.”

She slowly reached her arms around his waist and started squeezing.

“Hal-san is a pretty chill guy once you get to know. I’m sure he doesn’t mind me being, well me.”

She started squeezing harder.

“Ana?”

Harder.

“Ana, a little too tight. Can’t. Breathe…”

She started squeezing as hard as she can and with the strength of 10 Petras, lifted Subaru and started spinning around at mach speed.

“ANA!”

I dealt with nosey priestesses, annoying slavers, and childish women. Yet how is Subaru, always, the MOST STRESSFUL PART OF MY DAY!!!!!

Anastasia continued swinging Subaru around.

Halibel was at this point, almost on the ground, dying of humor, almost to the point of vomiting.

After regaining his composure and wiping a tear under his eye, Halibel decided to get down to business, “Ha…Ha… oh that was great! Alright, before you suffocate the lad, let’s go get something to eat. We have much to discuss.”

Anastasia was still using 20 Petra’s worth of strength to squeeze the life out of Subaru, as she paused to listen to Halibel, “What’s there to discuss?”

Halibel ignored the question and simply waved at them to follow him, “Come come, let’s not waste daylight. Business is better done over food.”

The two stars followed the shinobi wolf down to the nearest pub. It was a quaint and simple bar but was bustling with activity. The sign on the outside read, ‘Mov’s.’

I recognize this bar. Chamov. Cute little guy knows basically everyone. He owns a similar bar down in Lugunica.

They entered the bar as Halibel hailed the bartender, “Elder! It’s good to see you, have you been well?”

There, a short fluffy white puppy demi-human with a green hat was wiping a flask as he noticed the three come in, “Halibel! It’s wonderful to see you, I’ve been good, just got back from checking on things in Lugunica.”

“No kidding, how are things in the land of the Divine Dragon?”

“More exciting than here, there was a recent prison escape around a month ago which made the guards frantic. Apparently, an important witch cultist escaped.”

“You don’t say?”

While Halibel and Chamov were discussing recent events, Anastasia quickly checked on Subaru’s condition but was surprised to find him keeping his cool. Part of her felt proud of how calm he was despite how distressing it must be to hear.

Subaru noticed her gaze and just gave a small smile and a nod.

“Let’s save such serious topics over drinks later, what will you be having tonight Halibel?”

“Hmmm, let’s go for the dried poiison, along with several of my favorite snacks with three ale. Private room please, nothing fancy.”

Chamov nodded and motioned them to go to the back, “Your usual room is available, I’ll send someone with the food and drinks soon.”

“Always a pleasure to dine here Elder!”

Halibel laughed and led them to his usual spot. Anastasia meanwhile understood the subtext.

They use a messaging system similar to the bar I worked at. That combination of drinks and food implies casual conversation, low stakes, but important enough to last long and require privacy. In comparison, I’m guessing if Halibel wanted raw poiison, hard liquor, and an open table: it would imply danger and necessity to arm themselves in the back.

The two stars were led through a sliding door with a sitting table on top of tatami mats. As they situated themselves, Halibel on one side and the two on the other, a waiter came with their refreshments. Subaru quickly went to ask the waiter for something while Halibel and Anastasia grabbed their respective drinks.

Taking a deep swig, Halibel began, “Aw! That always hits the spot. Now, let’s get down to business finally. I hear both of you are looking for a room to live and a place to set up shop.”

Adopting her merchant persona once more, Anastasia took a small sip of her ale before casually taking part in one of the snacks, “Yes, that’s correct. We just arrived in the city and were lookin’ to establish a business. We’re in no rush as there is still much to explore.”

Casual food means casual appearance. We can’t seem desperate, otherwise we’ll get scammed. Even if he is the Admirer, I can’t underestimate him. I barely saved Ricardo by appealing to his tradition and sense of responsibility, can’t afford any risks now.

Memories of the past seeped through her mind, of the wolf-man shinobi hunting down Ricardo once upon a time for a transgression against their mutual kindred. How she bargained for his life and was able to win despite the odds.

Subaru sat down right next to Anastasia and began partaking in the snacks, “Sorry about that, needed to order something before we get started. Did you tell her about our deal Hal-san?”

Wait what?!

Trying her hardest to compose herself, she simply asked, “Oh, I didn’t hear about a deal? Did I miss something?” Saccharine naivety masking her underlying panic.

“Ah, Su-san, I almost forgot. Here, I’ll grab the paper and explain it.”

Wait a moment. He said Su-san. He’s said it since the tenement house. He knows Subaru’s real name!

As Halibel rummaged through his pockets, Subaru quickly darted his eyes and grabbed Anastasia’s hand. He simply winked.

Slightly less on the cusp of a breakdown, Anastasia steadied herself, ready to see the catastrophe about to reach her eyes.

Which never came. Halibel laid out the contract and began reciting the important clauses to Anastasia’s bewilderment and growing wonder.

Halibel cleared his throat, “As Su-san and I previously agreed, we have agreed to a temporary bodyguard situation where I will be tasked with providin’ safety and protection to the two of you for one month. Furthermore, I will provide protection from all threats whether they be internal or external regarding the country, no matter the degree of danger, and I will prioritize the safety of both of you at all costs. Any conscious action that ultimately would betray these conditions will result in death of the bodyguard. Finally, the trial period will not require any sort of payment, however, the terms and conditions of continuin’ employment will be discussed again at the end of the trial. Differences in payment, employment period, and terms of service can change if the bodyguard and employer wish to continue working together. Well, those are the important parts summarized, you may look through the paper if you wish little girl.”

Anastasia was absolutely flabbergasted, she quickly scanned through the document three times to double-check everything. It was the most generous bodyguard contract she has ever seen. Basically, top-tier protection for no cost for a whole month. How?

She looked at Subaru, who just simply gave his now iconic, cheeky grin, “Hal-san and I made a bet a few hours ago. Fortunately for me, I won.”

Halibel clicked his mouth in faux irritation, “And unfortunately for me, I still think Su-san rigged the odds…”

“Hey, no being such a sore loser!”

Halibel laughed in response.

Anastasia was still processing everything, “…What was the bet?”

Halibel smiled and started recounting how he met Subaru, “Su-san found me while I was workin’,”

Subaru coughed, “He was being a lazy bastard flirting with women.”

“Again, workin’. And we struck up a fun conversation about Kararagi delicacies. Eventually, I mentioned how today was a slow day and Su-san offered me some relief: a bet to see if he could summon something entertaining for me. I was very, very curious and was happy to oblige. But Su-san wanted to make the bet high stakes.”

Anastasia raised her eyebrow at Subaru who explained, “In exchange for protecting me from everything dangerous for a whole month, if I lost the bet, my life would be his.”

Anastasia’s eyes widened almost imperceptibly. Subaru noticed and began to sweat a bit, expecting a lecture later.

Halibel intervened, “Now, now, I wouldn’t have killed Su-san but it would have been nice to have someone help around the house.”

Halibel isn’t like that but in most other cases, Subaru would have been a slave in all but name.

She returned her attention to the wolf-man shinobi, “So, what happened next?”

Halibel just laughed, “Well obviously, how could I refuse such an interestin’ bet? So, Su-san takes me to an isolated area, for a second, I thought he was about to take my purity,” Halibel started covering his body in modesty.

Subaru just rolled his eyes, about to flip off the shinobi, before Anastasia grabbed his hand and pulled it down.

Halibel continued, “But then he did something really interestin’. Su-san was about to yell but then I think he got a little constipated or something. Either way, next thing I hear was something akin to an animal roar and a woman barreling from the sky towards him. Some white haired beautiful lady with white and purple robes looked like she was in a frenzy. Came this close to almost crushing Su-san like a grapp. Thankfully, I was able to counter her. She escaped, but not without taking a bunch of damage. We won’t be seeing her anytime soon again.”

Anastasia noticed two things: under Halibel’s robes were some bandages, indicating recent battle damage. The other was that she started to connect the dots to Subaru’s specific questions earlier. She’ll save the info for later.

Anastasia decided to chime in, “So, I’m guessin’ he won the bet?”

“Magnificently. Sure, heart-poundin’ combat was not something I would always be up for, but a deal is a deal. And so I, Halibel the Eternal Playboy, am under your service for the next month,” ending his speech with an exaggerated bow.

Anastasia didn’t know what to say. She had a lot of emotions running through her right now: confusion, concern, and anger were included. However, the most overwhelming emotions were a sense of joy and pride in her companion. For Subaru, who essentially took a huge risk and gambled big, with a payout that was assuredly a jackpot. Sure, she had tons of questions, but right now she needed to focus on what’s important.

Under the table, Anastasia simply gripped Subaru’s hand tighter three times. She showed no emotion besides a polite smile otherwise. Subaru himself, however, smiled three times brighter.

Anastasia said, “Wonderful. Then I believe our business is concluded?”

But Subaru chimed in, “Not yet, Hal-san has another offer, correct?”

Halibel took the opportunity, “Indeed. Just like I said before, I know you are both lookin’ for a place to stay and to set up a business. Luckily, I am what you would call a property manager for several areas. As such, I can offer you both places for rent. For a price,” as Halibel brought out two more pieces of paper.

Quickly, scanning them, Anastasia’s eyes bulged slightly behind the parchment. The cost of rent would be double their original proposed budget. They’d essentially run out of savings in less than a month.

Halibel continued, “It’s a fair price, especially considerin’ I will also be providin’ my services close by. It will also make things more convenient for you, given that I know Su-san’s real name and his fake one. Forgin’ documents to prevent trackin’ would be easier if done by me.”

I knew Halibel wouldn’t let us off so lightly. A true Kararagian through and through. Well, guess it’s my turn to pull my weight.

Just as Anastasia was ready to bargain for her and Subaru’s souls, a knock interrupted their discussion.

Knock, Knock.

“Oh!” Subaru jumped up to get the door, “What I ordered finally arrived.”

He let the waiter in who was carrying a tray of fried poiison cut in squares and five bowls: three of which were mayonnaise, one of diced ickle umbers, and one of squeezed lemom juice. The waiter looked visibly unsettled by what he was carrying but opted to let customer service take the reins and not question a thing.

Subaru, on the other hand, was positively vibrating with excitement as he got back to his seat with the waiter.

Halibel, his eyes slightly wider and one eye noticeably twitching, spoke, “That’s… an interestin’ order Su-san…was it necessary to get three bowls of it?”

Subaru ignored the obvious bewilderment and opted to dip one of the fried poiison into a bowl of mayo. Anastasia, giggling internally, did the same for her bowl.

Merchant technique number 58: unsettle your opponent to catch them off guard for the next attack. I don’t how Subaru does it, but he certainly made this negotiation much easier to start.

Anastasia offered, “Halibel-san, would you like to try some?” She offered one of the poiison dipped in mayo.

While Halibel didn’t visibly grimace, his eye started twitching faster, “I… will have to decline. I’ve had it before. It tastes fine but I am not a huge fan.”

Subaru’s eyes lighted up, “Oh, then let me show you something really good! You might like this better.”

At first Anastasia was confused but she put three dots together: tartar sauce.

It’s a gamble but if he can remember the flavor enough to put it together, and Halibel likes it, we may have a way out of this. Either way, I must set him up, and I know just how.

As Halibel started to get curious, Subaru turned around with the three ingredients and started mixing them.

Anastasia started the team-up, “You are in for a treat Halibel-san, Subaru here is a genius when it comes to food. Did you know he’s responsible for bringin’ mayonnaise into reality?”

That got Halibel’s attention, “Wow, wow. I knew Su-san was interestin’, but this is definitely exceedin’ my expectations.”

Anastasia continued the assault, “He’s a bundle of surprises isn’t he. In fact, this isn’t his only idea worth trying.”

Entice the opposition with something they want. Then, imply further possible products that could satisfy other desires. Now we can put him on the backfoot, he’ll start wanting to bargain for what we can offer. And now for the clincher…

Subaru finally finished his new sauce, using most of the other ingredients, he presented Halibel a sauce that was noticeably chunkier and more sour smelling. Curious, Halibel took one of the fried poiison and dipped it in the new sauce, putting it in his mouth.

He then took another and dipped it and popped it in his mouth.

And then another.

Another. Another. Another. Another. Another. Another.

“Stop!” Halibel missed the bowl this time. Subaru grabbed it and pulled it away from his purview. The shinobi’s eyes widening, he genuinely looked distressed now.

Subaru now began his turn of assault, waving his finger, “Uh uh uh! Hal-san, weren’t we going to focus on business?”

Halibel began sweating, “Yes yes, well, as I said previously-“

The tag team begins in full, Anastasia breaks through, “Well after looking through the documents, I have to say that we really can’t afford these places. We’ll have to look elsewhere first.”

With the implication that Halibel will have to travel extensively to get first dibs on sauces.

Halibel felt the pressure, “S-su-san, Ana-bo, let’s not be so rash. I’m sure we could discuss a different set of terms.”

Anastasia simply smiled, “1/5 of the original prices.”

Halibel’s eyes fully widened, “That is completely unfair!”

Subaru tagged in, “But! We’ll also offer one free serving of tartar sauce per week.”

Internally, Anastasia was having the time of her life, she really enjoyed her job and Subaru was a wonderful partner in crime.

Halibel thought quickly before retorting, “I’ll take 25% off the rent. Plus, the serving,” he added just as quickly.

Anastasia kept smiling, they had a clear advantage, “¼ of the original prices, plus the serving.”

Halibel’s defenses were wearing down, “35% off the rent, plus two servings.”

Subaru continued the onslaught, “How about ¼ price plus two bottles every month?”

The defense splinters, “…Half price, plus two bottles every month.”

Halibel couldn’t see it, but Anastasia was rapidly squeezing Subaru’s hand in excitement. Subaru himself was also feeling excited by the negotiations.

Anastasia needed just a little more, “1/3 price plus two bottles every month.”

Nearly there, “…1/3 price, three bottles every month.”

One last bid, Anastasia sent her offer, “1/3 price, two bottles every month, and first dibs on any inventions he makes.”

“…”

“…”

“…Alright, alright. You both win. I’ll take your offer.” Halibel concedes. Subaru and Anastasia win the gambit.

For the first time in a while, Anastasia is screaming internally, and it is out of joy and not pure rage.

“Alright, business is over, give me the bowl Su-san!” He summoned a clone which immediately took the bowl of tartar sauce for himself. The clone, however, did not return it to the original Halibel and opted to start savoring the sauce himself.

“Traitor!” Halibel began chasing the clone as Anastasia turned towards Subaru.

Her façade breaks and she simply gives Subaru one of the biggest smiles he has ever seen. She whispers to him, “That was amazing! I only gave you the basics over the last few weeks but you are a natural. How?!”

Subaru blushed slightly and whispered back, “…I had a great teacher.”

“But you barely had any practice?”

Subaru winced slightly before looking away scratching his head, “W-well I learn better watching someone rather than just practicing.”

It was Anastasia’s turn to blush in response, her heart skipping a beat. She quickly clamped that down. Hard.

Stop. Don’t. Don’t get carried away. It’s just lingering affection from our first meeting. I got close because it was necessary. No more, no less.

 

They finished their dinner and drinks before heading back to the tenement house to rest for the night. Halibel introduced them to their room, which did contain two separate bedrooms. Halibel teased that they could just take one bedroom.

Anastasia was about to argue for the two bedrooms but Subaru beat her to it.

“The one bedroom should be fine. If you don’t mind, we could probably use the other one for guests or just for my own personal workshop.”

Anastasia was surprised, just as much as Halibel was entertained by the notion, she never expected Subaru to argue for the one bedroom considering how often he was against it up until today. What changed?

When they were left alone in their room and ready for bed, Subaru decided to take the plunge, “…Do you want to talk now or tomorrow?”

Anastasia looked over to him, he looked tense but ready, as if he was pushing himself for one last lap to the finish line.

“…It’s been a long day. We deserve some rest. Let’s talk more tomorrow morning.”

He looked a little relieved but paired with some concern, “You sure? You don’t have to push it back just because of me.”

Anastasia just smiled, “We did wonderful today, it wouldn’t hurt to be a little lazy.”

Subaru, brightening, joked, “Alright well then my merchant princess, your body pillow awaits,” he said plopping down into bed.

Anastasia giggled externally but inside she hesitated.

How long can we keep this up? This level of affection… unless it goes forward, it will only cause problems.

Noticing Subaru’s confusion, she opted to prevent any awkward confrontations. She assumed her usual position, as they started to drift into sleep together.

…It was a wonderful day. Despite all the problems, we gained a lot and lost nothing. Hell, thanks to Subaru, we have a greater starting advantage than I could ever think of. He was a wonderful tag-team business partner despite how annoying he was earlier.

Her eyes were still closed but her face frowned.

Right. Business partner. Friend. Rival. Once we get our names back, best we’ll be is allies and rivals for the throne. I’m so stupid. I should be focusing on getting my name back. Focusing on my camp. Who I abandoned. Because I was too scared to even fucking try.

Before she could despair, she felt Subaru’s arms tighten around her. She opened one eye and noticed his face grimacing, as if in pain. His heart beating faster. She closed her eye again and simply tightened her hold in return.

…Not today.

Maybe.

Just maybe.

I’ll indulge.

Tomorrow, I’ll stop.

Feeling him calm down, she decided to drift into dreamland, finally.

 

 

Moments before.

 

As the two stars closed their eyes, an unimaginable present lay within one star’s mind.

 

A future of the past, where the night was loud and rapturous.

 

“Be greedy. Ask for rightful compensation, so that your own worth is proven, rather than depreciated. Nobody but you can do that. It’s not enough to value your life, you have to value what you provide to those around you.

 

Another future of the past, where the stars collided and conflicted.

 

“You can’t just run off, expecting me to accept that! For my own safety?! What gives you the right to decide that? To leave me behind… just so you can die alone…”

 

As the brightest black star finally succumbed to sleep, visions of a future that should never happen, echoed in his skull.

 

Of a scene, where the pale star of greed, bled in his sanguine arms. Their blood flowed into rivers of crimson, their last breaths taken within each other's embrace.

 

“Please…live… don’t die… I wish I met you sooner… I’m sorry…in-”

 

The black star’s arms slightly tightened around the pale star, before entering the land of dreams.

Notes:

EN: Ah Zarestia and Halibel. My faves. Let me know what ya'll think of the characterization. Honestly, it took me two seconds to realize Zarestia would hate Anastasia's usual merchant ways given her canon backstory. Plus, given how Rem was in Sloth IF and how Anastasia isn't like that, I considered Zarestia wouldn't hold back as much here. Since she doesn't have her light ball, her bloodthirst is still a lot less. She definitely would still kill anything that disgusts her though. Still let me know what you think!

EN2:Necrosoul flowers don't canonically have such an effect explicitly stated. Though considering they feed off corpses, wouldn't a plant want nothing bothering the carcasses as they grow? It just makes sense to me considering I studied biology and evolution.

EN3: In case anyone does not want to look it up: poiison is fish. I had to consciously keep making sure I didn't mix it up. It was the hardest part of this chapter.

Chapter 7: An Uneventful Morning

Summary:

Subaru and Anastasia catch up. Tia is also there.

Notes:

Over 1000 kudos hit! And so many bookmarks! I feel like I need to do some kind of celebration. Thank you again for the support, hope you enjoy the chapter.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

The next morning was less than calm as both Anastasia and Subaru had a lengthy conversation about certain topics: first was who was following them.

They were sitting at the kitchen table, eating a light breakfast. Scrambled eggs, toast, and mayo. Halibel already left but he wrote a note saying he would be back soon.

“I’ve narrowed it down to three people who we should be wary of,” Anastasia held up three fingers, “the one who I met yesterday, the one who chased us, and the one who may have been draining our mana.”

Subaru was lost in thought, he looked around quickly, before refocusing on Anastasia, “I’m assuming that the one who chased us is the main priority?”

Anastasia nodded, “Correct. Tia said she won’t kill me and instead will use me as bait. She isn’t an ally but she also isn’t actively hostile. The one draining our mana also seems to be non-hostile, at least in theory. At the very least, they’ve been following us and not causing any problems, so I’m willing to put aside the matter for now.”

Anastasia leaned into Subaru, arms crossed on the table, and continued, “Now, onto the real questions: who chased us yesterday and why? How do you know her? Why did you leave without a spirit? And finally, do you have a danger sense? I’ve noticed you act weird right before something bad occurs.”

He had a weird seizure right before the bandit attack. He also acted strange right before we started running away. Twice might be coincidence but his behavior at the temple suggests otherwise, the notes were also too on-point. Maybe he is just perceptive and smart, but I need to at least check.

Subaru looked at her, his face noticeably tensing, “Alright. But I need you to know if I say I can’t say anything. It’s not because I don’t trust you. It’s because I really, really can’t.”

Anastasia stayed silent for a moment before nodding, “Dangerous?”

Subaru gulped, “More than you can ever know.”

She sighed, “Alright. But I want you to know that I can handle myself. That, despite my lack of combat ability, I am experienced and am not exactly helpless. Don’t exclude me in some vain attempt to protect me. Remember: you aren’t my knight, and I am not your candidate.”

There. It’s a start. Just need to keep reiterating. We are friends, business partners, but that’s it. We have Halibel now too. I’ll use our previous conversation to springboard us into having a normal relationship. I’ll slowly wean us off this… attachment.

Subaru just smiled, “I know. I won’t try to distance myself, I’ll keep you updated as much as possible.”

…At least he agreed.

Subaru closed his eyes, before he took a deep breath and clapped his cheeks, “Okay! Let’s start from the top. The one who was chasing us? I think she is similar to someone I met before. Someone who hated witch cultists.”

Anastasia raised an eyebrow, “That’s not exactly unique.”

Subaru just chuckled, “No, I guess not. But in this case, it is. From what I can tell, her hate is almost pathological, single-minded. Which is a problem considering it’s impossible to reason with her as a result. She is also similar in another way: she can recognize me based on smell.”

This caught Anastasia’s attention, “Smell? So, she has met you before?”

“No, I…” Subaru swallowed, “I smell like the witch.”

Anastasia stared, not saying anything.

Subaru tried to keep eye contact, failing as his eyes kept darting back and forth between her and the ground. Obviously waiting for a reaction.

“…I didn’t realize the witch smelled like sweat and mayo.”

Subaru almost choked, he quickly sniffed himself, before he shoved Anastasia playfully, “You jerk.”

Anastasia shrugged and gave a small smile, “Couldn’t help myself.”

She then got serious, “Don’t get me wrong. That is something hard to swallow. But I’m not going to treat you differently just because you smell like a monster.”

Subaru winced, “Yeah… monster.”

Shit. Did… wait, is that how he got captured? Did someone recognize him by smell and that’s why he got thrown in jail? But it doesn’t make sense, even if they were suspicious, one cross examination from someone like Reinhard and anyone could tell he was not a psychopathic Archbishop.

Her arm started to motion toward Subaru, but she stopped the reflex.

Stop. Just stop.

Anastasia chose to keep the conversation moving, “So, she recognized you by smell? Given that you don’t smell different to me compared to anyone else, it means such an ability is special. And given how she tracked us, I guess the smell can be very pungent.”

Her eyes widened and connected the dots, “That’s why you threw us in that dumpster,” she brought out the flower, “it wasn’t luck, the way you maneuvered through Banan, I knew it felt too deliberate. But how? The flowers, the powder, the location, the smell: it couldn’t be coincidence.”

Subaru tensed for a second, but he decided to bite the bullet, “It’s as you said… danger sense. That isn’t exactly what it is, but I can’t explain more than that. You’ll have to trust it as some sort of… instinct.”

Anastasia pinched her nose, “Fine. I will. But you know how frustrating that sounds, right?”

Subaru looked oddly sympathetic, “Believe me, its more frustrating for me than you think.”

She let out a sigh, “Okay, then what about the spirit? I know you were… close to your previous spirit but this isn’t a time to be sentimental. You need a spirit to drain your mana.”

Subaru shook his head, “That’s actually why I didn’t. I think I have an idea of who is draining our mana, but I think contracting a spirit would scare them away.”

She raised her eyebrow, “You think whoever is doing this is a spirit?”

Subaru shrugged his shoulder, “Maybe? It’s the only logical thing I can think of given how rare people who can drain mana are. The only one I can think of that isn’t a spirit is Rein, and if he was here, mana would not be our biggest concern.”

Anastasia grimaced, “Fair enough. If they really are a spirit and all they’ve done is drain our mana, perhaps we can reason with them. Maybe use a contract as terms for a negotiation.”

Subaru nodded and smiled, “As always, you know how to take advantage of a situation.”

She scoffed in faux indignation, “Honestly. You make it seem like I’m some sort of villainess.”

“Oh, woe is me, to be under the employment and heel of someone with such evil intent,” Subaru said as he dramatically swooned over the table.

 “Know thy place, servant. As I decree, everything that this world offers, is done in favor of me!” she said with a haughty tone and a puffed up chest.

 

…

 

“Pfft!” “Bwahaha!” The stars laughed.

 

Elsewhere, the sun princess slammed her faithful jester to the ground for the fifth time today, thinking his sneezing would get her sick. She promptly sneezed herself. Sixth time is the charm.

 

 

Back to our stars.

Subaru finally settled down, “Ha! Man, I hope Al is doing alright. But going back to what we were talking about, I think our resident witch hater has more of a connection to Tia than you initially thought.”

Anastasia also stopped giggling and raised an eyebrow, “Besides stealing her light ball?”

He nodded, “Hal-san and I caught a glimpse of her when she tried to attack me. From how you described Tia, they almost look identical, save for some kind of color palette swap.”

“Could they be siblings? Or maybe they are actually from the same tribe of people…”

“Hard to say, best choice is to ask Tia next time you see her. For now, I’m thinking we call our murderous version, Tia-Two.”

Anastasia narrowed her eyes, “Subaru. That’s a horrible name.”

He just snorted in response, “You have a better one in mind?”

“Ait.”

“That’s just her name spelled backwards! Okay how about, Dark Tia?”

“Sounds like something a child would come up with. Maybe Tiatia?

“Solid Tia?”

“…Liquid. Tia?”

He pointed at her, “See, not that easy is it?”

She swatted his hand away, “Fine, names are hard. Who could have guessed?”

To be fair, it took a long time to choose my name. Sasha, Katerina, Natasha. Had a whole list. I’m just glad I didn’t settle on Emerada. Ugh. That would have been awkward in Priestella.

“It’s not that hard, took me a barely a minute,” a new voice spoke up.

They both froze, both stars slowly turned towards the origin of the voice.

It was Tia. She was munching on an appa, with her feet up on the table. In fact, there were multiple appa cores, banina peels, and a peah pit already in front of her.

“How did you get in?!” “Were you eating our food?!”

“Shut up, you’re both so loud,” Tia used a finger to scratch her inner ear.

Anastasia was about to retort but she noticed a draft breezing through the room. The window nearby was open. It also, conveniently, had a fist shaped hole where the lock was supposed to be.

“How did we not even hear you?” Subaru questioned.

Tia shrugged, “You were both distracted.”

In reality, wind magic has various uses other than slicing people to death. Tia did not care enough to elaborate, however.

Tia turned her head towards Anastasia, “I need to borrow purple Ana, your male needs to leave. Now.”

Subaru tensed for a fight, “If you think I’m just going to leave Ana here alone-“

“Subaru, it’s okay.”

His eyes widen, “Ana, are you insane?!”

“Subaru,” she kept her eyes on Tia with a polite smile, “I doubt she’s going to kill me. She still needs me as bait. Me being dead won’t help with that.”

Tia began to frown and look away, “Tsk…Disgusting.”

Well, that was the wrong thing to say apparently.

Her reaction didn’t convince Subaru, “This isn’t a good idea.”

Tia quickly turned and glared at Subaru, “Oh my Od! I won’t kill the bitch. There! Happy? Now leave, your mate will be fine.”

Both stars began to blush and were about to vehemently deny such a relationship, until Tia finally lost her patience and threw Subaru out the window with her wind.

Anastasia’s jaw dropped, “Why did you do that?!”

“He’ll be fine. The mutt just returned.”

As Tia said, Anastasia looked outside and saw Subaru being tenderly manhandled by the Eternal Playboy. Like a well-cared sack of potatoes with a bump on the top, a now unconscious Subaru was lifted under the shoulder of Halibel.

“Ah Ana-bo! Thanks for the package. I’ll be takin’ Su-san for a walk, let you have some girl talk with Tia-chan. We’ll be back with some takeout,” he said as he turned down the road and chuckled.

Tia slammed the window down, barely missing Anastasia’s nose. Turning around, Tia was now glaring straight at her.

Trying to keep her polite smile intact, “Is something the matter?

Tia’s glare somehow got even hotter, “Stop it.”

Anastasia raised an eyebrow, “Stop what?”

“That shitty thing you are doing. Acting all demure and rabbit-like. It’s disgusting.”

Anastasia felt some irritation tickling her skull, “I don’t know what you mean?”

Tia just pointed at her, “That! Why do you do that?”

Her irritation was peaking, “You mean being polite? It’s a normal human thing people do.”

“So, why were you not doing it with your mate?”

It exploded, “He’s not my mate!” she quickly covered her mouth. Surprisingly, Tia just laughed.

“There we go! The male is your weakness. You’re finally acting like your real self.”

While Tia smirked, it was now Anastasia’s turn to glare, “Are you just here to anger me or is there an actual reason you came to bother me? Weren’t you going to just watch me until the thief sprung your trap?”

Tia shrugged, “If that were the case, I’d have your male still be here.”

Wait, she overheard our conversation. Was she here the whole time?

Tia pointed to her right ear, “No, dumbass. I know what you’re thinking. I got good senses and the wind has its perks. And I’ve been watching ya since we parted ways.”

This is already becoming a headache.

“And as for why I’m here, pissing you off is fun but with the thief in hiding, I got nothing much to do. So, now I’m just left being curious. Specifically, about one thing:”

She pointed at Anastasia again, “Why are you in love with the male and acting like you’re not?”

Whatever Anastasia was expecting, it wasn’t that.

Wait, no, I get it. She’s confusing something again. Just like the ‘family jewels’ scenario.

The merchant sighed, “I’m not in love with anyone. What your seeing is… an unhealthy coping mechanism.”

Tia looked confused so Anastasia continued explaining, “Subaru and I had a rough past. We found each other at our lowest point and as a result, became attached to each other as we used the other for support. As a result, we are intimate but not sexual. Affectionate but not romantic. Attentive but not involved.”

Now that we finally settled down in Banan, this can all be over. We can start over with something more long-term. With a few more boundaries and expectations. Nothing ambiguous. Just friends.

“Sounds like a load of bullshit to me. That’s just finding a mate with extra steps and a fucked-up start.”

Anastasia shook her head, “You can’t build a romantic relationship like that. Besides, I have more important things to do than find love. I can’t lose focus now.”

Tia just stared at Anastasia in response, not saying a word for a few moments, before breaking out into laughter.

“Ah, I see what’s going on here. I think I understand why I find you so disgusting and fascinating. You’re scared.”

“What? No, I’m not!”

“Haha! Yes, you are. You lost something, didn’t you? And now you’re scrambling to find it. But then, you find something just as precious to you. Something new that you don’t really understand. And now you don’t know what to do. You want to keep this but you know getting what you lost back, may destroy what you have now.”

Anastasia’s hands gripped the table, “That isn’t what this is-“

“Stop lying to yourself. I know your type. Greedy. So greedy that they want everything in the world. Up until they lose one thing. Then they get all defensive. Curl up into a ball and try their hardest to keep whatever they own. So greedy that they end up losing the opportunity to have more. How funny! Your greed is literally preventing you from having everything!”

Memories of her camp echoed. Regrets and guilt crept up her spine.

Her teeth were gritting, “… Shut up.”

“Ha, no. I’m getting to the best part. You must not have even noticed until now? Did my words yesterday wake you up? Because it seems like you are hesitating so much with the male who expects otherwise. You were lying to yourself, weren’t you? Trying to ignore how you felt, so you can feel just a little bit of comfort. Weak. Lame. But now your logical greedy side is winning over your emotional greed. Ah, I feel bad for that male, you used him up and now you’re just going to throw him away- “

“Shut the fuck up!”

The string holding her sanity together, within Anastasia’s mind, finally snapped.

Barely fazed, Tia was about to retort before Anastasia kept up the pressure, “What do you know about me? You don’t understand anything. You’re strong, you have power, you’re not scared of shit. You never experienced scrounging for food in the trash or having to fight for your life just to get a bowl of rice filled with maggots. You never experienced having someone you trust, run away in the middle of the night with everything you own. And you never experienced having to make yourself love someone just to survive.”

Memories of being a hyena gnawed at her mind. Memories of a certain woman she once wanted to call mother, choked her very core. She remembered how the woman would completely disfigure beautiful slaves and always give her the same old hated lesson:

“Ah, little one. Remember: never covet more than you need. See these ugly wretches! Just because they are pretty, they think they can want what I have. Those who are greedy, end up losing it all.”

The volcano erupted, it could not be stopped, “You never experienced anything I have! You lost a ball, something you can easily get back. I lost everything! Everyone I loved disappeared. All my hard work was taken. My legacy is dead. You have all the time in the world to build back up. I barely have a few more years left in me, if I’m lucky! Do you think I want to make someone cherish me, only to take that away from them. Someone who has lost so much already! Do you think I’m such a cruel woman?!”

Why did you have to be so kind to me, Subaru? Why couldn’t I have just kept you at a distance? Then I wouldn’t have to feel so guilty. Guilty that I might throw you away for my camp, just like yours did to you. That I’m starting to cherish you as much as I cherish them. That if I did make you fall in love with me, would you be able to keep going after I die?

Why was I so lonely? Why did I open up to you so easily? Was it because your kindness touched my heart. I wish my heart stayed closed so I didn’t have to experience this pain again. I didn’t want to care again. Stupid, stupid girl. I don’t want to love you. I can’t. I just can’t.

“If that’s what you wanted me to accept? Then fine! I am cruel. I’m a terrible human being who manipulates others for her own personal gain. I know how messed up Subaru is and I would still use him to make a profit. I wouldn’t reconnect with my family because it wouldn’t be the exact same as before. I accept all of it. All of my sins. So, go fuck yourself!”

Anastasia was panting, her throat coarse, her eyes watery. Suddenly, her logical side kicked back in.

Tia, who had been listening stone-faced the whole, brought a hand up.

Well, I’m dead.

She braced for impact, only to hear Tia slam the table instead.

With a more jovial smile, Tia laughed once again, “Finally, so that’s your real face.”

“W-what?”

“Your real face. You only show it with the male and even then, you still hide so much. I always wondered why humans use fake faces all the time. You had so many faces, the most out of anyone I’ve ever met, which made me curious, but this one is the real one isn’t it? Crass, outspoken, greedy, hypocritical, - “

“Wow, gee thanks.”

Tia ignored her, “Lonely, weak, spiteful, and cruel. Really, so lame and funny, but at least its not disgusting like before.”

Sniffling, Anastasia glared, “The fuck is wrong with you? What’s this obsession with a ‘real face?”

Tia raised a finger, “Oh almost forgot, curious to a fault.”

Anastasia also raised a finger, a specific finger.

Tia ignored her again, “Everyone has a face. We are all born with one. We use faces to help communicate with people. Show them how we feel so that we can connect.  Babies always cry to let their mother know they need love. But then as they grow older, people cry to take love away. Crying about hardships, only to cause hardships for others. You would probably argue it’s the best way for the weak to survive. I would argue instead, that is what makes you weak. To not face your hardships directly, makes you weak.”

Not fully understanding, Anastaisa rubbed her eyes, “Is this somehow related to your light ball?”

Tia gave her a thumbs up, “Wow, I can now put ‘slightly not dumb’ for you as well.”

“Fuck you.”

“Haha! But yeah, you are correct. I listened to your conversation. This, Tia-Two. She’s not like me. She didn’t look like me but then she took my ball, which then made her like me. Understand?”

“Od, you speak in such an annoying way.”

“I do what I want, and I like how I speak. Anyway, I think I understand why that bitch took my ball. She was probably some weak girl, looking for glory, or some semblance of vengeance against those witch cultists. She was crying and she is making that everyone’s problem. Using my face to do it, because she is too weak to face her hardships with her real face.”

Rubbing her temples, Anastasia felt like she wanted to scream again, “So this was just a whole scheme, to piss me off. Show my ‘real face.’ And explain more about the fake you.”

“Yeah. And because it was funny. The faker part was just a bonus.”

“I hate you. So. Much.”

“And you are very entertaining. Ah, don’t be so melodramatic. If you really want some advice, I can help you with your male problem.”

“If it’s something related to ‘negotiating with love is pointless,’ I will punch you. I do not care if you can kill me.”

“You can try but I doubt you can actually hit me with your widdle baby hands. Ha! But don’t worry it’s nothing like that. It’s simple: love him or don’t.”

Anastasia choked, “It’s not that simple!”

“It is that simple. What if you die tomorrow? What if you die right now? All of your fears feel silly don’t they? Those regrets you have when you die are simply because you never act how you want. You hide it under stupid pretenses like ‘what if things go wrong.’ Don’t let your greed control you. Let it be free and accept all consequences.”

“So just, do whatever and see how it goes?”

“It was better in my words but if you want to say it the lame way, sure, go ahead,” Tia put her feet on top of the table again.

I think I have found the next contender for ‘person who pisses me off the most.’ Congratulations Subaru, you have a viable rival for no.1.

Knock! Knock!

They suddenly heard knocks at the entrance before the door suddenly slammed open. Two figures slid into the room, posing in very dumb ways.

“We have arrived! And with lunch!”

“Yep yep! Sorry for the delay, Su-san got us lost.”

Subaru looked back incredulously at Halibel, “You tried flirting with someone’s wife. You were this close to getting castrated,” Subaru emphasized his point by pinching his fingers.

Halibel just huffed, “That was also Su-san’s fault. Ya were supposed to be my, what did you call it? Birdman? Ya were supposed to be my birdman and give me a signal that she was married.”

Subaru waved his hands in the air, “I did! I literally gave you a sign that she had a wedding ring!” He demonstrated the sign which was Subaru making a circle with one hand and putting it on a finger of the other hand.

Halibel just stared at him, “…Ya see how I could have interpreted that differently. From my point of view?”

Subaru looked down. Then up. Then down again. Then up again. He narrowed his eyes, which then immediately widened, “Ohhhhhh. I think you just have a dirty mind.”

“And you need better hand signals!”

“Oi, what is this stuff?” Tia asked as she started rummaging through the packed take-out.

“Hm?” Halibel looked at his hand where the food used to be resting.

Subaru yelled, “How did she steal that from you?! Aren’t you the strongest in Kararagi?”

“Ya never goin’ to let me live that down aren’tcha?”

Subaru ignored Halibel and ran towards the food, he quickly grabbed it away from Tia’s hands, “Hey, hey! We brought this to share, don’t just start grabbing it, that’s bad table manners.”

Tia just stomped her foot and pouted.

While doing this, Subaru darted his eyes to Anastasia, who was currently spacing out.

Subaru looked into the bag, and exclaimed suddenly, “Oh no! We forgot the drinks!”

Halibel, who had his usual lazy expression this whole time, suddenly opened his eyes and was brought to his knees, “Su-san! How could you do this to me?! My alcohol!”

“I’m sorry Hal-san! I’ll go quick buy some from the nearby store,” Subaru gently grabbed Anastasia’s hand, “With Ana.”

Wait- “What?”

“Hal-san, you entertain Tia and make sure she doesn’t eat all of the food,” with that said, he tossed the food over to Tia. She immediately began to rummage through the food again.

Halibel suddenly stiffened, “Wait, Su-san this wasn’t part of the-“

“Sorry Hal! Gotta go grab the alcohol, bye!!” Subaru quickly rushed out of the house with Anastasia in tow.

Now on the streets, Subaru slowed down and let go of Anastasia’s hand. Despite her best efforts, she desperately wanted it back.

Everything feels so confusing again. I thought I decided things would be different, that I wouldn’t stay attached. Now, I want everything, all at once. Ha! Maybe I am too greedy…

“Ana? Are you okay?”

Anastasia got shaken out of her thoughts, “Yeah. Never better.”

Subaru took it in stride, “You don’t have to lie. It’s pretty obvious what happened.”

Anastasia froze and stood still at one side of the street. They were walking along a fairly empty neighborhood. Everyone was either at work or near the downtown area currently.

“That obvious huh?” Anastasia looked embarrassed.

“Well, I feel like I would be a pretty bad guy if I ignored the red eyes, pinkish face, and tear stains on a pretty girl.”

Her cheeks got redder, “Oh yeah. I guess.”

This time Subaru looked sheepish, “Also, we might have. Maybe. Heard you yelling.”

At this point, Anastasia started curling up into a ball, sitting, “…You heard everything?”

“Well, I think we started hearing it halfway through. I think around the point you started talking about losing things.”

Oh, so he heard basically everything. Great.

“…”

Subaru sat down next to Anastasia, “Ana, did I ever tell you about how Emilia and I got into a huge fight?”

“…No.”

“Yeah, I don’t like talking about it. It was one of my biggest mistakes. I got so obsessed with her. I ended up not only alienating her but also embarrassing myself in front of the whole Royale Selection. Got in a fight with Julius too, he kicked my ass.”

I think I remember that. Sort of. Julius got in a fight with a random knight who ended up resigning. It was during the first meeting of the selection. Was that Subaru?

Subaru continued his story, “And the reason I got obsessed? I was afraid… of being alone. Of being abandoned for someone better. It was so dumb. The problem though? Those fears were reaffirmed when Gluttony got me. They abandoned me, only caring about my accomplishments. Without them, I was nobody. Worse, I was treated like a monster.”

Memories of their earlier conversation in the morning ran through her mind. For a moment, regret formed, only to be smothered by another memory.

“Those regrets you have when you die are simply because you never act how you want.”

Her hand edged toward Subaru’s, resting quietly on top of his.

Subaru noticed but didn’t bring attention to it, “And I thought that was it. My worst nightmare came true. But then I met you. I met someone who probably thought I was some weak stupid kid, who got in a fight with their knight for stupid reasons. And I thought, this is the annoying girl who prioritizes profit first. And employs Julius. They must be terrible. Honestly, I didn’t trust you for a second in the beginning.”

You should have kept doing that. I should have kept doing that. Why did we trust each other so fast? It was so stupid.

Subaru laughed, “But you know what happened? That annoying girl took a chance and opened her heart. To me of all people. I don’t know why but it felt like I was looking into the mirror. Because you looked so lonely.”

… We were both such lonely people. Forgotten. Maybe, it was because I saw myself in him as well.

Subaru softly rubbed her hand, it made her feel warm, “And as we traveled, something else changed: I began to admire you for how greedy you are. You value yourself highly. You demand compensation always. And you always ask for a high reward. Before, I’d think you were flying too close to the sun. Now, I realize that’s a form of self-love. To love yourself and demand that others recognize your value. I never did that because I always thought my life was worth little.”

I noticed. You acted like all of your actions, all of your incredible achievements, were par for the course.

He began to stand up, lifting her up to face him, she didn’t notice before but she was crying, “But now? I want to try being that kind of person. I want to demand value, I want to know how to love myself. I want to be like you. And I’m going to start now: Anastasia I demand a reward for my efforts in helping you get to Kararagi!”

Despite her tears, she started cracking up, “Pfft! Okay, what would you like to bargain for Subaru?”

Subaru raised his free hand and pointed at her, “Its not going to be some job. Or even just a name or smile. Something fitting for all I’ve done: help me achieve and be a part of my happy ending.”

Anastasia must have looked very confused because Subaru immediately started explaining, “It sounds vague, I know. But I’ve always dreamed of having something like that. Where at the end of my story, I’m happy and healthy and with people I love. Which requires a lot of hard work because I now consider being healthy as loving myself. Lots of time and effort are required so it will be difficult.”

Anastasia began to ponder downward, parts of her still questioning if this is healthy, “Subaru, I don’t know if that’s a good idea…” she then looked up and saw Subaru smirking.

“Then how about a counteroffer? Keep being greedy. Be selfish. Be yourself. I need a role model to learn from, don’t I? So, I need you to keep being a ‘sinful person.’ Look at me and think of how you can profit from me. While I’ll look at you and think of how much I can benefit from you. We’ll learn from each other and build each other up, selfishly. Cooperating selfishly. Without any attachment based on guilt or like we owe each other. Do whatever we want, without restraint. Maybe we’ll end up hurting each other, maybe we are messed up. But at least, we can hold our heads up high and say, ‘I lived my way.’”

Anastasia didn’t respond, contemplating once again, “…What if I abandon you for my camp?”

She didn’t expect this response, Subaru snorted, “Then I’ll offer you a reason to keep me near. And I expect you’ll do the same for me too. I know who you are. Even if I ended up back in my camp, you’ll probably entice me with tons of offers to join you.”

She tried to tease him, “You know me so well, huh? How intimate~.”

Subaru smacked the teasing back, “You’re the one who invited me into bed first.”

She blushed and pinched his cheek, “B-because I needed a body pillow!”

“Whatever you say~!”

They both stared at each other before giggling.

“Ha, our relationship is so fucked up,” Anastasia bluntly stated.

Subaru just shrugged, “Not even in my top ten. You should see Ram and Roswaal. He basically adopted her to become his superweapon. Heck, I fell in love with someone who nearly killed me and tortured me.”

Anastasia looked horrified, “Subaru. You can’t just drop something like that out of nowhere. Especially given how exhausting today has been. And we haven’t even eaten lunch.”

“Eh. Part of my ‘love myself’ plan is admitting how fucked up my life really is.”

She facepalmed, “Okay… we’ll talk about that later then, I guess.”

Subaru grinned, “And what about my offer?”

She stopped facepalming, and simply closed her eyes and smiled, “…You drive a hard bargain. I accept.”

Subaru fist pumped in the air, “We’ll figure this out one step at a time. Sure, everything is so messy. And maybe we got a bit too close so fast. And maybe our relationship looks weird to other people and can't be defined normally.”
