Chapter 10: Two Weeks of Prep

Summary:

This chapter, we follow the gang as they prepare for the festival among other things.

In addition, both stars begin exploring their hearts.

Notes:

This chapter is a very long one, tons to get through, so enjoy~!

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

The festival of storms, otherwise known as the Great Rain Festival, was only two weeks away. While usually obtaining a stall so close to the event would be difficult, Halibel’s connections got them a very nice area, albeit small. And it only cost two tartar sauce bottles.

Given the short time frame, they had a lot to cover before they were ready.

Day 1:

“The color looks fine but honestly? The pattern doesn’t look great. Too flowery.”

“…Guys.”

“Hmm, I agree with ya Ana-bo. Su-san ain’t a flower boy. He needs something more manly. Or maybe more feminine?” Halibel offered while taking out a pink kimono.

Tia nodded in approval, “Definitely feminine. Nothing manly would fit him right now. Su’s too thin, he needs more fat and muscle. More meat and sugar. We should get some on our way back.”

“Guys.”

“No no, Tia-chan, we ain’t buyin’ more sweets for ya. It’ll all go to ya waist.”

“Tsk. Sugar goes to the brain first mutt.”

“So that’s why ya have such a large fivehead.”

“I will rearrange your guts, so help me.”

“Ohhhh Tia-chan, so forward~. Ya gotta buy this wolf dinner first before gettin’ anywhere near his insides.”

“Guys! Are you all ignoring me?”

“And you guys say Subaru and I need to get a room,” Anastasia said with exasperation as she ignored Subaru.

“Disgusting. Never in a million years with the mutt.”

“Agreed. How could ya even think of such a dark future Ana-bo?”

“You both keep insinuating innuendos for us all the time!” Anastasia pointed at Tia, “She literally tells us to fuck half the time.”

Tia scoffed, “Untrue. I tell you to do it all the time. Speaking of, go mate.”

Anastasia looked positively mortified, she angrily whispered, “We are literally in the middle of a store!”

Halibel just laughed, “Hasn’t stopped this one!” As Halibel then pointed a thumb at himself with a cheeky grin.

The merchant put her hands on her face, “Please. I did not want to know.”

Tia tenderly grabbed Anastasia’s shoulders from behind, “In the wild, there is no limit to where you can do it. Do not be afraid, little Ana, embrace your inner animal.”

Anastasia lovingly death gripped Tia’s hands, “Tia. Why are you like this?”
Tia ignored the miniscule amount of pressure and gave her most sincere smile, “Because your reactions are entertaining.”

“…Now I know how Suwen feels.”

 

 

“GUYS!”

All three of his companions finally turned their heads back towards him. Subaru was currently wearing a black haori with a pink floral pattern.

“…We’ve been looking for hours. At this point, I’d rather sew my own outfit.”

They were currently shopping for supplies as well as new clothing. Well, mostly just for Subaru and Anastasia. Halibel had an extensive wardrobe and Tia had specific tastes.

Anastasia was surprised, “You can sew?”

“Have I never mentioned that? Back in my camp, I would sew all of my clothing. Heck, I would even make dolls for Petra and Meili.”

“Well, that changes things,” she turned towards the manager of the store, “We’ll take a plain black haori set and a plain white kimono set. Actually, make that five of each.”

The manager nodded and quickly told her employees to assemble the orders.

Subaru tilted his head, “The haori I get, but a kimono? I thought you were also going to try some on?”

Anastasia just scoffed, “Why would I get something anyone can buy rather than something uniquely tailored to me?”

“Why do you think I’m going to make something for you too?”

She then shuffled up to her partner-in-crime with her best Mimi eyes, “Buuuut Subaru~! Don’t I deserve something nice for once?”

Subaru just stared at her with annoyance, “…You kicked me out of the bed because it was too hot yesterday.”

Anastasia stared back with saccharine affection, “…But! I apologized and allowed you back.”

“After you made me go get Tia-One to blow some cold wind around the house to cool it. She nearly cut my head off when I woke her up!”

Tia clicked her tongue again, “Tsk. I told you I don’t like being woken up at night! Make it up for me by creating a better kimono than Ana’s.”

Halibel just laughed, “Ah, Su-san since I am your favorite landlord, you should consider giftin’ me one as well. It is only fair.”

Subaru looked between them all, “I’m not your personal fashion designer!”

Anastasia now got really close to him, “Buuuut Subaruuuu~!” She was really laying on as much cuteness as possible, puffing up her cheeks and batting her eyelashes.

Subaru tried his best to resist, “Ana, I’m not doing it.”

“Pweease~?”

“Urgh! N-no.”

Anastasia was now hugging him tightly by the arm, “It would make me so happy~.”

“…”

“…”

“…Fine.”

Sucker.

Anastasia immediately let him go and started shaking his hands vigorously, “Pleasure doing business with ya Subaru-kun!”

She then skipped away to pay for their outfits.

Subaru sighed before immediately noticing the expression on Halibel and Tia’s faces. Smiling annoyingly.

“What?”

“Nothing! Pleasure doin’ with business with ya as well Su-kun~” Halibel said as he brought his hands together and made a kissy face. He then followed behind Anastasia.

Tia just came up and patted him on the back, “Don’t worry Su. Females are always a male’s greatest weakness.”

Subaru stared at Tia before lifting his head to the ceiling, closing his eyes and sighing.

“…Hate you guys so much,” Subaru muttered under his breath.

Day 3:

“Ana and Su’s Company?”

“Too simple.”

“Black and White Sauces? The black is Su-san while the White is Ana-bo.”

“The customer might assume all of our sauces are just white and black. While technically that is some of our sauce colors, I don’t think we should constrain ourselves. Also, the name just sucks.”

“Sauces Have Incredible Taste?”

“…Subaru, what do all the first letters of that name spell out?”

“…Me?”

Anastasia looked bewildered at Subaru.

Subaru simply pointed at himself and clarified, “Little shit.”

Anastasia then pursed her lips and said, “Ooooooohhhh.”

 

 

“No.”

Subaru, indignant, “Hey come on! It kind of works, it’s funny and could bring in customers.”

“Well one: I’m not included in the company name. Two: I don’t want to name my company SHIT!”

Subaru put on his best thinking face.

He snapped his fingers, “Love of Life In Sauces Have Incredible Taste!”

“…”

Subaru was currently double finger gunning with a shit eating grin.

Anastasia started walking slowly towards Subaru, “…Subaru.”

The grin dropped, “Ana it was a joke.”

“I’m not going to hurt you.”

Anastasia started picking up speed while Subaru began backtracking.

“You are absolutely lying.”

Anastasia put on an offended expression, “Subaru! I would never.”

As she said this, she started sprinting at him.

“No, you would! You absolutely would!!”

Subaru began the greatest moonwalk in Kararagi history.

“I’m just trying to give you a hug!”

“My neck isn’t where most people hug, especially with just their hands!”

Any onlookers would be able to see an absolutely romantic scene of a purple haired woman wringing her hands in the air while sprinting at her black-haired lover, who was backtracking like his life depended on it. Truly, a romantic comedy.

“Natsuki Subaru! Get back here so I can strangle you!”

“You are not even trying to hide it anymore!”

Tia turned her head over at Halibel. This was all happening next to their house.

“Weren’t we supposed to get food?”

Halibel was just grinning, “Yep yep.”

“…This is very funny to watch.”

“I thought you were going to say ‘shouldn’t we stop them?’”

“Why would I say that mutt? That’s lame. This is better. It’s like watching two animals fight and fuck.”

“I really don’t know if ya actually understand some of the words ya use. But yeah, it kinda is like that.”

Subaru ran over to them and quickly ducked behind Tia, “Tia-chan help!”

Tia simply raised her eyebrow at him.

Subaru narrowed his eyes, “One extra bottle of teriyaki.”

Tia smiled and patted him on the head, “This is why you are my favorite Su.”

Anastasia finally arrived, gasping for air, “Halibel… curse Subaru or something.”

Halibel just dramatically held his hand on his chest, “Ana-bo! I would never betray Su-san!!”

“Tartar…Sauce.”

“You cannot buy brotherhood-“

“Three bottles.”

The wolf took out a kunai, “Sorry Su-san. Say goodbye to your family jewels.”

Subaru poked his head out from behind Tia, “She said curse me not my bloodline!”

Tia readied her hand, “Don’t worry Su, this dog is about to be two chorries lighter. Your balls are safe.”

Halibel snorted, “The correct comparison would be melans, Shini-ugly.”

Tia glared, “My bad. I meant peos.”

Subaru had a slightly glazed look, “I can’t believe peas is spelled like that here…”

The ensuing battle was legendary!

…Until they stopped because someone complained about the noise, the rest of the day was spent surveying the stall area and looking for someone to design a booth for them.

Day 6:

Anastasia and Subaru were currently waiting outside a reputable blacksmith and metalworker shop.

“So, you had a crush, that was very similar to the maid you also have a crush on, who tortured and nearly killed you?”

Subaru looked uncomfortable, “…Yes.”

…What is with Subaru’s luck?! Is it just his destiny to be tortured by his friends?

Anastasia started massaging her temples, “And you still like this girl?”

Subaru puffed his cheeks thinking, “Yes.”

“But you also like Emilia and the maid?”

“…Yes.”

“…Are you a masochist?”

“Ye-what, no!”

“It really sounds like you are,” Anastasia put a hand on her hip.

“I do not like pain!”

“Well, do you want a harem?”

“No! I mean sure, every guy fantasizes about having one, but I didn’t intend on falling in love with multiple people. It just happened!”

“…Do you still like them?”

I know he does. But I want to see how he responds.

“…I don’t know. A part of me feels hurt by how easily I was thrown away by Emilia. I know it wasn’t her fault but… it felt like I was abandoned once again just because I made a mistake. And Rem… my feelings are complicated about her. I’ve started thinking about how she treated me when we first met. I was… reminded of my third crush. Yet I still love them. It feels… wrong. It didn’t before but it does now.”

Hm? I was expecting more of a clear and complete yes. He did mention before how betrayed he felt being cast aside without anyone to believe him, but conflictingly he never specifically blamed anyone. And considering how affectionately he talked about the maid and his candidate on the way to Banan from Lugunica, it feels slightly out of character for him to say such a thing with so little time passing. What happened to change his mind?

…Was it because of our conversation? Or was it because of me?

  1. Don’t do that. It’s still too soon to think those thoughts. I blame Tia, I really need to tape her mouth shut one of these days.

“Feelings are… complicated. You can’t really control them and sometimes you never expect when they come out. I’ve already told you that one story. But did you know my first crush was Ricardo?”

Subaru turned his head in surprise, “Really?”

Anastasia smiled, “Yep. He was one of the first adults who treated me well without some messed up motivation. He never took advantage of me for his own indulgences. And he got me my first job. He was kind, sweet, and patient.”

I realized it when he bought my first birthday present. A doll in the image of Alec Hoshin. I remember secretly carrying it everywhere I went.

“Honestly, from how you’re explaining it, I would have fallen in love with him as well. Is he still single?” Subaru joked.

Anastasia playfully punched his shoulder and smiled even brighter, “He is but he isn’t interested. But anyway, the point I want to make is that you can’t help who you fall in love with. But you shouldn’t just let yourself be controlled by your crushes. Even though I loved Ricardo, I was too young, and our personalities were not compatible romantically. So, I grew out of it.”

“…It’s not that I think I’m incompatible with them. And our ages are similar.”

Anastasia sighed, “Okay then, let’s start simple, why do you like these girls?”

Subaru looked away for a moment, despondent, before refocusing on Anastasia, “…They’re kind, loyal, and compassionate. But most of all, they helped me out when I was at my lowest points. Emilia may not remember, but she was the first person who showed me kindness when I arrived here. Rem was there when I felt hopeless, when I was about to give up. She gave me a reason to push forward and believe in myself, or at least in a version of myself she believed in. And the third one… she was similar to Rem, she was there for me when I was at my lowest as well.”

It just seems like you get easily attached to people when you experience a stressful situation and feel obligated to pay them back for miniscule reasons. Well, I would be a hypocrite to completely denounce that, considering how we met and got close.

Still though, that was that and this is this.

“And what about what you don’t like about them. Love is about accepting their flaws as well.”

“Well. I guess I don’t like how naïve Emilia can be sometimes. Sure, it’s cute. But it feels like I’m talking to a young teenager sometimes instead of someone my age.”

“Really? When I talk with you it seems like I’m talking to a five-year-old brat.”

Subaru smiled, “Takes one to know one.”

“It’s why we get along so well. But seriously? It doesn’t seem so bad. Maybe a bit immature but that’s not the worst.”

Subaru stared at Anastasia, “She thought when I kissed her, she was pregnant.”

Anastasia stared back.

Blinked.

And then immediately choked.

“…How?”

“I blame her adoptive father, Puck. It seems like his parenting style was one thing and one thing only: protect. Like a helicopter parent. And that’s not the only problem with him but we can talk about that later.”

Note to self: I need to ask Subaru what a helly-coptur is later.

“So, you both kissed. Was this before or after you promised to wait for her to understand what love is?”

Subaru shrugged, “It was around the same time. After that, we went on some dates and held hands. But nothing really else.”

Anastasia was baffled, “So you kissed. You went on daytes, whatever that is, I’m assuming it’s some sort of courtship. And she still hasn’t realized if she likes you or not after a year and a half?!”

Subaru grimaced, “I think it’s maybe an elf thing. Perhaps her development is slow.”

Anastasia pinched her nose, “No. I think its because you gave her way too much time and freedom.”

He got defensive, “I didn’t want to pressure her, I don’t want her to return my feelings if they aren’t true.”

“Subaru, you gave her unlimited time, that’s the problem. And just like anyone who gets unlimited time with no reason to rush, she will procrastinate. Even if she doesn’t do it consciously, subconsciously she will push off difficult topics to another day. And then another day. Repeatedly. What you did was too kind and unrealistic. In the world of business, no one is going to wait for you to get the perfect recipe or create the perfect product for sale. To survive, you have to take the plunge even if you don’t feel confident. That’s how people evolve, when they are under pressure and pushed to create results. And let’s say elf development does slow her, that means she might take years or decades to actually understand how she feels. But you’re not an elf. That amount of time is precious to you. Human lives are way shorter than elves. What if you die before she decides? What if you get an incurable disease? What if she rejects you and it’s when you reach 60?”

“I know!” Subaru yelled, Anastasia backpedaled slightly, “Sorry… you’re right. It’s just. I’ve had similar thoughts. But I pushed them to the back of my mind at the time because I wanted something genuine with Emilia. And I didn’t want her to think she was obligated to return those feelings.”

Anastasia rubbed his arm, “I’m sorry too. I guess I got riled up by how terrible this sounded.”

“…Is this because you don’t have much time to live?”

Anastasia flinched, “So… you did hear that. Of course you did, I guess I just hoped you didn’t.”

Now it was Subaru’s turn to rub her arm, “We don’t have to talk about it. I’m sorry I ended up hearing it.”

“No, that isn’t the problem. I just didn’t want you to worry about that. Regardless, yes. I don’t have that much time left.”

“How much?”

“…Maybe 10 years at most, if I’m lucky.”

“…” Subaru tightened his grab on her slightly, “And how did this happen?”

Anastasia sighed, “My gate was already defective, meaning that I could not take in mana from the environment. So, the damn thing has been slowly draining my Od. Normally that would mean I would have a lifespan of around 50 years, give or take. But, because of what happened with Gluttony, I gambled with my life. I asked my spirit at the time to funnel as much mana as possible into my body to force myself into the Flow Method. Unfortunately, my spirit cannot absorb mana from the environment well, so the only source was my Od. I gambled and failed. Lost my name as well as several decades of my life.”

“…Ana-“

The merchant raised her hand, looking resolute, “I don’t need any pity. I’ve known my life was short ever since I was a child. And everyday I’ve lived it like it was the last. That’s why I always go after my dreams and ambitions. I take what I want, and I don’t care how others think. It’s how I lived my life and it being shorter doesn’t change that. It just means I’ll be making every moment of it worthwhile.”

Subaru gave a somber but supportive smile back, “I know you don’t need pity. I just want to say: I’m glad I can be here with you. And I’m glad that you told me. Because now I know, I have ten years to make sure your life is the best it can be.”

Anastasia smiled but gave him a pinch, “While I am grateful for such kindness, you should be taking care of yourself as well. Don’t just focus on me.”

He laughed, “Hey, remember, I’m being trying to be more like you. So, I’ll be greedy and make both of our lives the best they can be.”

“…You idiot.”

“We’re both idiots.”

“Says you.”

They both chuckled and giggled.

Anastasia spoke again, “So what about Rem? We got off topic, but I’d like to know what you don’t like about her as well.”

And it doesn’t seem you want to talk about the third at all, given the lack of a name you’re providing me with.

“…Rem is passionate. She cares immensely about people she loves. But that gives her tunnel vision, a certain narrow-mindedness that I think is dangerous. Again, she didn’t like me in the beginning. And it was related to how I smelled. She had the same ability as Tia-Two.”

I wonder if that means Tia-Two is an Oni as well. Maybe we should try capturing her, though I don’t know how reasonable she could be considering how murder happy she seems to be.

“She thought you were a Witch Cultist?”

Subaru nodded, “And what’s worse is that her whole village was massacred by the Witch Cult.”

Anastasia visibly shuddered, “So she must have had a grudge. But… you don’t act like one at all. I’m guessing she realized you were more than just your smell?”

Subaru twitched.

Wait, what? There’s that twitch again.

“…It took some time but yes. Though honestly, it felt more like luck than anything. But the problem was that she genuinely hated me, and it affected how she perceived me. Even when the others told her I wasn’t a cultist, she wouldn’t believe them one hundred percent. She had a valid reason but a part of me is still scared of what she could have done if she wasn’t convinced.”

…I have a suspicion. A theory. I need it confirmed right now.

“Subaru. This danger sense you mentioned, “she noticed him tensing but she needed to know, “Did it…go off when you met Rem?”

“…Yes.”

“…And let’s say, hypothetically, this danger sense helps you know when something is about to put your life in danger. Would that mean you could know if someone has intentions to kill you or will have intentions to kill you?”

Subaru took a deep breath, closing his eyes as if bracing, “…Yes.”

He quickly looked relieved when he opened them, which was not left unnoticed.

“…Okay.”

Maybe it’s not exactly a ‘danger sense.’ This almost confirms it. Those twitches. His extreme reluctance to say the exact nature of this ability. His almost uncanny ability to react quickly and know certain specific details that should not be possible. I’ve heard of this as a rumor that in Vollachia, there exists people who can see the future. Subaru must be similar. He saw the future. Or perhaps, only futures where his life is in danger. Or bad futures. And maybe not saying he can is one of the limitations. But that’s not the issue.

Rem, Ram, Otto, Garfiel, and Roswaal. What exactly did they do to him in those hypothetical futures? And I can’t imagine how he felt in that prison…

…I need to make plans.

Anastasia didn’t say a word but slowly embraced Subaru.

“A-ana?”

“…I think I understand a bit now. Subaru, I’m glad we met.”

Maybe he was like me, forced to build love and trust with monsters to survive.

Subaru blushed, “Where is this coming from?”

He’s not staying in that camp. I won’t let him. It would be the same as letting those slavers take slaves off the streets. Forced into servitude to survive.

“You don’t have to explain anything. Just know, I won’t let you go back to that hell. Ever.”

“…” Subaru, still confused, was silent as he slowly brought his arms around her. They had hugged before but as the days have gone by, small things have changed.

Such as how long they hugged. How tenderly they held each other. How both their cheeks got a little flushed. And what was currently happening: a rapid beating from each of their chests.

She looked up into Subaru’s eyes softly.

Maybe those confused feelings of affection are because he needed to survive. Maybe he just needs a reason to throw those feelings away. Maybe I could-

SLAM!

The door to the blacksmith opened, “Sorry bout the wait, I got yer metal containers ready finally-“

The blacksmith was holding three metal baskets with wooden handles. Subaru’s deep fry baskets. He also came upon a scene where Subaru and Anastasia were currently flushed and a considerable distance away from each other.

“Did I interrupt something?”

“No!” They both yelled before glancing at each other and quickly looking away.

“…Riiiight. Well let me just hand these to ya and get ya on yer way.”

The walk home was a bit awkward.

Day 8:

“So, you lost both yer names?!”

“Yep.”

It was hard for the two stars to decide if they should, but they decided to explain some of their situation to Halibel. They were all together laying around the main living room. Tia was also there and would not leave no matter what.

“Disgustin’. What a disgustin’ ability that is. To take away someone’s very history, their footprint on the world. It’s basically akin to killin’ a man. But in some ways worse because the bastard left them alive to experience the loneliness,” Halibel clicked his tongue.

Ricardo did say he was the wolf demi-humans’ pride, the only one who could actively show his heritage. The idea that it could all be taken away…

Tia looked unfazed, “So what? You’re still alive. You can still eat, drink, sleep.  A name is just that: a word. As long as you still exist, the bastards can be paid back in full.”

Halibel, irritated, “It ain’t just about bein’ alive. Imagine all of your hard work, everything you ever did, gone. As if ya didn’t exist. It’s an ability for parasites. Those who see the happiness of others and decide to take it because they won’t work for it themselves. I don’t expect ya to understand but don’t play down such a situation. It’s not funny.”

Tia narrowed her eyes, “I wasn’t joking mutt. You’re taking this too seriously. Who cares if your name is gone, you’re still free. Freedom is all that matters. Look at Ana and Su, they’re alive and fine. This Gluttony is lame if all it takes is something as worthless as a name.”

Halibel was about to angrily retort, but was cut off by Subaru’s own cold voice, “That’s enough Tia.”

“Su even you-“

“Enough!” He looked disappointed, “Tia. You may not care about losing your name, but some people do. Ana lost her whole company, all her accomplishments, and her family. She lost so much from Gluttony. Imagine if you lost your name which then led to your light ball disappearing forever. And imagine someone came up to you and basically told you that you shouldn’t feel bad that you lost it because at least you’re still alive.”

Tia flinched, “…Angry.”

Subaru continued, “That’s how it felt for people who lost their name. Having everything they cherished, including their very identity, gone within a second. You can believe whatever you want but don’t you dare make light of people’s problems like that. Especially when you don’t truly understand.”

“…Sorry Su,” Tia looked like a kicked puppy.

Subaru looked at her, half disappointed and half with compassion, “It isn’t me you should apologize to.”

Tia turned toward Anastasia but had an expression that was genuinely apologetic, “Sorry Ana, I wasn’t right to say that.”

To be fair, she isn’t exactly wrong. I was still alive and able to move forward. The mindset she has isn’t bad but she just said it tactlessly.

Still, Anastasia was shocked at how good Subaru has become at wrangling Tia, “It’s okay, I accept the apology.”

Halibel was still a little peeved, “Isn’t there someone else ya have to apologize to?”

Tia glared at the wolf, “Mutt-“

Subaru raised his eyebrow, “Tia.”

Tia pouted, “Sorry mutt.”

“Tia!”

If Tia could double pout, she would, “…Sorry Hal.”

Halibel decided to let it go, “Apology accepted.”

Anastasia gave Subaru two quick squeezes on the hand to say, “Thank you.”

Subaru squeezed back, “Anytime and always.”

Anastasia pondered for a moment before deciding this was the best moment.

Well, time to pay back the favor.

“There is one thing we should clarify,” Anastasia began, “Not all of us were left alive and well. Subaru wasn’t so lucky.”

Subaru gulped, “Ana we don’t have to-“

She looked at him, “Be greedy.”

“…Yes, I will. Please continue.”

And so, Anastasia told their two companions all she knew that happened to Subaru during his imprisonment. She looked at Subaru for confirmation about explaining some of the more graphic details. She wouldn’t say anything if he said no. Subaru looked reluctant but decided he wanted to explain that bit himself. Anastasia held his hand the whole time.

Halibel looked positively horrified. Tia. Tia had a very interesting expression. Like a mix of disgust, horror, hatred, anger, and nostalgia all in one.

Tia was silent and focused the entire time, especially when Subaru started explaining what Felix did.

“Od. Su-san, pardon me but what the fuck?”

“Yeah… it was. Yeah,” Subaru looked a little pale but he wasn’t having a bad reaction like usual. Which was great progress.

“…” Tia was still silent. She then got up and kneeled in front of Subaru.

“…”

Seconds passed before she finally spoke, “I want to make sure I understand. Completely. You lost your name. And the people you helped, the people you gave up your freedom for. Abandoned you. They butchered you. Imprisoned you. How do you feel about that?”

Subaru was startled, he briefly looked down before staring into Tia’s eyes, “I-I don’t know… Some days I feel alright. Other days I feel like I want to tear the whole world apart. All I do know is, I never want to go back to that hellhole ever again. I think…I think I want to be happy. To prioritize myself a bit… and make myself happy for once.”

Anastasia kept holding his hand, proud of him for the constant reminder to his new wish.

Tia stared back, and for a moment something connected. Tia’s eyes softened and she gave a genuine somber smile.

Saying nothing, she just brought her head forward and placed it briefly on his. Surprised, Subaru looked towards Anastasia briefly before deciding to just go with the flow.

 

Tia pulled back and turned her somber smile into a bright one, “Su. Once I get my light ball back, let’s go kill all of Lugunica.”

 

 

 

What? What? “What?” “What?” “What?”

Tia kept smiling, “You heard me. We are going to go to that shitty fucking country and turn it into a mass burial ground.”

Subaru was bewildered, “W-wait Tia I don’t think-“

Halibel clapped his hands, “You heard the lady, guess Lugunica’s days are numbered. Shame really. Was nice havin’ four countries while it lasted.”

Subaru stared at Halibel, “Wait no Hal-“

“Wait a second,” Anastasia raised her hand.

“Oh, thank god.”

“I have a list of people who aren’t terrible and are pretty useful, I say we should let those few live and kill the rest,” Anastasia brought out a folded piece of paper, “There might be a few I missed but I’ll check.”

Said list only had names from Anastasia’s camp, two maids from the Emilia camp, Felt and Reinhard, some of Anastasia’s contacts/business partners, and for some reason ‘that one Appa guy and his family.’
Subaru facepalmed, “Goddamnit.”

Anastasia snapped her fingers, “Oh maybe we should also save Crusch and Wilhelm. I’m not super inclined to save them but they could be useful. In addition, we need to somehow convince Reinhard not to stop us. Maybe we can use Felt…”

He now put both hands on his face.

 

“Pfft,” Subaru started laughing, “Bwahahaha! I can’t believe, hahaha!”

The current advocate for Lugunican genocide was genuinely perplexed by her favorite human’s reaction.

Tia put a hand on Subaru’s forehead, “Su are you okay? If it’s about the whole murder plan, we can start it as soon as possible. No waiting necessary.”

That just made Subaru laugh harder.

“Hahahaha! No, it’s just. I’m laughing at the absurdity of this situation. And how, for some reason, I don’t dislike it. Thank you, Tia. I appreciate the joke. To Ana and Hal-san as well, thank you. Talking about this does make me feel a bit lighter.”

Halibel just slapped Subaru on the back, “Course Su-san! How could I just let my favorite drinkin’ buddy suffer in silence? It would be against the ‘bro-code.’”

Subaru just laughed again and began to banter with Halibel as Tia looked on confused.

She turned towards Anastasia, “I don’t understand. I was completely serious. There will be no survivors. I will make sure everyone dies.”

There was no malice there, but Anastasia didn’t need Crusch’s Divine Protection to know she was not lying.

Anastasia just smiled and patted Tia on the shoulder, “I know. Let’s put that aside as a Plan T scenario. We shouldn’t consider wiping an entire country as our first plan of action.”

Joking aside, seeing Tia’s full confidence in wiping out a whole population when she has her light ball gives me a few ideas. Also, definitely finding a way to keep Tia here and recruiting her into my camp.

Day 12:

“Subaru, you need a haircut.”

The aforementioned boy raised his hand to his neck, he felt the hair reach near his shoulders, “It is getting quite long. Halibel? You know any good barbers?”

“Well, I do know this one guy-“

“I can cut it for ya Su,” Tia raised her hand from the floor. She was currently lying down on her back.

“You’ve cut hair before?”

“I’ve cut many things. Hair should be easy.”
“I don’t think that’s a good idea.”

“Too bad. You don’t get a choice,” Tia then immediately lifted Subaru up and put him under her shoulder like a sack of tatoes. Subaru meanwhile was trying to wriggle out of her grip like a worm. Unfortunately, he could not worm his way out of this.

Fortunately, “Tia wait!” Anastasia waved her hand.

Subaru sighed in relief, “Oh thank goodness.”

Unfortunately, he spoke too soon, “Cut his hair so it looks good when its long at the back. It’s a bit messy right now but I think he’d look really good with longer hair, especially when down.”

Tia gave a thumbs up as Subaru looked mortified.

“Betrayal! You’ll rue this day Ana!!” he said as he was dragged away to another room in the house.

“Hehe!” Halibel chuckled, “I’m guessin’ that was on purpose? So, what is it that you wanted to speak to me bout?”

Anastasia looked serious, “The mikos told me Hoshin Trading Company has been looking into us, specifically, looking for any information regarding a certain Natsuki Subaru and women named Anastasia or Natasha.”

Halibel also turned serious, “My network hasn’t picked up any signs of spies near the decoy houses. I’ve also finished spreadin’ rumors of people with variations of Su-san’s name as well as prepared fake identities and records of them bein’ found in those houses all across Banan. I’ve let people know that if anyone starts snoopin’, to inform me immediately.”

Our favorite shinobi has been hard at work the last week preparing for his two wards to stay safe in Banan.

Anastasia nodded at that, “Good. Try to take any spies alive, we need to interrogate them to better understand what’s happening in Lugunica. Also, please make similar fake decoys with my name and with the name Natasha.”

“Sounds good. Now, regardin’ both you and Su-san’s identities, it’s takin’ a bit to finalize. Bureaucracy and all that. Banan’s also been havin’ trouble with a certain company tryin’ to push for specific laws, so all of the government employees have been overworked. Still, after the festival, we should be able to get official identification as well as a license to business soon. Any ideas on what you want for yer last names?”

Anastasia pondered, “No idea, I’ll ask Subaru next time I have the chance. Though just the last names? I thought we were trying to hide all of our identities? Also, what’s the company? What laws are they advocating for?”

Halibel snorted, “Ya can’t hide yerself by using a completely different name. Any competent tracker can tell someone has a fake name, especially since most people can’t react as fast to it compared to their normal name. It’s impossible. So, we’ll keep usin’ Anastasia and Subaru but change yer last names. Hidin’ in plain sight I call it.”

He then continued, “As for the company, they call themselves ‘Fujogeki Company,’ specializing in various trades, especially glintstones. They’re relatively new and are advocating for greater management of spirits within Banan. They believe spirits are becoming dangerous tools of espionage and wish for more laws that limit their usage.”

“…I’ll need to be careful. I doubt they’ll be a problem, but it pays to keep watch of all variables. Maybe I can use the miko network to investigate the company, I doubt the shrines would appreciate their main source of income being heavily controlled by the government.”

Halibel agreed, “I’ll look into things on my end as well. Is there anything else you wished to discuss?”

Anastasia looked pensive, “Yes… I need some advice.”

The wolf grinned, “Oh, Ana-bo has finally come to Uncle Hal for advice. What a wonderful day it is today!”

She glared and swiped at him, “I’m serious, this is important to me.”

Halibel sat down cross-legged, “Well come on, Tia can’t just cut hair all day. I mean she could but Su-san’s head would become a powerful mirror for the sun.”

Anastasia looked around before taking a deep breath, “…What does Subaru think of me?”

Halibel stared at Anastasia.

Anastasia stared back.

“Pfffft!” Halibel started laughing.

“It’s not funny! I’m serious,” Anastasia said as she pouted.

“Ha! Well, I’m laughin’ because that question is easy. He likes ya! A whole lot!”

“Yes, well I know he does but does he like me in that way?”

Od, why is this so hard?! I feel like a teenager. Curse past me for avoiding romance for so long.

“Oh, how precious this is!” Halibel wiped away a fake tear, “Ana-bo is finally maturin’ into a beautiful woman. Now we just gotta wait till your growth spurt hits.”

Anastasia was pissed, “If you’re not going to take this seriously, I’m leaving.”

Halibel raised his hands, “Sorry sorry, I got a little carried away. I’m makin’ fun of ya because ya got nothin’ to worry bout. The number one person Su-san looks at right now, is you.”

Anastasia blushed, “…Is that so? Has he mentioned anyone else?”

Halibel opened his eyes, “Ah, so he has told you bout those other women.”

“You’ve talked to him about them?”

Halibel scoffed, “Of course! Su-san and I are brothers in liquor as they say. Not bound by blood but by the hardest liquid known to man. We have talked about his love life extensively as well as other necessary topics between men.”

“So…what did he say?”

“Nope!”

“What do you mean ‘nope?!’”

“It would be a complete invasion of Su-san’s privacy and a violation of the bro-code to do so. Just as Su-san has never discussed conversations between you two with me, I shall do the same for his. Tis only fair.”

Anastasia sulked but understood the logic.

Looking very vulnerable, Anastasia quietly asked, “Look, I understand if you can’t tell me everything, but is there anything you can offer. I’ll pay. I’ll even try to get more tartar sauces for you.”

Halibel stared at her, sincerely looked at her, and then opened his eyes and smiled, “Ana-bo. Tell me: do you like Su-san?”

She felt weird doing this, but she’s had nearly two weeks to process how she feels. Her conclusion?

 

She likes Subaru.

 

“…Yes.”

“Do you love Su-san?”

“…I don’t know.”

But she doesn’t know if she loves him. Which she is okay with.

“But even if you don’t know, you want to try finding out?”

Anastasia is under the belief that one doesn’t need to be in love before courting. They can figure it out as they go, as long as both sides are honest.

“Yes.”

“And what if he rejects you?”

 

But Anastasia is a merchant foremost, she doesn’t like working with incomplete information and is paranoid to a fault. She knows Subaru likes her, but how much? Would he pick her over the others? His feelings seemed to be mixed, but has that changed? Has he talked about her, and what exactly does he like about her? Does he have a preference for anything? Any specific area or color-

That thought was pushed into the back of her mind and archived for later.

Anyways, she’s had a lot of time to think. And she wants to double, triple, and quadruple check before doing anything.

 

“…I’d respect his decision.”

Even if the idea hurts to think about.

“And what if he doesn’t know, or needs time, or wants to have other girls?”

Despite her usual stance on romantic relationships, that being a non-priority, Anastasia is still a woman.

“…”

A woman who does hold some value in romance. And who does not want to mess up something genuine.

“…”

“I’d do my very best to take him for myself. I’m greedy and I don’t want to share him romantically. I’ll give him every reason to choose me.”

“…And finally, what about your short lifespan?”

Anastasia scoffed, “Same as how I usually deal with it. I’ll make the most of it and spend it happily with him. If he wants.”

Halibel’s smile rose even further, “Then there is no need for any advice. You do not need it. All you need is a little courage, and that I can’t provide. You’ll have to find that yerself.”

Anastasia sighed, “…I know.”

The hardest part is always the first step.

SLAM!

The door slammed open, and both Tia and Subaru walked in and posed. Stupidly.

Tia vibrated with excitement, “So, how does Su look? Handsome? Great? Your answer should be positive, or I’ll cut you.”

Subaru, though posing, was blushing and looked embarrassed.

Halibel clapped, “Well, I’ll be! Our Su-san looks dashin’, doesn’t he Ana-bo?”

“…”

“Ana-bo?” The wolf turned and found himself amused.

Anastasia, a normally logical and cunning linguist, found herself speechless and gawking at her partner in crime.

Subaru’s hair, which used to be long white and messy during his tenure at the prison, has now become a complete mosaic of white and black. No longer a large clump of hair, Tia did cut it well, the top and back were kept a little long while the sides were shorter. His bangs were still slightly long but kept uneven, swept down near his right eye and up near his left, reminiscent of his hairstyle as his most popular feminine persona, albeit shorter and not covering his eye. Finally, because of his longer hair in the back, it was bound into a small ponytail using an orange hairband.

In Anastasia’s opinion? Sometimes, all you need is a good haircut to really draw one’s attention. And the new haircut really did bring out Subaru’s eyes and boyish charm.

Subaru seemed to take Anastasia’s silence as a negative, “Is it that bad?”

Luckily, the girl was still cognizant, she shook her head, “N-no, I mean yes, I mean no. Okay, wait. No, it is not bad. Yes, it looks good.”

Subaru still looked doubtful, “Really?”

She coughed and brought back her composure, walking closer with a slight blush on her face, “Yes. I wouldn’t lie to you, ya know? Wouldn’t be good for business. You look really handsome.”

Stupid. Stupid. Stupid. This isn’t usually this hard. What is wrong with me?!

Now it was Subaru’s turn to blush, “O-oh, thanks…”

Tia looked over at Halibel and motioned with her eyes between the two stars. “Talk went well?”

Halibel chuckled and winked. “They’ll be fine. Ah, young love.”

Day 14:

The day of the Great Rain Festival has arrived. Numerous parties across Banan and Kararagi are converging for one of the most popular festivals in miles.

Stalls, street food, and games litter the streets.

Our stars and their two companions are ready to make their grand opening as a new company. Simultaneously, the pair of individuals who have been watching our stars since the beginning have also decided to execute their plan. Finally, a lone avenger stalks the shadows, finally healed and ready to hunt.

A storm is brewing and all the key elements have arrived.

 

Notes:

EN: I know I mentioned there would be an appearance update this chapter, but I think it will work better as pacing for the next chapter, so expect to see how their new outfits look because everyone gets an upgrade. At the very least, here's Subaru's new hairstyle, a sort of conglomeration of everything he has been through.

EN2: Now, some of Anastasia's feelings talk near the end might be a little OOC. But honestly, Anastasia is a normal woman. She has feelings and just like anyone, no matter how stoic or cold-hearted they are, everyone folds in front of the person they love. Especially before they know for sure it can be reciprocated. I know I have and would.

EN3: We are finally reaching some of the parts of the fic that I've been waiting for. I've seen other authors have similar thoughts, where they write a fic usually for 'this moment.' For me, there are like 5 or 6 of those moments I planned out. One is coming up very soon and I'm extremely excited.

Chapter 11: The Eye of the Storm

Summary:

The Great Festival begins! And so does the final confrontation between our heroes and their relentless enemy...

Notes:

Enjoy the chapter!

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

With the sounds of roaring laughter and bustling crowds echoing throughout Banan, today marks the beginning of the three-day event known as the Great Rain Festival. Food, games, clothing, jewelry, and more flooded the streets. And nearly every person was talking about the exciting new stalls that had arrived.

“Have you seen that new fluffy stall? Looks weird, like little puffs of clouds, but tastes so sweet!”

“I heard there was a poisson fishing game nearby, we should check it out.”

“Oh, they have a Spirit show later in the afternoon! Mikos are showing off today aren’t they?”

“Hey, have you heard the rumors?! Halibel the Admirer is walking around!”

“Are you new or something? He always does that. It’s Halibel.”

“Really? Isn’t he the strongest in Kararagi?”

“We ain’t like those fucks in Lugunica or Vollachia, that shit means somethin’ different here.”

“Oh, well, I heard he keeps talking about this one stall-“

“Wait, Halibel is recommendin’ a stall?!”

“Uh, yeah, why? Is that rare?”

“The guy knows where the best stuff is, he has an eye for it. If he says it’s good, it is good. “He’s the Admirer for a reason. We should check it out. What are they sellin’?”

“Uh, something like- “

 

“Hello and be amazed! Try our brand-new sauces with a new delicacy: French Fries!”

And within this street of bustling busybodies, lies our favorite star duo. The brightest black star was currently posing and yelling proudly in order to entertain the old folks and children passing by. He stood in a black haori adorned with orangish gold stars, a hakama of vertical black and white stripes, and wearing socks and sandals. The hems of the cloth were of the same orangish gold color while the haori himo nestled centerstage was white. His salt and pepper hair was wrapped in a short pony tail in the back while his bangs parted to the right, almost covering his right eye.

“Every customer gets to sample each sauce with their own basket of fries! Each sauce is sold separately but we do offer combo deals! We have limited stocks so buy quickly!”

The pale star of greed was happily using her natural beauty and cuteness to draw any men, young and old, to try and sample their product. She was currently wearing a white kimono adorned with wisps of violet and light blue, each wisp ending in an outline of a star of the same color. Her obi was a dark purple and the obijime wrapping around it was black and orange. Her hair was tied into a side ponytail that was pinned by her usual yellow star and the ribbon with Mimi’s face on it.

“Quite an arrangement of absolute wonders you have here~. Yep yep! These taste great! Ah careful there Miss, don’t want any grease to ruin your beautiful kimono.”

Halibel, our favorite Eternal Playboy, was currently frequenting the local delicacies of other stalls nearby. He was sampling a collection of grilled meat skewers and was drizzling a bottle of tartar sauce on top. Of course, whenever people asked where he got such a sauce, he would always use the opportunity to advertise his current employers. His current wardrobe matched his usual wear, a black kimono with purple accents. However, there were some new additions: white wolves danced across his arms and on his back lay a star, the outline white, being circled with several more white wolves.

Today was a day of celebration.

 

 

Within these streets, a dark avenger stalks the crowds, roaming through the cacophony of external noise and internal bloodlust. Despite her lunacy, she wasn’t exactly mindless. She listens. And she knows that where the mutt leads, his pair of sheep will be nearby. So, she follows the rumors, she follows any whiff of her prey’s stench. And finally finds her target.

There he was.

Smiling.

Right in front of children. Every inch of her mind screaming to tear him asunder.

It would be so easy to kill him. Just one flick of the wrist.

But the voices in her mind warned her. The wolf was near.

She swam through the myriad of people and searched for the guard dog.

There he was. Standing nearby but nowhere close to the abomination.

Laughing and smiling. Without a care of the world.

A sign of weakness.

She turned towards her prey.

So close. Only focus on him. Everything else was background noise.

She inched towards the cultist. His smell rancid. His voice raked her eardrums.

“Ah Ana? Do we have more ketchup?”

15 steps away. Disgusting. His voice sounded so sweet and emotional. A façade. Made for the sole purpose to bait the innocent.

“That fast huh? I guess people really like it here. Hey, are you okay?”

Excitement. Gratitude. Concern. All fake. Nothing from the Witch Cult deserves to live. They took her happiness. Her freedom. Butchered her love and her body.

“I’m just worried because your face is red. Hey, don’t walk away! See! You’re getting more red.”

Hate. She hated him. She hated how he looks at the purple thing. How could such an abomination act as if they are in love? And how could someone return such feelings to a monster?

10 steps.

“What if you get sick? Hey, now you sound like Tia. I might have white hair but I’m not that old!”

Kill. Die. Everything must die. Those words pounded through every cell in her body. No remorse. No limits. The cultist dies and then the rest.

5 steps. She was almost there. She’ll cut off his limbs first. Slowly. Then she’ll douse him in alcohol. Burn him. Make him feel the pain. All the pain she felt. When she suffered.

She lifted her hand-

Clap!

A loud clap rang through the white noise of the crowd. The passersby simply ignored it but Tia-Two could not. The mutt was now standing right in front of the cultist.

Clap!

Another clap. She quickly glanced to where the wolf initially was and saw that there was a second Halibel grinning at her, his hands brought close together in front of him.

She braced for a fight. She was in a crowd but that gave her an advantage. In her murder-addled mind, a few broken eggs were worth a dead cultist. The wind bristled around her-

“Shh, shh! Quiet in the audience, our main performer has arrived,” a third voice of the Admirer sprang from behind her.

Clap!

 

The background noise went silent.

The avenger’s body shuddered.

Every fiber of her being started screaming danger. Every hair bristled.

She quickly looked around and froze in fear.

All of them.

Every single person in the crowd simultaneously stopped.

Silent.

And staring right at her.

 

 

Why is Halibel known as the strongest of Kararagi? Was it because of his natural tendency to compliment others for their quirks? Was it his mastery of stealth and curses? Was it because of his unusual ability to duplicate his form without halving his potential?

Like the other apexes of each country, he exemplifies the greatest and most valued traits of his home. Lugunica values heroism and honor. The Sword Saint will always arrive to save the day and preserve integrity. Vollachia values strength and domination. The Blue Lightning always searches for higher challenges and defies stagnation.  Gusteko values faith and endurance. The Mad Prince always follows his own doctrine and yields to no man nor Spirit.

Kararagi values subterfuge and coin. And the Admirer always walks the crowds of Banan and praises the worthy. He admires and is admired by the people of Kararagi. Unlike the other strongest, he is the one who is the most in touch with his nation’s citizens.

His shinobi skills, his curse magic, his cloning ability. All add to his legend. But his strongest blade lies within his influence. The Sword Saint, the Blue Lightning, and the Mad Prince are all respected. But the Admirer is loved. He is the strongest because with but a word, the people trust him. With but a few favors, stores and businesses bend over backward to assist him. And with only a small request, could a whole street of a festival be given to him.

The strongest of Kararagi needs only clap, and a symphony of rapturous noise, quiets in his presence.

Kararagi values money, and those who can pay for everything without spending a single copper coin, is the most valued one of all.

That is the very apex of Kararagi.

The bright star who walks with his head held high, carrying the history of wolves on his back.

The existence, known as The Admirer.

 

 

“Stand down Dark Tia, or however you call yerself. This isn’t a fight you can win,” The Admirer smoked his kiseru as he motioned towards the circle of Banan citizens.

“…”

The wolf opened his eyes slightly, “Even if you’ve gone insane, ya can sense it. These aren’t normal people. They are all shinobi. Ready to kill you if you move a single muscle.”

The crazed avenger glanced around. Adults, children, the elderly. Despite their appearances, every man and woman had eyes that radiated killing intent. The net they spun was unbreakable. Running would be pointless.

“Oi. Fake bitch.”

Through the crowd of onlookers, walked the Shinigami of Wind. Her eyes held malice, muted, but still ever present and locked onto her thieving double. She wore something similar to her usual outfit though with added features: The lime sphere that swirled under her arms had a green star centered within. In addition, smaller spirals with green stars echoed throughout her outfit, like miniature galaxies.

“Hand over the light ball. And you won’t have to die.”

The avenger grit her teeth, “…”

“Huh? You got shit in your ears? Give the light ball or die. Those are your only options.”

“…Why?”

“Speak up bi-“

“WHY?!”

The avenger screamed and pointed towards the brightest black star who was currently trying his best to stand in front of the pale star, much to the latter’s frustration.

The avenger continued, “Why do you protect him? The monster. He’s fooling you all. A member of the Witch Cult. He must die. All of them must die. You are only protecting filth. He will ruin you. Everyone he is around will die. Die! You will only be able to watch as they die over and over and over again!”

Subaru tensed but Anastasia quickly grabbed his hand. Glancing over he noticed her focusing on him intensely, shaking her head slowly. Subaru gulped and nodded, relaxing slightly.

Tia wasn’t having it, “Su? How lame. He ain’t whatever those bitch cultists are. Just look at him. You can see it in his eyes.”

Tia-Two wasn’t having it either, “Wrong! You sicken me. How dare you?! What happened to your freedom? They butchered us, burned us, and left us for dead. You would chain yourself to such scum?!”

The Shinigami narrowed her eyes, “…Enough.”

“You-“

“Enough!” The wind picked up around them, “How disgusting. How dare you accuse me? You don’t know me. That face isn’t yours. Those powers aren’t yours. And those emotions aren’t yours. My freedom? What about yours? You cling to your grief like a sick dog. Whining and lashing out at everything that even remotely reminds you of your pain. You want revenge but instead of facing it yourself, you run away by hiding behind a mask. Because you’re weak. It’s alright because they are a cultist. It’s alright because I suffered. It’s alright because I am justified. All my atrocities. All of my actions. Everything I have become. It isn’t my fault.”

Tia pointed her hand at the false idol, “You hold no accountability. No responsibility. No gratitude for the opportunities you were given. You spit on the very blessings this life has given you.”

The avenger shook violently, “What blessings?! They took everything. They killed everyone I knew and loved. How can I stand still and let that atrocity pass? How can I face them again?!”

“And what would they think seeing you as you are now? They would barely recognize you. You threw away your greatest blessing: being alive and healthy. All you have accomplished is a pile of bodies with no purpose. Did you even check if they were actually pieces of shit? You haven’t even gone after one of their bosses. Not a single dead Archbishop. You’ve had months with the light ball. Months of your life wasted with not a single step towards progress. You should be rewarded with death.”

The avenger tensed, “…”

But Tia did something unexpected, she sighed, “…However, I will give you an opportunity. Give me the light ball. And I’ll promise to help rend that shitty Cult asunder. You have my word.”

Tia-Two was skeptical and confused, “…”

“You may not believe me. I would not believe me. But. I promised someone important to me that I would try. Try to listen and think from other’s points of view. And despite it all, I can at least understand. The rage. Not just anyone could resonate with the light ball. So even I can sympathize with you. So, I’ll give you one last chance, give back what you stole. And walk away.”

The false Tia looked towards the offer given to her. Underneath the mire of bloodlust, a part of her wanted to take it. The part of her that was just a scared oni, wanting her old life back, that was so cruelly taken away. Questions began to spring up: why did she do this? What was her plan? Did she even check to see if these people were innocent or not? She sacrificed so much, what was this all for? These questions began to clear the swamp of her mind. But as she started to mentally comply, she took a breath, and the stench filled her airways.

Turning her head toward the brightest star of another world, she found her answer to those questions:

Oh right, him.

No matter the cost.

All of them have to die.

Die.

DIE.

DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE. DIE.

The swamp within her mind returned.

The last vestige of the oni died.

And all that remained, was hate.

The avenger sprang towards the two stars. The wind blowing wildly around her. A horn starting to glow on her forehead. Ready to end their very existence. There was no more reasoning left, only animalistic rage.

And within that brief second, hundreds of kunai pierced her body, several blades of wind sliced her limbs, and three clones of Halibel slammed her ruined body to the ground.

The winds sweeping towards the stars bounced harmlessly off an invisible barrier, a barrier of wind Tia put up before the confrontation.

There was never a chance of a fight. This was either a negotiation or an execution.

Tia walked over towards her double, she glanced over at the stars, “Sorry Su. I tried.”

Subaru just nodded and gazed at the slowly dying avenger, bleeding and suffering from the myriad of killing curses perforating her body, “…I’m sorry. I wish you could have had another ending. What was your name?”

“…” The dying phantom only glared as Tia began to recover the light ball.

“…I just want to know, so you won’t be forgotten,” he said as he gripped his partner’s hand.

“…Zarestia,” the phantom spat.

Tia narrowed her eyes and sighed once more, “Even to the end, you hide behind my image. I guess that was your choice. The mask you chose to wear to the grave.”

She plucked the light ball from her copy’s body. The connection fractured, the fake Tia’s body began to crack and twist. Returning to origin. Until finally revealing a simple brown-haired girl.

A victim, whose name will be forgotten along with their tragedy.

 

 

Anastasia gazed at the corpse solemnly. I can’t say I’m sad about this ending. Yeah, her situation was a tragedy. But everyone experiences tragedy. It was either her or us. Even if we convinced her to lay down her arms, would she not try to kill Subaru again? I don’t know. Even if there was a small chance, I couldn’t risk that. If not now, she would have died eventually. So, I’m not sorry. Because this was how your story was going to end anyway. Put down like a rabid dog.

She then turned her head towards Subaru, he looked in pain. His pain brought her pain.

Why do you care so much? She tried to kill you. You deserve the right to be angry. To feel relieved. Why do you look so sad?

Anastasia’s unoccupied hand start to grip her kimono.

Those bastards. What have they done to you that makes you so forgiving? Was this the only way you could live? I hate it. I hate it so much.

 

But I can’t help but love that part of you. Your kindness.

She squeezed his hand to get his attention, knocking him out of his stupor, and simply gave him a small smile, “Are you okay?”

His eyes widened and he gave a small smile in return, “Yeah. I am. It’s finally over. We’re alive. And safe.”

Well, not exactly over yet. We have one last thing to take care of.

Anastasia looked over towards Tia who was now channeling the gem, the light ball, in her hand. The winds start spinning around her. Caressing Tia’s very body. As if welcoming her back.

Until finally.

 

 

Anastasia couldn’t breathe. For a whole few seconds, she felt her very body tremble. She expected this. Halibel and her had discussed this many times over the last week. Talking about it is one thing, but experiencing it?

Her malice, her rage, her purpose. Even without the maelstrom currently forming around her, the storm clouds forming above, and the winds knocking objects around nearby, all of it pales before the utter bloodlust emanating from Tia.

No, not Tia.

The Slasher.

The Reaper.

The Great Spirit of Wind.

Zarestia: The Most Beautiful Shinigami

 

The bloodlust was causing everyone to shudder and fall to their knees. Everyone except Halibel and Subaru. Anastasia was barely hanging onto Subaru’s hand.

…Halibel I understand, but Subaru? What the hell did you experience?

Subaru bent down to help Anastasia up. Grateful, Anastasia patted him gratefully before letting him walk forward towards the eye of the storm.

The winds were howling, stalls were starting to fly upward, shinobi were trying their best to brace but some were knocked unconscious.

It was a storm worthy of the Great Rain Festival.

“Tia,” Subaru said softly.

Despite the noise, Zarestia was able to hear clearly, “Su,” she said with fondness.

She was smiling.

But her eyes were no longer a muted light. They were now a brilliant aurora of death. And it was barely being held back.

Zarestia kept smiling, “I’m sorry Su. I’m sure Ana and Hal have told you already. But let me introduce myself again. I am Zarestia. The Great Spirit of Wind and Murder.”

Subaru gave a look of concern, “…Are you okay?”

“I’m more than oh-kay Su. I’m finally complete. I’m finally free.”

Subaru started to step forward, “Then why do you look so-“

Zarestia raised a hand, “Stop. Please. Su it’s time to face reality. I need to leave. Don’t think I don’t know why Hal brought all of these people here. We didn’t need this many to take her down. They were for me. In case I decided to kill you all.”

Subaru flinched, “But that doesn’t mean you have to leave! You haven’t killed anyone. You don’t have to do this, we can figure something out.”

Zarestia chuckled, “I always liked that part of you Su. You shine so brightly. Despite everything. Such a dreamer you are. But the dream has ended. It’s been fun but I still want to kill. I can’t help it. I want to keep my freedom. But I also want you safe. So, I’m going to have both by leaving. It’s for the best.”

“Su, remember what I told you before: embrace it and don’t be a fool,” as Zarestia finished she glanced toward Anastasia before refocusing on Subaru.

She then gave him her brightest smile, “Thank you for everything, I’ll always remember you. I’ll even remember the purple thing and the mutt.”

Subaru looked heartbroken.

Meanwhile, Anastasia was doing what she always did best, working to find an angle to play off of. And for once, she found a way to get one over the Spirit. However, it might require an incredibly risky gamble.

Anastasia stepped forward but suddenly felt Subaru hold her back, she turned her head to see a very afraid Subaru. He shook his head vigorously.

In any other situation, I’d tease him, but I need him to trust me and let me handle this. He’s done his part, now it’s my turn.

She simply smiled and gave him a resolute gaze. He looked like he was weighing his options heavily. Before letting her finally move forward on her own. Subaru stepped back but kept fidgeting his hand in his pocket with anxiety.

Anastasia approached Zarestia who had already turned away and began to drift towards the sky, “That all you goin’ to say to your friend? My my~, I feel so sad that you didn’t say a word to me.”

Zarestia flinched, she didn’t turn around but she did stop her momentum, “What is there left to say Ana?”

“Goodbye? Sorry for leavin’ so suddenly? Maybe an explanation why yer runnin’ away like a coward?”

As Anastasia said those last words, Zarestia started vibrating, the bloodlust oozing out of her was increasing slightly.

“…I’m not running.”

“Really? Because it seems like ya are. Tell me if this sounds familiar: ya lost yer light ball. And durin’ your search for said light ball, you found somethin’ new. Somethin’ just as precious as yer light ball. And now you don’t know what to do. You want to keep this but now that you got yer old thing back, yer afraid of destroyin’ what you have now.”

Zarestia was violently shaking, the air felt dense with malice, Anastasia could barely breathe again but she needed to keep up the pressure.

“That’s not-“

“Stop lyin’ to yerself. I know yer type. Passionate, free-spirited, and always speakin’ their mind. But also completely hypocritical. Ya speak all this shit of doin’ what ya want and beratin’ others for hesitatin’. But the second you reach the same situation, ya freeze. Ya don’t know how to resolve yer different desires, cuz you know they can’t coincide. So instead of facin’ such problems headfirst, or compromisin’, ya run away because ya never learned how to fix yer shit. Because all of your problems could be solved by slicing it to death. Ya wanted to be free, so ya never had to change yer ways. How funny. Yer wish to be free is cripplin’ ya from actually bein’ free-“

“SHUT THE FUCK UP!”

SLASH!

A huge blade of wind brushed past Anastasia and hit the wall of a house. Thankfully no one was injured. She glanced back and saw how pale Subaru looked, he was holding a knife firmly in one hand. She thought it must have been for self-defense. She gave him a thumbs up from behind her back. It only slightly calmed the boy down.

Anastasia refocused on the now utterly furious murder Spirit and took a deep breath.

Just like before. Gamble. Watch. Listen. And be honest. She’s like Subaru. I need to be emotional.

Anastasia was about to speak but Zarestia cut her off, thankfully without a wind blade, “What do you know about me?! Do you think I want this? To leave behind happiness? Yes. I was happy. I’ll admit it. I am lame. The last few weeks have been the happiest I’ve felt in eons. I had so much fun. But what could I do?! I am a walking disaster. I could kill Su without thinking. I could kill you just by sneezing. I can’t control it. It is in my very nature to kill. I want to kill. So let me kill. And let me keep you all safe.”

Zarestia was crying, “I’m a Great Spirit. I can’t coexist with you. I can’t hide who I am. This is me. The Tia you knew? She was a mask. A mask I used to enjoy my time here. But now I don’t need to use the mask. That Tia is no longer needed. I’m Zarestia. And that is all I’ll ever be. I’m the one who burned down a whole country because I assumed they would love me and praise me for it. I’m the one who butchered the world when they decided to cut me apart and roast me for my sins! And I’m the one, who still wants to be around people, to have them cherish me…”

Zarestia, with tears running down her face, glared at the merchant, “So yeah, I’m a hypocrite. Despite all the shit I said to you and that fake bitch, I’m here doing the same thing. I pussyfoot around and don’t face my problems. I lash out and make all my problems everyone else’s! But what else am I supposed to do? I can’t have everything. It’s just not possible. I can’t be so cruel to risk your freedom too…”

Anastasia looked pensive before deciding her plan of action, “…You know, now that I’m on the other side of this, I think I understand what you were saying before. This is much better. Your real face. Hypocritical, selfish, kind of narcissistic,”

Zarestia sniffed, “Oh, wow, thanks.”

Anastasia ignored her, “Idiotic, childish, and blunt. Honestly, yeah you are lame. Just like I was. And you know what I realized since our conversation?”

Zarestia raised her eyebrow, “That you’re an annoying bitch?”

Anastasia ignored her again, “That you were both right and wrong. I should be more honest with myself. Especially regarding things I care about a lot.”

Anastasia looked back towards Subaru, before refocusing on Zarestia, “But also, these masks I wear: they aren’t fake. They’re necessary. They’re parts of me. How I was able to cope with the world and all of its cruelty. Without them I’d still be that kid raging against the world, probably left dead in an alley. The masks I use may differ from who I was initially, but that doesn’t mean they were lies. They were parts of myself I used so I can be happy. My emotional self helped me connect to Subaru. My merchant self helped me excel in business. And my childish self helped me survive my adoptive mother.”

Zarestia stared at the girl, “…”

Anastasia continued, “I looked into the history of Kararagi. The records were sparse, but I was able to connect the dots. There was a period of time way in the past, where the land was wreathed in fire. Afterwards, the already desolate land was pelted by rain. An unnatural amount of rain. So much rain, that eventually the almost unfarmable land became very fertile over the years. This fertility allowed Hoshin and the original founders to settle here and build the many city-states. Strangely enough, a rainstorm would always fall throughout Kararagi around the exact same time every year, especially around Banan. It’s why the Great Rain Festival came into being, as thanks for the seasonal rain that gave our country life. Am I wrong to assume, that was you?”

Zarestia said nothing but the storm clouds that swarmed above were the only answer Anastasia needed.

Anastasia’s eyes softened, “Despite how murderous you may act, you are capable of so much more. The rain, resisting to kill me and the others, hell even just having those feelings. You are not just a killer. You’ve grown beyond that. Or at the very least, you always have been.”

“…So what? It doesn’t change the fact that I can’t live with you all. How can I when every part of my body wants to eviscerate you out of existence?”

“You’re acting like you have to reject one part of yourself to let the other live. Or that coexistence cannot occur between two conflicting beings. Look at me and Subaru, we’re practically opposites in personality but our values coalign, and we are able to be together despite our conflicts. Your two selves still have the same values: freedom, being true to yourself, and caring for others. You can be both Tia and Zarestia. Sometimes you can be Tia, hanging around us and having fun. Sometimes you can be Zarestia, killing whoever you want.”

Zarestia looked down, thinking, before looking back towards her friend, “And what if it all goes wrong? What if the people I want to kill, end up being you and the rest?”

Anastasia rose her eyebrow, “Then that’s the risk we’ll take. Don’t get me wrong, I’m doing this for the benefit of keeping you around. Having a powerful Spirit has its perks. And hey, I’m already going to die in ten years, if I cared about living a peaceful life, I would have never tried to become the queen of my own country. And if you’re worried about the others? Halibel is Halibel and I’m eighty percent sure Subaru has experienced worse kinds of people as friends. So, let’s just do whatever and see how it goes.”

Anastasia extended her hand, “Let’s try this one more time. I’m Anastasia, you can call me Ana.”

The winds around them started to calm and settle. The storm raging above, finally still.

The Spirit looked toward the hand and smiled nostalgically, “Zarestia, but you can call me Tia,” she then finally took Anastasia’s hand and grasped it warmly.

 

Subaru walked up with Halibel, still a little pale but looking very happy, “So, does that mean you’ll stay?”

Tia looked toward her favorite human and smiled, “Yeah, I think I will Su. I might leave sometimes if I feel my bloodlust build. But I’m going to try. I’m going to be whoever I want. And who I want to be right now, is the kind of person who can stay with you guys as long as possible.”

Tia then snorted, “Besides, I still haven’t seen you and Ana mate yet. Can’t leave before that happens.”

Anastasia face palmed, “And you ruined the moment, I forgot how much I hate you. Is it still possible for you to leave?”

“Nope,” Tia popped the P, “You all are stuck with me now.”

Halibel laughed, “Like a terrible STD.”

Tia swiped at the wolf as Subaru walked up to Anastasia, putting his hand back into hers.

He smiled, “You did amazing back there! Still, I was afraid the worst was about to happen…”

Anastasia rubbed his hand and gave him a cheeky smirk, “What can I say? I got a lot of practice negotiating with emotional disasters.”

Subaru narrowed his eyes and pinched her nose, “You’re lucky you’re cute.”

Anastasia frowned but then quickly giggled, “Oh such wonderful flattery~. Please do continue.”

“Super smart! Incredible! Totally not flat-“

Subaru dodged a swipe from Anastasia as he laughed, “Gotta be quicker than that, you don’t have that much weight holding you back.”

She started pinching his cheeks, “Little shit, so help me-“

“Ah Su,” Tia interrupted after giving up on hitting Halibel, “I almost forgot. Would you like to make a contract with me?”

Subaru froze but Anastasia didn’t, “It’s not a bad idea Subaru. Tia is one of the strongest Spirits. And now that she got her gem back, it should be possible. You won’t get a better contract than this.”

Subaru looked hesitant. He focused his eyes and took a wide look around until focusing on a certain spot. After staring for a few seconds, he sighed.

He then looked towards Tia, resolute, “…Yeah. Let’s do it.”

Tia smiled, “You won’t regret this Su,” she reached out her hand in order to initiate the ritual.

Subaru waited for a few seconds, before stepping forward and extending his hand out as well.

He was almost about to grasp-

“STOP, IN FACT!!”

Suddenly a figure darted in between Subaru and Tia, with their hands in the air, interrupting the contract ceremony.

It was a little girl, in a pink dress, with frazzled blonde haired tied into spiraling pigtails. Her eyes looked sullen and tired.

“Please… please stop. Betty…Betty is sorry, I suppose,” the girl looked on the verge of tears.

However, the merchant wasn’t focusing on the girl. Sure, she looked distinct. But what was most striking, was the fox fur scarf tied around her neck.

Anastasia’s eyes widened.

Echidna?!
