Chapter 15: Interlude: Theater

Summary:

Welcome to the web of entropy, where our pale star finds herself in an odd place...

Notes:

Sorry for the wait, this took way longer than I had hoped, hope you enjoy it!

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

Welcome back to the web of entropy. In some cases, the possibilities of reality can create interesting scenarios. Imagine a scenario where one’s innermost secrets were laid bare for all to see. Imagine that scenario reveals all of the horrors and pitfalls you have faced that no one could ever truly understand. And imagine in that scenario, you finally feel the satisfaction of being truly known. As well as the horror of being known too well. In reality, being seen by those you love for who you truly are could bring about the worst despair imaginable.

 

So let us take a glimpse at this scenario, this Theater of Despair.

 

 

The lights flickered on throughout the theater, revealing many of the tired but hopeful faces of the various royal candidates and their camps.

“Anastasia-sama?”

The mauve-haired merchant was knocked out of her stupor by her faithful knight. They had recently finished the last viewing of a certain self-proclaimed knight’s life during his stay in Lugunica. Needless to say, it was both an enlightening and horrifying experience.

“…I’m fine Julius, nothin’ to worry about,” she said with a smile.

She clutched her scarf. Well, it’s not totally a lie. On the one hand, we really have nothing to worry about, as long as Natsuki-kun is our ally. On the other hand, I can’t help but think about what could happen if Natsuki ever went rogue. Still, paranoia aside, there are some glaring issues we’ll have to contend with once we leave this place.

She glanced over at her various rivals and their allies.

First, was the Priscilla camp. Priscilla was currently kicking the shit out of her jester while Schultz tried to placate the drunk mess of an Astrea. I doubt she will stay still. If there’s one thing I learned about her since staying here, it’s that Ms. Prissy-and-always-Pissy won’t be dissuaded from doing what she wants. She’s not dumb. She’ll be figuring out a way to incorporate Natsuki into her camp some way or the other. Just like me. The problem is she might just take him by force. And I’d rather not deal with a very wary time traveler when negotiating.

 

Next, was the Felt camp. Felt was also kicking the shit out of her Knight, except with less effectiveness. She may be allied with Emilia but that might be worse than actively vying for the boy. Given that Natsuki is more connected to both of them than the rest of us, he’ll likely try to push things into their favor subconsciously. Sure, he might not actively screw us over, but he will prioritize. I don’t blame the boy, none of us really helped him out, but it means this selection will never be in our favor.

 

Her eyes wandered to the Crusch camp, they seemed to be busy discussing something, most likely plans for after they leave. Despite the revelations and turbulence, they look like they were doing better than before. Ideally, having Crusch back with her memories is a boon to the nation. Pragmatically? We just got back one of our greatest rivals. Before this, it wouldn’t be arrogant to say that I or Ms. Pissy were in the lead, which is funny considering we’re both foreigners. Now though, Crusch will probably retake the lead, and given her relationship with Emilia and Natsuki, she will have a major advantage. And that’s not even considering her possibly blooming feelings, if she somehow convinces the boy to have a polycule, then her win is even more certain.

 

Finally, she looked towards the Emilia camp. The last viewing ended on a high note, so they all looked rather hopeful, despite the baggy eyes and tear marks.  

…I don’t know what to think of these people. It feels like they are a barely functioning camp all things considered. The fact that they were basically in-fighting and torturing a boy literally one year ago is a prime example of that. The clown needs to either die or be removed from the equation. He may have been pacified, but what if he somehow gets out of his restraints? Not taking any chances. The pink maid does not get a pass. I don’t care. She basically allowed her master to commit several atrocities due to some fucked up love. If she wants to die with her master, then she’s going too. Which would mean the blue maid would also be a problem. A little ball of rage and self-esteem issues won’t take kindly to her sister getting targeted. But then Subaru will definitely object. Ugh, this might get complicated.

Anastasia sighed internally.

She stifled the grimace of several memories shooting through her mind. She pushed down the part of her that felt like a hypocrite. She was not going down memory lane. Not now.

She started eyeing the rest, starting with her rival merchant. I may have to reorient my opinion on Suwen. He may not be the best merchant but he is definitely a crafty individual. The Sanctuary win may not have been possible without Suwen acting as Natsuki’s confidant. The tiger boy has potential; the fact he was able to defeat the Bowel Hunter singlehandedly cements that. He’s a little reckless, but a little mentoring and experience will fix that right up. Perhaps if the right situation comes up, stealing both of them wouldn’t be a bad idea. The maids also, their reactions definitely seem like their loyalty to the clown is gone. The spirit is a package deal with Natsuki, so no point if I can’t win him over. However, none of this matters given who their leader is.

 

She lingered onto the half-elf candidate, eyes narrowly squinting. Can’t say my opinion of her has improved much. Sure, her backstory was absolutely awful. And yeah, I can understand why she is so naïve now. But does that really absolve her? No. Given her reactions, she never even questioned Natsuki-kun’s abilities, origin, or even any of his mental instability. Seriously, one fucking year. How?! Either Natsuki is that good at hiding his information, or someone isn’t asking the right questions, if at all. If I had some weirdo come from nowhere and basically singlehandedly solve all of my problems, I’d know everything about him by the end of the first week!

Anastasia pinched her nose. Calm down. No point in being so frustrated. There’s no point given Natsuki loves the girl. It means I’ll have to settle for being an allied camp. I have to forge friendly relationships, not enemies. Maybe I can still coax some information out of him for a business or two.

She now looked around her own camp. The Triplets were talking with Ricardo about exploring Priestella and seeing if they could drag Subaru with them. Julius looked pensive. Anastasia gathered that he must be thinking of how to properly talk to Subaru once this is over.

She glanced back towards Emilia, where Subaru was resting between her and Crusch. Anastasia’s feelings for the boy were a mix of fondness, genuine admiration, fear, and pity. She didn’t hold romantic feelings for the boy; they weren’t close enough to elicit that kind of emotion. However, she did feel positive about him, anyone would when they see how selfless he was. It also made her fearful, he seemed willing to do anything to push forward towards his goals, who’s to say that one day his morals would be tested. What would make him snap? Anastasia did not want to think of the implications.

 

After a few minutes of processing all of her thoughts, she finally came to a conclusion: she needs to fully mend the bridge between her camp and Subaru. Even though he was a very forgiving person, it wouldn’t be right to let any lingering resentment remain, especially between her knight and him.

Anastasia clapped her hands gaining her family’s attention, “Alright, I’m thinkin’ we should prioritize gettin’ a meetin’ with Natsuki-kun once we get back to Priestella.”

Julius flinched, “…Would you like me to apologize to him directly?”
You don’t have to look so guilty, I doubt the boy actually hates you that much. He literally forgave someone who tortured him.

“I won’t force ya to, and it isn’t somethin’ he’d probably accept out of thin air. I think it would be better if ya focused on gettin’ to know him better,” she motioned to Otto and Garfiel with her shoulder, “Be like them. If you can get along with them, I think gettin’ along with Natsuki shouldn’t be too hard.”

Julius looked doubtful but he still smiled, “As you wish, my lady.”

“Mimi wants to take Mini-Boss through Priestella!”

Anastasia chuckled, “I heard y’alls conversation, after a brief meeting with everyone, you can take him out and have some fun.”

Ricardo grinned as the triplets started planning an excursion, “Ya don’t want to go with Ana-bo?”

Anastasia shrugged and smiled, “We barely know each other, besides, his last impression of me wasn’t exactly positive. We’ll build a relationship slow. Baby steps.”

“Ya sure?” The wolfman pointed a thumb at the three ladies surrounding Subaru, “Ya might lose to them if ya take too long.”

Julius choked as Anastasia rolled her eyes, “Oh please. I may be interested but I’m not exactly smitten with him. Besides, he has two girls vyin’ for his heart and a third rarin’ to go as well, I ain’t gettin’ involved in that.”

Ricardo snorted, “That why you tried holdin’ his hand during the last few days?”

She kept her composure, “I mean, since all the others were doin’ it, can’t a gal try it out for herself?”

“Gahaha! You ain’t wrong, Ana-bo. Though I think pissin’ off the other misses, ain’t worth the effort.”

Julius held his fist up with fierce determination, “Do not worry my lady, if need be, I will put my life on the line to make sure you are safe while you court Subaru.”

Anastasia chuckled.

She looked at Julius and flinched.

He was dead serious. The man was willing to kill if it meant protecting his lady’s love life.

“Julius, I’m not in love with the boy. No need to cause a political incident.”

Julius nodded, “Then in case you ever are, just know I stand firm.”

Julius. Sometimes I wonder if you’re in love with the guy given how passionate you get when he is involved. Still, it is an interesting scenario. Would I ever fall in love with the boy? Highly doubtful given our characters but hey, interesting nonetheless-

THUD!

All of the camps’ discussions were interrupted by a sudden noise and an impromptu visitor. Looking towards the end of the theater, right next to the large screen, there was a very familiar mauve-haired individual. Moaning in pain and dazed, it was another Anastasia Hoshin but dressed very differently compared to usual. She was wearing a Kararagi style white kimono with an odd pattern of violet, light blue, and stars. Her hair was woven into a side-ponytail, pinned with her usual yellow star and a ribbon with Mimi’s face on it.

 

All of Anastasia’s camp looked at the double. Then they turned towards their candidate. Then back towards the second Anastasia. And then back towards their candidate once again.

 

“Uh.” “Is that-“ “Another Lady Boss?” “Two Ana-bo’s?” “What sorcery is this?!”

By this point all of the theater was looking at the second Anastasia with incredible confusion, making their point known by yelling.

“Hey what the fuck?!” “Hmm, a second fox?” “Umm, is anyone else seeing another Anastasia-san.” “Tis is some weird shit, did the theater guy drug us?” “Warden, what is the meaning of this?!”

 

Crusch’s last request for information silenced the room but gained no response.

He has been awfully quiet ever since the viewing ended.

The Anastasia in the theater shook her head. No wait, that’s not important, we need to figure out what’s going on here? Why is another me here? And why is she wearing Kararagi clothing? Wait, I don’t own a kimono set like that… is she from the future?

Anastasia connected the dots. They were supposed to go buy some clothes later in Priestella and she knows they sell Kararagi goods there. Unless she was an imposter, this version of her must be from when they returned home!

But something gripped her mind tightly. Did something happen in Priestella for her to be dragged in here?

“Ugh my head, where am I? Subaru? Where are you? Are you okay?”

The first merchant froze. Wait, Subaru? Why did I… no, did I really?

The first Anastasia’s mind started to race. Why did her double just call for Subaru? Were they together when she got abducted? Why were they together? They weren’t close enough for that. Actually, wait, why did she call him by his first name? How close did they get?!

A few others in the crowd of people also caught the odd words of the double. A certain clown, grey advisor, green duchess, and little maid had keen perception, and all had their own questions.

However, one knight acted. The Finest Knight got his lady’s attention. He motioned with his eyes toward the double and back towards her.

”Would you allow me to… check on her?” Is what he nonverbally said.

By this point, Anastasia was 50/50 on whether this a future her or some deranged trap. Her curiosity got the better of her.

Anastasia nodded.

Julius took action immediately, getting up from his seat and striding down the steps toward his lady’s duplicate.

He arrived in front of her and knelt down, “My lady, is that you?”

The second Anastasia still looked dazed, blinking constantly as if she was trying to wipe away a fog, “…Julius?”

Alright, that points more towards her being ‘another me.’ A real version of me. Still, it doesn’t indicate why she is here.

Julius felt more assured now, “Yes, my lady, it is I. Are you alright?” He held out a hand in front of her.

By this point, it looked like Anastasia-two was starting to clear her vision as she looked startled to see Julius in front of her, “Y-you remember me?”

Wait what? Did Julius lose his memories? Like Crusch…

Julius didn’t immediately connect the dots and only cocked his head in confusion, “…Is there a reason I shouldn’t?”

 

Silence reigned for a few seconds before being broken by the second Anastasia’s melancholic laughter, “Oh I see what’s going on here. It’s one of those dreams again.”

Julius raised an eyebrow, “My lady- “

“No, no. It’s fine Julius. I’m fine,” she waved her hand in the air as her eyes looked on the brink of tears, “I guess. I thought life was going so well recently that I wouldn’t need one of these again. But I guess I was wrong. I still miss you guys.”

“…What do you mean by that?” Julius looked like he was about to have a panic attack.

Which was being shared by literally everyone in the Anastasia camp. Many were already deeply affected by the events in the theater, so they assumed the worst.

 

The second Anastasia ignored him and took his hand, “Well, let’s not keep everyone waiting. I can’t wait to see Mimi again, she’ll probably be asking about what we will be doing today. Then Tivey will tell her to calm down or something that will make her mad. She’ll hit Tivey with her rod and then Hetaro will try to calm both of them down. I’m sure Ricardo will be laughing the whole time.”

No. No please.

The second merchant looked down towards the floor, as tear drops fell, “A-and I’ll laugh and try to get everyone’s attention. I’ll deliver our tasks for the day. And we’ll skip to lunch or maybe even a shopping trip. And it will be all six us and maybe even Joshua, talking and laughing like always. And things will be just like normal. Just the same as it used to be.”

They died. They died in the future and I was the only one who survived. Did his checkpoint update? Or maybe. Maybe he couldn’t save us… or didn’t even want to.

 

“M-my l-lady,” Julius looked like he was going break down any moment.

Anastasia giggled softly, “I can’t tell you how much I missed that. It’s always the little things. I’ve noticed that a lot nowadays. It’s the little details we tend to miss and cherish the most. You really don’t know it until it’s gone.”

At this point, the triplets were crying while Ricardo was trying to calm them down, Anastasia was trying her best to think.

Another Archbishop? Or maybe the Black Serpent was unleashed? Or could it be that we were assassinated? Did Natsuki kill us? No, it sounded like I was on good terms with him. Then, what caused this event to happen? I need to know.

Julius was going through a similar process, his mind raced as he started to realize this might be a future version of his lady, “…Anastasia-sama. Please tell me what happened.”

“Ha. I guess this is the dream where you try to save me and it all still ends up the same.”

Julius’s heart broke, “P-please. I need to know. Even if you think it will go the same, I assure you, I will make sure this never happens.”

Good work Julius. There’s a chance she is only a temporary visitor. The Warden hasn’t said anything. Maybe we’ll be sent back soon or she will? A mistake in the system? I don’t care. We need to get information before she disappears!

But Anastasia-Two had other ideas, “…Hey, do you know a person named Natsuki Subaru?”

Julius’s eyes widened, “W-what do you mean by that? Of course I do, he is the knight of the Emilia Camp?”

Anastasia-Two chuckled, “Right… I guess you would say that here. Since he told me. Anyway, that’s not important. Do you want to hear something funny? I think I’ve finally fallen in love.”

 

Julius choked. Anastasia choked. The Triplets choked. Ricardo choked. Almost everyone in that theater choked.

W-wait, wait, wait! WHAT?!

Julius sputtered, “W-what-“

Anastasia-Two laughed again, “I know how that sounds. Anastasia Hoshin, a greedy girl who would rather get one more coin than waste any time courting. But it happened. I fell in love. A part of me tried fighting it given the circumstances. But honestly? I can’t say I hate it. That warm feeling I get when I see him at peace, when my heart skips a beat as I see him smile, the joy I feel whenever we talk: it’s immeasurable. Ha. I don’t even think any currency in the world nor any business opportunity could measure up. It’s quite crazy coming from me.”

“Anastasia-sama…” Julius’s eyes softened. While the possibility that they were in imminent danger still weighed on his mind, hearing his candidate talking like a maiden-in-love truly pulled his romantic heartstrings.

And he wasn’t alone. Several people in the audience were of a similar mindset, especially those in the merchant’s camp. A certain half-elf, a blue-haired oni, and a Valkyrie: all could relate.

…I wonder who was able to crack my heart open. He must be pretty high quality for me to act like that.

 

“I miss you guys. So much. Everyday I wonder what could have been if I didn’t look for you guys on that day. And yet, I can’t help but feel guilty at times.”

“…Why would you feel guilty, my lady?”

Anastasia-Two looked up, smiling with a hint of melancholy, “Because what happened led me to him. If it weren’t for what happened in Priestella, we wouldn’t have probably ever gotten as close. And I feel guilty because some days I wish I could just lay in his arms instead of working to reunite with you guys. And I hate that. Because I want to be with you guys too.”

The mood shifted, a weight was lifted.

Alright, that’s good. So, they aren’t dead. But, we got separated?

Julius looked relieved as he gazed at his candidate, sympathetically, “My lady, while I do not understand the circumstances, I don’t think any of us would ever blame you for prioritizing your happiness.”

“…My happiness is my camp.”

The knight chuckled, “And it seems he is your happiness as well. Maybe even one of the greatest happinesses to happen to you. We’ll always be here. Waiting. But this is something new. Something many don’t experience quite so often. Is it so wrong to want to embrace it fully?”

What Julius said struck a chord in a certain Sword Demon. He looked like he was reminiscing on his own love and felt a kinship with the merchant that he never felt before. He wanted to say something, but his candidate laid a hand on his shoulder and shook her head. It wasn’t his time now. She needed something more personal.

 

“He’s right Ana-bo. We’ll always be here. But love? That comes and goes if you don’t try to claim it. All of us want you to be happy. And if that means waitin’ a bit more? Hell, I’m already old, a little more can’t hurt,” Ricardo said as he marched next to Julius.

Anastasia already gave the go ahead, deciding that ‘while information would be nice,’ she had a feeling this version of her needed this. It’ll be her good deed for the day, as a certain boy would say.

Huh, I guess you could call this some self-love for myself… I’ll make sure what happens to you doesn’t happen to me. But I’ll need ya to tell me about this guy we fell in love with: I’m getting more and more interested about who he is.

“Mimi can wait,” the little kitten girl ran up and hugged the second Anastasia’s left side, “Mimi thinks it would be fun if Boss Lady got married!”

Tivey sighed as he walked up next to his sister, “Anastasia-sama isn’t going to get married that quickly Mimi. They haven’t met us yet which means they just started to court.”

Anastasia-Two blushed as Mimi bonked her sibling on the head, “You never know! Look at Boss Lady, she’s so in love, she’ll definitely get married as soon as possible!”

Anastasia felt herself feel both amusement and cringe hearing all of this. It was one thing to have someone talk about your love life in front of you. It was another thing to see another you experience it. Like a synesthesia between clones.

Except its mostly second-hand embarrassment.

She could hear some of the barely audible snickers from the audience. Anastasia will remember who they are.

Hetaro thankfully came into save the day, “Mimi, please stop embarrassing our lady like that, she looks like a tometo.”

Anastasia-Two still looking embarrassed, started to hug her family, “…Thanks guys. I really wanted to hear this.”

Ricardo looked at his pseudo-daughter with warmth, “Of course, Ana-bo. We’ll always be here for you.”

The Triplets all crowded around and hugged their Boss Lady. Julius, deciding to forgo knightly etiquette, joined the warm hug as well.

To Anastasia-Two? This meant so much to her that none of them could understand.

For a very brief moment, she felt like she got her family back. Instead of the nightmares she usually got.

 

Julius chuckled, “I’m very curious to meet this person you mentioned. He seems to have swept you off your feet.”

Anastasia-Two was still blushing hard, “W-well, if what he says is true, technically you guys already did meet him.”

Wait, what?! Who?

Everyone froze.

Many were now trying to speculate who exactly they knew that might be Anastasia’s fated lover.

All except for a certain clown who started smiling widely, as if he had a very funny theory he expected would be confirmed soon, something that a certain pink-haired maid suspected from her knowledge of his reactions.

Julius rubbed his chin before his eyes widened, “It couldn’t be?”

He stared at the second Anastasia, “Otto-san?”

Anastasia-Two’s face morphed into the most disgusted expression he had ever seen, “Absolutely not. Never. In a million years.”

Otto, who was listening to all of this with immense concentration, felt his ego get eviscerated. He didn’t like the merchant either, but did she really have to say it like that?!

Garfiel looked like he was trying his hardest not to die laughing. He settled on silently punching his brother with increased amusement. Otto was not amused. And tried ineffectually punching him back.

 

Julius kept speculating, “… Russel Fellow?”

“Julius, he’s married.”

“Kiritaka?”

“…Julius, are you trying to piss me off?!”

Bad guesses Julius, zero marks. Besides, Kiritaka likes girls like Liliana. I don’t look like her at all.

 

For some reason, the sleeping Subaru lightly snorted.

 

Julius looked sheepish, “Apologies my lady, there’s not many people I could see who may fit with your personality.”

Anastasia-Two sighed, “That’s fair. I mean, I’ll be honest, he and my personalities are complete opposites. So, you would have never guessed right.”

Opposite personalities? Who do I know that…has…? Wait.

Ricardo scratched his chin, “Opposite personalities ay? The only one I can think of is the Mini-Boss.”

Anastasia froze. No. It can’t be.

Anastasia-Two raised an eyebrow, “Who’s Mini-Boss?”

Tivey now raised an eyebrow, “You don’t remember Anastasia-sama? We started calling him that back when we hunted the whale and Sloth together.”

How? What? When? No, wait, really?!

Julius started connecting the dots, his face morphed into shock, “…Anastasia-sama. Are you in love with Natsuki Subaru?”

Anastasia-Two’s eyes widened as she blushed and looked down, “…I guess I am.”

 

A pin dropped. Every person’s face morphed into some sort of bewilderment. Except the clown. Who was smiling with his eyes closed.

 

Oh.

Fuck.

“What the fuck, really?!” The voice exclaiming profanity came from our favorite little lion, Felt. Which was not much of a surprise.

Reinhard was currently smiling at how weird his friend’s love life would become in the future, not saying a word.

“Bro really is collecting them like Pokémon… I wonder if he’ll catch the princess next, somehow.” said a helmet-wearing jester.

Who was kicked in the head into the nearby wall by Priscilla, “Quiet jester. I do not like your insinuation that I would be ‘caught’ so easily.”

Heinkel was currently having his hands in his head, “…Does the fucker just get more women to even out the amount of shit he deals with?”

Schultz was starstruck, “Wow, it’s just like those stories where the hero has a ton of noble women wanting to court him!”

Heinkel turned his head towards the little child, “Schultz. You shouldn’t be reading those. He is not a role model for you.”

The drunken Astrea then had a thought, “Fuck. Actually, none of us are good role models for you. How is it that the batshit insane suicidal fuckup is not even the worst?!”

The worst Astrea felt like he needed a heavy drink right now.

The second worst Astrea chuckled, “Subaru-dono. You have already stolen my Lady’s heart, as well as two others, surely this is too much for you to handle?”

Felix laughed as well, “Come on old man Wil, Subaru-kyun’s heart is too big, of course he can.”

Crusch was pinching her nose, “I should have known. It seemed so unlikely, yet here we are. Subaru-dono, what am I going to do with you?”

Otto looked absolutely flabbergasted, “He actually did it… he’s going to seduce the whole Selection at this point.”

Despite that, the grey-haired advisor felt immense pride in his brother for his prowess at picking up women.

The feeling was mutual in his other brother, who was much more vocal about his pride, “The Captain has done it again! Mine amazin’ self wants to be just like him!”

Frederica elbowed her brother, “Garfiel! Behave, that isn’t something you should copy.”

Petra looked absolutely decimated, “Anastasia-sama too…?”

The pink-haired oni was irritated, “Barusu. You already have my sister and Emilia-sama’s heart. And Crusch-sama’s somehow. You truly are the enemy of all women.”

The clown patted his maid’s shoulder, “Now, now, I doubt Subaru will prioritize her over his first loves.”

Ram sneered, “Barusu should still keep it in his pants, he should be giving all of his love to my lovely sister, instead of random bimbos.”

Emilia was pinching the sleeping Subaru’s cheek, “Subaruuuu~,” she said while pouting, “Was Rem, Crusch, and I not enough for you?”

Rem smiled but also pinched Subaru’s cheek, “Any woman would fall in love with Subaru-kun once they got to know him. Though Rem’s hero should calm down before he gets spread too thin.”

Anastasia, the original, was currently having a mental breakdown.

Me.

She turned towards the boy in question.

And him?

She then looked down at her feet.

Together?

She brought her hands to her head.

HOW?!

Sure, he isn’t bad looking. And sure, he has incredible qualities, very selfless and kind-hearted. And sure, RBD is incredibly powerful. But that doesn’t mean I would fall in love with him that easily?! And look at me. LOOK AT ME! How do I look like that when I talk about him?

Anastasia-Two now finally noticed the people who had been sitting in the background all of this time.

“That’s. Different. I don’t think my last dream had this many people. Either I subconsciously really miss everybody or this is like that nightmare where I end up naked in front of everybody. Or that one dream where everybody else was naked…”

Shut up, shut up, shut up! Stop talking right now. It was already too much that you’re talking like that, but now you are saying stuff you shouldn’t be saying. Oh my Od, I should have just not allowed this dream idea to keep going.

Thankfully, Julius Juukuulius understands tact and quickly tried clearing the air, first by clearing his throat, “Apologies Anastasia-sama, there’s been a misunderstanding. This is not a dream.”

Anastasia-Two looked at Julius and laughed, “Ha. Right. This is not a dream. Which is why you guys are here and not in Lugunica. Or why everyone from the Royal Selection is also here. And why you all recognize me. And why there is a second me in the crowd. Hey, even Subaru is there, sleeping. Though he looks kind of different. Not the weirdest thing I ever saw in my dream. At least Subaru isn’t covered in mayo and naked this time-“

“STOP!” Anastasia-One had enough she started sprinting down the stairs, embarrassment be damned, “I think that is quite enough. I believe we should prevent any further complications from arisin’.”

“…What was that about Big Bro being naked?”

The little lion was prevented from speaking further as Anastasia-One gave a polite and smiling death glare right at her.

She decided it wasn’t worth it.

Anastasia-One went up to meet her double, trying her best to hide both their expressions by standing right in front of her, whispering, “This isn’t a dream. You were taken to a place that allows us to see Natsuki-kun’s life in Lugunica. Stop revealing information that should be never told to anyone.”

Anastasia-Two looked at her double, confused, “This is a really weird way for my dream to tell me something about my subconscious. I think I remember Subaru saying dreams reveal a lot about our innermost fears or something. Maybe this represents how I hate having my secrets being shown to people. Or maybe my emotions are so connected to my family that normally I would hate showing it to others out of a sense of paranoia-“

“Would you please turn down your voice?!” Anastasia-One whisper yelled, “Before you say something you regret later. This isn’t a dream.”

Anastasia-Two snorted, “Okay, well then if this isn’t a dream, I’m sure if I slap myself, I won’t feel a thing-“

SLAP!

Anastasia-One beat her to it by slapping her immediately.

“Anastasia-sama!” Julius looked dismayed at his candidate committing self-harm. Technically.

“Julius it’s either this or I die by embarrassment, and a little pain is worth not experiencing that again.”

Anastasia-Two grabbed her swollen cheek, “Ow! That hurt! Wait. That. Hurt?”

She looked down, neurons firing rapidly, her eyes widened. She slowly raised her head and stared at her past self, “This isn’t a dream.”

“No.”

“You all are real.”

“Yes.”

“And I just said all of that. In front of everyone.”

“…Yes.”

 

 

Anastasia-Two got up into Anastasia-One’s face, angrily whispering, “WHY THE FUCK DID YOU NOT TELL ME?!”

Anastasia-One got pissed as well, whispering back, “I did!”

“I meant earlier! You could have told me before I started having an emotional breakdown in front of our knight?!”

“I didn’t want to interrupt; you looked like you needed this!”

“Yeah, but not in front of all of these people!” She pointed at them before realizing, “Wait, so what is all of this, who are you people? Where is this? And why am I here?”

She looked at her camp, becoming slightly morose, “…And you guys aren’t ‘my camp,’ aren’t you?”

The whole camp looked at her with warmth and concern, Ricardo decided to talk, “Sorry Ana-bo. I don’t think we are. We came here way before you did. Right around when we entered Priestella, we got abducted by the guy who owns this place.”

“Wait, Priestella?” Anastasia-Two’s eyes widened, “You all are from the past?!”

Anastasia-One’s eyebrow was raised, “Does that mean you are from the future? When did you come from?”

“…Around four months after the Battle of Priestella.”

Everyone locked onto that statement. A battle. Right where they were about to head towards.

Julius had a serious expression, “Anastasia-sama, it is important you tell us what has happened in your future so that we can be prepared.”

“I can help with that.”

They were startled by a sudden voice echoing through the chamber. It wasn’t the Warden. The voice was garbled and barely discernable from either male or female. But it was loud, and it resonated through their Ods.

“Ah, I must apologize, this is quite difficult to control. I only just started understanding how this theater works and it is quite fascinating. It uses a combination of different spells, Yin and Yang especially, and other magic all in tandem in order to allow this theater to properly work and provide all of the necessities for survival. I must say, the Warden’s magic is very interesting, it is nothing like anything I’ve seen before. Well, that wouldn’t be quite correct. I have seen many theaters like this. Too many.”

No one could recognize the voice, except a clown who felt like it was somewhat familiar, but he couldn’t quite recall who it reminded him of.

Crusch cut in, “What have you done to the previous Warden? Who are you?”

“Hm? Oh, him? He’s currently busy with other duties. I took over once I realized this theater would be unoccupied. As for who I am, well, it wouldn’t be fun if I just told you immediately, now would it? You’ll have to stay in the dark about my identity until the time is right. As for what you can call me in the meantime: Nuwa sounds lovely.”

Anastasia-Two looked towards the origin of the voice, the screen in front of everyone, “Why did you bring me here? I doubt it was to have me reunite with my camp.”

“Well, I would say that is an unintended bonus. My intention was to grab both of you: you and your little lover. Unfortunately, my lack of experience has enabled me to only teleport one of you here. But, as he often says, ‘we will roll with the punches.’ So let me speed this along, as I am unsure to how long I can keep you here.”

CLAP!

A loud clap echoed throughout the chamber, everyone’s eardrums shook.

“Ah, apologies, once again, this is my first time. Now, let me introduce you to our little star today, someone you are familiar with: Anastasia Hoshin. However, she comes from the near future. A future where she lost her name to Gluttony and was sent adrift, with no one to help her. However, she ended up running into our other lost star, Natsuki Subaru. And thus began their story of reclamation.”

 

Crusch and Rem started gripping their seats at the mention of Gluttony. It seems the Archbishop was continuing to be a menace, something they’ll have to rectify when they return.

All of Anastasia’s camp turned towards Anastasia-Two, with eyes of concern and shock. Anastasia-One just stared, “…We lost everything, didn’t we?”

Anastasia-Two stared back, very tired, “…Yeah. Nobody could remember us. Well, nobody until we met Subaru.”

 

The sounds of gears started twisting and turning as the screen flickered to life. Brief flashes of different images rushed past.

“Wait,” Emilia gripped her knight’s hand, “You said Subaru was a ‘lost star.’ Did he… lose his name too?”

Almost everyone in the theater started to tense.

The voice snapped, “Don’t rush me. All will be revealed, so just watch as the story unfolds.”

The screen began to flicker different images, too fast to catch anything specific. As it did, Julius led his two ladies back to their seats along with the rest of their camp. The Anastasias decided to sit right next to each other, both being surrounded by the rest.

Many in the audience awaited what would be in store for them.

4

Some, like the Emilia Camp, worried for the fate of their knight. They already saw how he suffered just from the losses he acquired from constant time loops. How would he be able to handle Gluttony? The thought sent shivers down their spines.

3

Those, like the Crusch Camp and the Felt Camp, thought of the ramifications. They already saw Subaru constantly betrayed by those around him. How would they react to the boy without any of their prior history?

2

Those, like the Priscilla Camp, were more interested in how the boy would be able to outmaneuver this latest challenge. Would he be able to win despite all odds again? Or has his luck run out?

1

And those of the Anastasia Camp? Most were a mix of concern, fear, and curiosity. Their candidate found love but at the cost of losing her name. The idea that Anastasia was suffering in the future laid heavily on their minds. They wanted to know more, to be better prepared for what’s to come.

 

The screen finally flickered to life. At first, darkness covered the screen, until suddenly an unfamiliar ceiling burst into view, coupled with the slow blinks of whoever’s POV they were witnessing.

I don’t know that ceiling.

The crowd knew. It was Subaru’s voice echoing his thoughts from the screen.

This bed feels softer than I thought. And the pillow- wait what’s touching my hair?!

Subaru’s eyes looked a bit more up and choked. Anastasia Hoshin was looking down on him, eyes entranced in deep thoughts. The screen now showed Subaru, laying his head on Anastasia’s lap, in an unfamiliar bedroom.

…Is Anastasia giving me a lap pillow?!

Everyone choked.

“Oh, Anastasia-sama…” “My, my, he really woooooorks faaaaaaast.” “Bro really likes his lap pillows.”

Anastasia-One turned her head slowly at her double, “…Explain.”

Anastasia-Two had her head between her hands, “Do I have to?”

One kept whispering, “When did this happen?!”

“…Like a day after I met him.”

“…You’re kidding me.”

“No.”

Anastasia-One face palmed. Did he seduce me in less than a day?! How?! Just look at him-

 

Why does he look like that?

Gaunt and sunken cheeks, eyes slightly dark, white hair, small scars on his face here and there.

Anastasia had a thought that was mirrored by many others. Especially by two people.

“Anastasia-san?” It was the half-elf princess’s voice that permeated through the air, “Why does Subaru look like that? What happened to him?”

Her voice was a mix of concern and desperation, as if thinking of the worst possibilities already, which reflected off the sheer fear on her face.

Anastasia-Two was silent, simply looking more tired than ever. She glanced at her double, then quickly at the duchess, and back to Emilia.

“…Subaru went through a lot after he lost his name.”

“…”

“…”

“…Could you please tell us more?”

“No, I don’t want to.”

Emilia was slightly shocked, “But- “

Anastasia-Two held up her hand, her double noticed a slight twinge of animosity hidden beneath her now iron-clad face, “It isn’t my place to say. Subaru isn’t here and I won’t talk about what he went through without him.”

Two briefly gazed at the younger Subaru’s comatose body, before finishing, “He deserves at least that much.”

The Emilia camp looked antsy, Garfiel briefly started to get up but his brother grabbed him and shook his head, the ex-merchant analyzing Anastasia-Two. Beatrice was about ready to fly over. They all looked like they wanted to interrogate the future Anastasia, out of concern for their knight.

Julius and Ricardo silenced any more questions, “If my lady does not wish to speak, it is her right.” “I know ya’ll are worried, but we barely seen anythin’, maybe we don’t need to have Ana-bo explain everythin’ yet.”

Eventually, everyone settled in their seats, all with various thoughts running in their heads, all heading toward the same conclusion that Subaru experienced untold horrors after the loss of his name.

Anastasia-One’s thoughts were more specific. Subaru lost his name, he looks like he went through something hellish. Most likely, given how often he encounters them, it was the Witch Cult-

However, they were interrupted by a soft poking from her side, where her double sat. At first the merchant was about to question the sudden prodding, until she noticed a pattern. It was a code she would use sometimes to send secret messages.

Torture. Betrayal.

…Again. It happened again. How? How the hell does one guy keep facing these types of situations?!

Her eyes widened, as they subtly gazed at her double. The older Anastasia simply nodded and returned her gaze to the screen. Trying to keep her composure, the younger merchant’s stomach began to fester. She had so many questions, but she understood her older counterpart’s intentions. Information is precious. And whatever her older version knew, leaking info nonchalantly could lead to chaos.

“…Anastasia?” Subaru tried to get Anastasia’s attention, but the merchant simply narrowed her eyes, still thinking.

Wonder what she’s thinking. Maybe I can help.

“Oi, Anastasia?” The merchant kept ignoring him her eyes kept shifting.

Wow she really can’t hear me. I’ve never seen her this focused-OW!

Anastasia was currently messing with Subaru’s hair, what started as a nice feeling quickly turned into a tug of war with his head.

“Ow, hey, be gentle with my hair. GENTLE!”

The merchant still wasn’t responding. In fact, her hands were now frantically swishing his hair everywhere.

“Are you even listening to me?!”

Okay, she is definitely spiraling, I need to knock her out of it.

He brought his hand up to her face, prepared his fingers and:

FLICK

With a snap, Subaru flicked Anastasia’s nose to bring her out of her stupor.

If you can’t tell, Julius’s jaw just dropped.

The merchant shook her head, “OW! You ass, what was that for?!”

“Given that you were about to turn my luscious locks into a barren field, I feel that was appropriate.”

She quickly looked down and saw that Subaru’s hair now looked like it was pulled and clumped into neat little pockets, looking like a chaotic mess.

She looked sideways, “Sorry… sometimes I get a little lost in my head.”

Aww, even Anastasia gets embarrassed. It’s kind of cute.

Anastasia-Two was currently blushing internally, trying her very best not to embarrass herself further.

“Hey, it’s okay. I have the same habit,” he grinned cheekily, “Besides, not everyday I get to wake up in a lap pillow.”

It was hard to see but Anastasia’s face was blushing. She turned her head back towards Subaru, gave him a light push from the side, and shoved him off the bed.

Hard.

“Ow! Damn it! What was that for?!”

Never mind. Not cute at all.

“Given you were being a little shit, you deserved it. Come on, get ready, we got to get some food before we head out.”

“Yes ma’am.”

Many people had questions. Some were faster than others:

“…So when should I expect grandkids?” Ricardo asked.

Both Anastasias glared at him as he laughed.

Julius was rubbing his head, “…Flicked the nose of a Dragon Candidate. Even if it’s him, he really should know better.”

Everyone in the theater erupted, “Honestly, it’s weird seeing her like this…” “It’s kind of cute.” “Subaru-kun looks awful, what happened to him.” “But what about Big Bro?! He looks like shit.” “I understand Felt-sama, but it’s not something we can force.” “Betty’s Subaru…”

As everyone discussed amongst themselves, Mimi whispered to Anastasia-Two, “Hey, so, what got you interested in the Mini-Boss. He’s awesome! But other Lady-Boss doesn’t like him like that. So, what gives? Is that why you gave him a lap pillow?”

Anastasia-Two coughed, “T-the lap pillow was more for Subaru’s sake then me. As for why I’m interested in him…it’s a lot of things. Small things. But I guess the biggest reason would be how kind he is.”

The younger merchant raised an eyebrow, “Kind? That doesn’t seem like something we would consider attractive.”

The older merchant looked at her like she was stupid, gesturing towards Ricardo with her head. “Remember our first crush?”

Anastasia-One waved her hand in the air, “Fair enough. But we were young. There must be something else.”

Anastasia-Two rolled her eyes, “Just watch, you’ll understand what I mean.”

Subaru quickly put on a mask with a purple scar and a black coat and walked downstairs with Anastasia. They made their way to the ground floor, in time to order one of the breakfast sets: Subaru getting a scrambled eggs and tatoes platter while Anastasia got a cup of coff and a pastry.

“Why’s Big Bro wearing that weird costume?” Felt turned her head towards the kimono-wearing Anastasia.

Many were thinking the same question.

“…Not my place,” she replied, to the frustration of many.

Subaru looked at Anastasia’s plate and frowned, “That’s all you’re going to eat?”

“I’m not that hungry. Besides, I don’t need much food to work,” Anastasia said as she waved her hand in the air.

“Well, you won’t grow big and strong with that attitu-OW!”

Anastasia pinched Subaru’s hand, “I’m 23, you child.”

“Hey, I’m 18! At least I look like an adult.”

“Barely and you certainly don’t act like one.”

“Hey, I’ll have you know my boyish charm is one of my best attractive traits.”

Anastasia scoffs, “And who are you attracting? Sex deviants.”

Subaru quickly replies, “Hey I’m not the one who looks like a legal loli.”

Julius choked. Anastasia-One looked over at her double like she was crazy for falling for someone who called her a loli.

Anastasia-Two looked at her double like she was stupid because they are the same fucking person.

Ricardo and the Triplets laughed, “Ya both really play off each other well. Maybe we should have got the Mini-boss in our camp.”

The Emilia camp heard that and immediately crowded around their unconscious knight.

“What does that even mean?!”

Someone coughed near them.

They both looked to the side to see the waitress standing with their food, while wearing an expression that screamed customer-approved politeness.

“Would the young couple like to eat their breakfast outside?”

They both glanced at each other and gulped.

“Sorry, ma’am.” “We’ll be more quiet.”

“Fantastic! Now would you guys like anything else? Oh! We have the new sauce everyone’s been raving about: mayonnaise.”

“Yes! Absolutely!” Anastasia was startled by Subaru’s sudden excitement.

“What’s got you so excited, it’s just a new sauce that’s trending?”

“Hey, I’ll have you know this is liquid gold. It goes with everything and makes all dishes 200% better.” He said as he squirted an inhumane amount of stuff onto his eggs and tatoes.

Everyone chuckled and grimaced in horror at the absolute mountain of mayonnaise he was spilling on his meal.

“Subaru-kun really did like his mayonnaise, thank goodness we were able to make it here.”

Anastasia-One caught that, “Wait you made- “

Anastasia-Two grabbed her, shaking her head slowly, “Keep watching.”

The younger Anastasia narrowed her eyes but her older counterpart just kept motioning her to shut up and watch the show.

Anastasia visibly grimaced in disgust, “Urgh, you sure?”

Quickly taking a bite, “Mmmm! Delicious!”

Man I missed this!

Anastasia took a sip of her coffee. She then started to frown.

Subaru noticed this, Oh no she’s got that look again.

“You good?”

“Hm?”

“You looked like you were about to contemplate the meaning of life again.”

“Ha. Ha.”

“Well, you won’t find the number 42 with that attitude.”

Everyone, except the new Anastasia, looked at Beatrice for an explanation.

Despite her worries for her contractor, she still looked prideful as people wanted to know what he meant by that, “It means- “

“It’s a reference to a book that Subaru read where a bunch of people asked a super smart metia about the meaning of life and it blurted out the answer as ‘42.’”

Now everyone turned their heads towards Anastasia-Two, who was looking at her nails idly.

Beatrice was shocked, “H-how do you know that?!”

The pale star shrugged, “I asked him when we were traveling. I asked him a lot of things actually.”

Rem chimed in, “Wait, where are you and Subaru-kun traveling? It doesn’t seem like Subaru-kun would just leave without-”

Anastasia-Two looked at the blue maid, not recognizing her at first, her eyes then widening, “You’re that maid he always talked about.”

Not expecting that, Rem blushed, “S-subaru-kun talks about me?”

The older Anastasia gave a polite smile, “Of course he has. He’s told me many stories about you.”

She avoided the questions. I don’t know how long she can keep this up, I doubt the others will let her keep doing this. I’m curious myself: what happened to him that made him decide to travel with me? And why does the future me look like she’s waiting for something…

A certain clown, advisor, and Duchess were noting Anastasia’s evasiveness, watching for a way to get the merchant to fess up.

Most of the other audience were curious how close the future Subaru and Anastasia got; however, it seems this Anastasia was not inclined to answer their questions easily.

Still, if I know myself, and I do, I’m probably loving the fact that I have so much information and can lord it over everyone.

Beatrice pouted in her seat.

“What does that mean-“Her question was cut off by a spoonful of eggs, tatoes, and a generous helping of mayo being shoved in her face.

“Here, you need brain food with all that thinking you’re doing.”

She frowned, “I’ll pass.”

“Come on, unless widdle ole Ana can’t stand a widdle mayo~?”

Julius grimaced, “…Subaru, please.”

Her frown deepened but just as she opened her mouth to retort, he shoved the spooned into her mouth.

It was not Julius’s day, “Subaru! That is not knightly behavior!!”

Anastasia-Two waved Julius down, “It’s alright Julius. Besides, the food tasted great.”

Julius looked at his older candidate with disbelief with how nonchalant she was about his rude behavior. Anastasia-One was also looking at her counterpart, wondering how her future self was acting.

“Hey!” she said as her mouth was stuffed with food, before realizing, “That’s actually not that bad.”

“See?”

Anastasia-One was still bewildered. She also thought she needed to try mayo later in Priestella. Maybe with daisukiyaki.

“Right? It’s my favorite. Thank god, Rem helped me make this stuff back then.”

“Wait, what did you just say?

“Hm? It’s my favorite?” He replied as Subaru was dividing his dish in half.

“No after that.”

He lifted another spoonful of grub to her face.

She looked at him.

He looked at her.

Seconds passed.

He motions with his hand towards the spoon.

She motions back with her hand with a confused expression.

Subaru simply shrugs in response. Anastasia pinches her nose.

She then goes in for another bite.

“That was cute,” Ricardo looked towards his two daughter-figures, “Ya guys do that often?”

The older Anastasia nodded, “We eat together all the time. And we do this kind of stuff all the time.”

Some of the girls in the audience seethed with jealousy.

The younger Anastasia eyed her counterpart, noticing a slight smirk and her eyes dancing with happiness, and rolled her eyes.

She is definitely enjoying this.

“Yeah so, Rem helped me make mayo because we couldn’t find it anywhere here.”

“Wait so you’re telling me YOU invented a new condiment?!”

He lifted another spoonful. She stared at it. She then begrudgingly took another bite.

“Well technically I didn’t invent it. It came from my home, and I just sort of copied it. Plus, even then, Rem did most of the work to figure out what ingredients were needed.”

Rem looked happy at the praise, “Subaru-kun should take more credit.”

Ram just patted her sister on the shoulder, “Barusu is giving you rightful praise, you did do most of the work, you should take your own advice.”

Rem sheepishly chose not to reply.

“Why didn’t you tell me this before?!”

“It wasn’t something important to bring up!”

“I STRONGLY FEEL BEING AN INNOVATOR IS A WORTHWHILE THING TO BRING UP!”

“IT’S BEEN ONE DAY!”

“Already fightin’ like a married couple too~,” both Anastasias started punching and kicking the old wolf demi-human.

SLAM! The waitress from before slammed a couple of plates on the counter while glaring at them with a smile that was slowly becoming more brittle.

Both of them sheepishly gave her a smile before getting back to the conversation.

“Okay this actually solves one of my issues,” Anastasia whispers.

Subaru raises the spoon once more before asking, “Was it what you were thinking about in the room?”

She mindlessly took a bite before continuing, “Yes. We need a product to sell consistently once we get to Kararagi. Something new to corner the market. That way we can get the attention of any investors and accelerate building a trading company.”

…

The Emilia camp looked over at the second Anastasia. Otto was the first to speak, “Anastasia-sama. Why are you taking Natsuki-san to Kararagi to build a new company?”

“…Save your questions for later, if what we are seeing is as I remember it, there is a bit more we need to see before I’ll talk. Don’t push me, I can just stay quiet, I don’t have to speak.”

The rival camp looked frustrated, but they knew they couldn’t force her. Try as they might, despite the change in ownership, they were unable to conjure magic. Most likely the previous restrictions were still in effect.

 

“Wow. You really have been planning stuff thoroughly. Have I ever mentioned how impressed I am by your diligence?

Another breakfast shipment on the Subaru express down Anastasia’s gullet.

“Nope, you really should sing my praises more often though.”

“Fantastic! Smartest gal of our generation! Breaking news: greediest merchant alive makes billions! Stay tuned for more!”

“Thank you, thank you, hold your applause,” she replied dryly.

They both stared at each other before breaking into snickering.

“Oh, that was honestly adorable,” Frederica muttered. While the maid was loyal to Emilia and her fellow maid, she couldn’t help but see that Subaru did get along quite well with Anastasia, just one-on-one. It really made her romantic heart flourish.

The original Anastasia was getting more and more intrigued, I really got comfortable with him fast. Normally, I would never act this way unless I really knew them well…maybe I should have talked to Natsuki earlier.

“Oh, going back to that mayo business, how much were you able to make from selling the recipe?”

Subaru froze.

“Because given how popular it became, I’m sure people were scrambling for a chance to distribute it. Depending on where you stored the gold, maybe we can find a way to sneak some out for a bit more extra savings or investment money.”

Subaru started sweating.

“Though given that your name was forgotten, it might be more trouble than its worth. Where did you keep your savings Subaru?”

“…”

“Subaru?”

“So, here’s the thing…I may have given out the recipe for free.”

 

 

“YOU DID WHAT?!!!” “YOU DID WHAT?!!!”

The original Anastasia stood up and screamed right as her older self on the screen did.

Anastasia-Two simply smiled, as if waiting for this to happen.

“How did you all just let him give out that condiment for free?!”

Everyone in the Emilia Camp froze under the accusation, it seemed unimportant at the time.

“Weeelllll,” Roswaal chose to defend his wards, “I did offer to help Subaru properly patent and commercialize his invention buuuuuuut he said he didn’t need the money and decided to give it to the people of Arlem. They must have spreaaaaad it afterwards.”

Anastasia-One face palmed and angrily started to mutter to herself while sitting back down.

The second Anastasia simply patted her counterpart on the shoulder in mutual understanding.

…I was right, no, more than right. They’ve been wasting his potential this whole time.

“So, you’re telling me. You were somehow able to recreate an inventionnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnn-

 

The screen froze.

“Huh. That wasn’t supposed to happen. Let me try to figure out what is wrong.”

Many in the audience were confused. The only time the screen had glitched was during the White Whale incident, so some were tense with fear that a similar occurrence was about to repeat.

A few took advantage of the pause.

Otto stood up with Garfiel, Emilia, and Rem. He approached the older Anastasia, “Anastasia-san, I understand you must have your reasons for secrecy. But please understand us as well, we are only worried about our friend. So could you answer my previous question: Why are you taking Natsuki-san to Kararagi?”

The woman kept up her facial façade, “When we lost our names, we had nothing. So, if we wanted to survive, we had to start somewhere new.”

Emilia wasn’t satisfied by that, “…Why did Subaru not come to us when he lost his name?”

That somehow set off the older Anastasia, “You don’t think he did? Think for yourself for once.”

“Hey, don’t act like-“ “Garfiel, sit down, I won’t have you threaten my Lady-“ “Garf, Julius, calm down, let’s all be reasonable.” “There’s nothing to talk about, if Boss Lady doesn’t want to, she doesn’t have to-“ “Subaru-kun’s safety is a priority, she can’t just-“ “You have no right to say that- “ “Don’t speak to Ram’s sister like that –“

Anastasia-Two looked away from the ensuing argument, but Anastasia grabbed her close, “What is the matter with you? We wouldn’t get so emotional about this usually. What happened to him? I thought you had a plan but now you’re acting irrational.”

Anastasia-One glared at first, before quickly calming herself, “You would react the same if you knew what I knew.”

“What do you mean by that-“

The screen flickered to life.

“Shit! How long until we get to the village?”

The screen showed Subaru running through a forest with Anastasia, it was night time.

“…Still…Far…We…Have…A…Long way to go,” she said, gasping and coughing. She fell on the ground.

“Anastasia!” Subaru stopped and helped her up, “We need to rest. Or let me carry you!”

Anastasia looked battered and bruised, her dress torn and barely held together. She had a black eye and several scratches all over her body.

“What happened?” Anastasia-One said, horrified.

“…What is this?” Anastasia-Two was confused, “I don’t remember this…”

“Wait, you don’t?”

“I-I don’t, this, what is this? We never ran through a forest-“

“Shit this must be a loop,” muttered the younger Anastasia.

“…What did you just say?”

The screen was still playing in the background.

“…Subaru, if we both go in the same direction, we’ll die. Let’s split up. There’s a chance one of us can make it.”

Subaru shook his head violently, “I’m not leaving you! You’re too slow, you’re more likely to get caught.”

“Subaru, be reasonable!” Anastasia yelled, glaring, “This is the end of the road, our partnership is over. You don’t have to worry about me, and I don’t have to worry about you.”

He glared back, “That isn’t important! Anyway, we can’t argue about this right now. We need to keep moving or- URGH!”

Time seemed to slow, a close up of Subaru’s face showed, blood trickled down his head. The camera zoomed out, showing Subaru’s head skewered by an arrow. His body started to collapse to the forest floor.

“NO!”

“NO! Why are you showing us this? What kind of fucked up message are you trying to convey?!” The older Anastasia wanted to get answer from Nuwa but heard nothing. She looked around but was shocked by the audience. They looked…desensitized. Not exactly horrified but like they were at a funeral. After going to millions of them.

She stared at her younger counterpart, who was watching the screen intently while rubbing her scarf, not even batting an eye at Subaru getting killed, “…”

“Please… no.”

“…Why?”

The pale star approached the merchant, “Why are you looking at this like this is normal? What is wrong with you?! Especially you, isn’t he your knight?!” She screamed as she pointed directly at the Emilia camp.

Emilia winced but chose to look away and seek comfort from her knight’s hand.

“Wake up. Please.”

The merchant gave the pale star a tired look, “…Just keep watching. You’ll understand.”

“This isn’t-“

“Anastasia-sama. Please. I know this must be confusing but you will only understand if you watch,” Julius stopped her and begged her to calm down.

“…I’m sorry.”

The pale star looked at her old camp and saw familiar faces. But they all looked different. As if they had seen horrors unimaginable. They looked similar to undertakers who toured battlefields looking for unidentified corpses, so they can bury them.

Subaru’s eyes started to fade. But not before hearing one last sound.

“I shouldn’t have-URGH!”

The thunk of an arrow hitting its mark.

 

“ARGH!”

Suddenly, Subaru was now back on the front seat of a carriage, gasping in pain and hunched over.

“Subaru! What’s wrong?” Anastasia leaned over to check on Subaru.

No, Ana! Wait, no. I returned. I’m back. I need to-

Thunk! Thunk! Thunk!

Three arrows pierced. One for each earth dragon.

Subaru turned his head.

Anastasia lay next to him, her eye pierced by the arrow.

…No.

Memories flashed across the screen. Of him hearing Anastasia’s last words before he died.

The thunk of the arrow.

No.

Screaming.

Screaming for the pain to stop.

NONONONONONO!

Screaming for everyone to save him.

Why does this keep happening?!

Visions of Rem dying, Emilia dying, everyone dying.

It now showed him, back in the carriage. Looking at Anastasia’s body. His eyes widened, his heartbeat drumming his ears, body tensing. Just like his memories, he screamed. A loud, angry howl of pain

And the screen turned black.

The pale star was in a similar state. Entranced by the screen. She looked like she was about to vomit.

The younger Anastasia was about to console her older self, when the screen flickered and change again.

“DIE! DIE! DIE!!!”

“Run! That fucker’s psycho! Get back to the camp!”

The screen now showed a bloody and heavily injured Subaru among a pile of four corpses, all mangled with tons of injuries and damage. A broken bow and several swords and a whip laid on the floor. Bandits were running away.

He was breathing heavily.

Shit, they’re too far away for me to switch. I need to-

“…Su…bar…u.”

His eyes widened, he ran over to the carriage as fast as possible.

“Anastasia!”

No response, “…”

“Anastasia, please, can you hear me?”

“…”

He put his fingers on her throat. Anastasia was still alive. Still breathing.

Her heartbeat is too slow but she’s alive! Oh, thank God she’s alive! Wait. No. Her eye. I can’t pull it out. She needs medical attention. But where-the village! It’s the closest. We’re too far from the capital. I need to rush her to the village. We need to get away from here too, the bandits.

The boy picked up the injured Anastasia and carried her on his back and started running. And running.

And running.

And running.

And running.

Anastasia felt a hand on her shoulder, it was her older self. The pale star had an unreadable expression.

“Explain. Now.”

“…You won’t believe it.”

“Try me.”

“…Subaru can return by death. Every time he dies, he turns back time to a set point, with full knowledge of what happened as well as the feeling of dying etched into him.”

“…”

In a soft tone, “I know. It seems far-fetched but-“

“The danger sense.”

Anastasia raised her eyebrow, “The, what?”

The pale star wasn’t listening, she started muttering to herself, eyes widening, her hand on her mouth, “That’s what it was. It wasn’t future sight. Or danger sense. He can return. But why did he not tell me? Can he not? Is that the cost? It would explain why he was always so tense. But that means…. No. No,no,no!”

“Wait, calm down.”

She still wasn’t listening, “No, please, no. This. Can’t. NO!” Her older counterpart got out of her seat and raced to the screen.

And running.

Shit, what is she doing?!

The pale star slammed her fists on the screen, “Stop it! Stop!”

Anastasia and the rest of her camp ran down with her future self, “You can’t stop this, we can only watch.”

She kept trying, “STOP! Just leave me! Why?! You barely knew me?!”

And running.

“Anastasia-sama…” “Boss-Lady…” “Ana-bo…”

She slammed her fist, blood started to trickle, “What did I do to deserve this?! You didn’t. You don’t. NO!”

That’s it!

“Get a hold of yourself!” Anastasia did not want to see herself in such a disgusting state. She slapped herself, sending the pale star sprawling on the floor.

And running.

It didn’t help, Anastasia started muttering again, closing in on herself, “In Banan. How many times? That’s how he knew. That’s. He was so good. I thought he practiced. Why he said those things. The notes…the prison. How many times did he die in there? How is he okay? How did…”

“Su…”

The pale star slowly turned her head.

“Ana?! You… can you hear me?”

“Ye…s.”

“You’re going to be okay. You hear me?! I’m going to save you.”

“No…”

“Sa…ve…me…?”

“No. Say no.”

“Yes. I will.”

“No!”

“…please…save…me…”

“No…” The pale started to choke. She looked like her mind was about to break.

“…I will. No matter what.”

And he kept running.

“…I did this,” her face looked hollow. Her eyes dead.

He ran. And ran. And ran.

“I made him into this. He… I made him into a slave.”

Even when his feet became mangled, his wounds festered and bled, his chipped bones shattered and split. Yet, he still ran.

“I’m just like her… just…like…her,” she started gripping her own hair.

Anastasia knew what she was talking about. She didn’t like the insinuation.

“…No. We’re not.”

“We are!” The pale star cried.

He ran. Even when one foot dragged behind, because it could no longer move. Even when he could only crawl. Even as his whole body was numb, he couldn’t feel anything. He still pushed forward. With Anastasia on his back.

The star pointed at the screen, to her dying lover, “Look at him! I did this to him. I made him rely on me… attached to me. And he’s now dying for us because he doesn’t know anything else. He has nobody!”

Anastasia grits her teeth, “You don’t know-“

“I do know!”

He could see it. The village was right there. He was so close. Just a little more. Black spots began to appear.

“We were in Banan. He…reacted just like that. He must have died. So many times. For us. For me.”

“This isn’t the worst he’s been through!”

“What are you- “

“I’m sorry.”

The pale star turned her head, her face covered in tears, looking at the screen which portrayed Subaru as a mess of blood and flesh, slowly crawling towards a village in the distance. The sun was rising.

“If only I was stronger.” The dark spots continued.

“No. Please don’t say that.”

“If only I reacted quicker.” The darkness was taking hold.

“I didn’t expect that. I didn’t need that. You were enough.”

“If only I wasn’t so useless.” He could barely see, still moving.

“You aren’t!”

“…I’ll save you.” It was pitch black.

“You already did… ever since you met me. You did,” she reached her hand up, touching the screen.

“I promise.” There was nothing but a garden of shadows.

“…I love you,” she whispered.

 

“HURGHK!” Suddenly, Subaru convulsed in pain, back on the carriage.

“Subaru?! What’s wrong?” 

Not this time.

He pulled her close, barely dodging the arrow as it flew by her head and into the carriage wood.

Never again. I’ll keep you safe. No matter whatttttttttttt.

The screen froze once more.

 

The pale star wept on the floor. Shuddering. Her camp huddled around her. Anastasia stared.

…What happened to me? This…it was all at once. The revelation was too much. If I loved him… just like her. I would have had the same reaction…to him sacrificing himself for me. Is love even worth it? For all this?

Suddenly, the older Anastasia stopped crying. She looked as if everything connected in her brain at once. Her eyes were no longer dead.

 

She stood up, slowly. Turned, her eyes held death. Not just death. Full. Unrelenting. Rage. She stared at the audience.

The audience was a mix of solemn acceptance and soft tears. They froze under the pale star’s gaze.

 

She raised her hand and pointed at the Emilia camp, “You.”

Priscilla fanned herself, looking very amused. She was the only one.

Emilia tried to say something, “Anastasia-san- “

 

“You. All. Killed him. Didn’t you?”


Otto stood up, “Wait, Anastasia-sama, how do you know-“

Anastasia looked at them like they were bugs, “He talked to me. He would tell me stories. But there were always these small things that never added up. Small details I noticed. His low self-esteem, how he acts like he’s unimportant, how he flinches sometimes randomly when people touch him. What did you do to him?!”

She pointed at Otto, Ram, Roswaal, and Garfiel, “I know you were all involved. You must have killed him in a loop. I fucking knew you hurt him, but I can’t believe you would kill your own camp member!”

They all looked guilty, except for Roswaal. He accepted his sins. But right now, he wasn’t as jovial and joking as he was earlier, right now he was viewing everything with a calculating look.

“Please,” the pale star turned her head to the blue haired oni, “It isn’t my sister’s fault-“

“You’re the third woman he loved, I knew it was weird that he said you were similar to her! Both the second and third. That’s why he said it that way.”

“What?”

“You tortured him. And he still loved you. You sick twisted monster.”

Rem looked like her previous mental wounds popped open, Ram cut in, “Do not speak that way- “

“Or what? You were probably in on it too, weren’t you? I doubt you would be that ignorant to not know your sister torturing someone! You watched. I bet you fucking did. You watched an innocent boy get slaughtered!”

Ram flinched, every single one of the Emilia camp felt like they were being exposed once again, the wounds were still raw from previous fights and emotional outbursts.

Anastasia chose not to stop her, all of her previous efforts did nothing. She also made sure her camp members stayed put. Besides, they deserved this.

“Anastasia-san. I’m sorry. I understand how you feel. Subaru is very important to me as well. I felt the same things as you did when I saw it here. You are right to feel this way,” Emilia tried to coax the pale star.

The older Anastasia just glared at her, “…Did you know? Subaru harms himself. Every night.”

Emilia became shocked, “I-I, what?!”

The pale star gritted her teeth, “Of course you don’t know. No wonder he’s so fucked up. He scratches his arms into a bloody mess every time he has a panic attack or he has a nightmare. Every night he has nightmares! I thought it was because of what happened after Priestella, but no. From what he told me, this wasn’t new. This happened since before that. Which means: you didn’t notice.”

“I, n-no, never knew, I-“

“Betty knew.”

Emilia turned her head towards Beatrice, “Beatrice?”

“Betty’s Subaru would do as the merchant said, I suppose. He promised Betty not to tell anyone, while Betty would help heal him.”

“…Why didn’t he tell me?”

Beatrice ignored her and turned to the merchant, “…How did you find out?”

“I sleep in the same bed,” the pale star held up a hand, “We aren’t like that. No sex. We just did it to comfort each other. Even if I didn’t, I would have figured it out, because I’m not an idiot.”

She glared at the half-elf and continued, “You know how I know so much? I asked. I watched and I asked. I noticed how he acted and I would find ways for him to open up. Do you know how long I’ve been with him? Only almost two months. And I can confidently say I know most things about him. How long have you known him? A year. And you never even noticed he was like this… Od, you disgust me. All of you disgust me.”

Emilia was shocked after hearing her knight was suffering this whole time. Right next to her. And the signs were there.

Suddenly lights started to flicker around the older Anastasia, her body looked translucent.

“Well, that was very entertaining. I quite liked that speech at the end, my little pale star of greed. But unfortunately, I think your time is up.”

She looked at the voice, unamused, “…Will I remember any of this?”

“Unfortunately, no, I took you out of your story too early it seems. I should have aimed for later in the timeline. It’s why the theater glitched, it seems without the Sage and his Authorities, this theater isn’t running correctly. How interesting.”

The pale star felt like the voice’s eyes were on her, “What?”

“…Nothing. Just a theory. Anyway, say goodbye to everyone. You’ll likely not return until later.”

She looked at everyone. She first focused on her camp, “Thanks for comforting me when I first arrived. I promise, I’ll find a way back to you guys.”

Despite what had happened in the last half hour, they looked at the older candidate with warmth.

“We’ll be waiting my Lady.” “No matter what, Lady Boss.” “We’ll always love ya, Ana-bo.”

 

She then looked at the other camps, then Emilia and Rem specifically, “He still loves you. Even after getting betrayed after his name was taken. He still loves you both. But you know what? I don’t care. I’m going to take him. All for myself. And I’m going to make him the happiest person in the world.”

She didn’t even care to see their responses instead looking at her younger self, “Did we ever kill him? Hurt him?”

“…We used him for information.”

“…So, we are also disgusting.”

“…Yeah. I guess we are.”

“He’s wonderful you know. Fun to talk to, kind, considerate, and a little shit.”

“…I don’t love him.”

“Neither did I. I never thought I would. Guess I was wrong. And you might too. Just, watch him. And be the person who notices him. Everything about him.”

And with that, the pale star was gone.

Notes:

EN1: This took over 20 revisions. I scrapped so much and recreated everything from scratch so many times. I can go on and on about what went wrong but it was mostly how unsatisfying the original drafts were. I just hated redundancy and I also didn't want this one chapter to have very rushed moments, which there were a lot of in the past. Think of this as a preview of what would be how I envision my version of a react fic: a different perspective of events from the series so that it isn't exactly redundant but still covers everything. Plus, interactions with some of the new characters with those from the theater. I know there's probably stuff people still want to see: Felix, everyone's proper reactions, and more. But, I didn't want this one chapter to be too bloated and to have rushed moments. So I chose the most poignant for now. Don't worry. The theater will return. Eventually.

EN2: If anyone is wondering why Anastasia was not exposing anything quickly, she had a plan. All I'll say is that she really wanted one person 100% dead, didn't know the theater rules, and was waiting for the perfect moment.

EN3: As for the 'warden' or I guess Nuwa as I call them, they aren't some kind of OC or something. I have a specific interpretation of who is controlling the theater and it is a character from Re:Zero. Good luck guessing~.

EN4: If your wondering which cast this is, think of it as a conglomeration of all the other react fics, and not just one. Reactionist, vyazov, etc. I have my own interpretation of the whole react casts development but I do not have the time to make my own from scratch, so just use the other react fics as reference.

Chapter 16: Anastasia Begins Her Attack

Summary:

Our favorite pale star has started the train of love, and it has no breaks...

Notes:

Enjoy!

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

“Uh, Ana?”

“Hmmm~? What is it Subaru?”

“…You’re a little close.”

Anastasia raised an eyebrow, “We’ve always done this. You’ve never complained before.”

“Well-yeah-but-uh-I mean-well…” Subaru kept blubbering.

She giggled, “Come on, use your words~. You’re a big boy, aren’t you?”

Subaru blushed immensely. They were currently in bed together, the morning dawn approaching around them. Yesterday, Anastasia decided to fully commit to operation: “Seduce the Little Shit.” As a result, she may have stolen his lips several more times before they returned home.

While they never told the others what happened, some of them could guess given how the only words Subaru could say was a mix of “wha-habuhbwhat” and “huhyuhawah” and “wow.”

He didn’t really fully recover until he woke up in the morning. And he woke up to Anastasia hugging him very closely. And wearing a slightly provocative sleep-wear kimono. It was a light purple color and while it certainly covered everything nice and well, some of it was drooping it from the shoulder. And she smelled really nice. Like really, really nice. Like really really really-

He felt something warm cup his cheek and tilt his face down, “Cat got your tongue still? I can help with that.”

Subaru raised his eyebrow, still a little confused, “Uh, yes? What- “

She swung in and stole another kiss, a deeper one and this time: she certainly did take his tongue back from the proverbial cat.

She separated and giggled again at his reaction, “Whabwhuh?”

“Hey, don’t let the cat steal it again. Unless,” She put a finger on her chin and looked him in the eyes as she sat up on top of him, “You want me to keep helping ya~?”

Subaru blinked.

 

It took him a second to process her words as he also processed the current situation. The situation where a very pretty girl was now sitting on top of him in bed.

 

His neurons, thousands of them, all fired and made one single thought. One single provocative thought that was squeezed from every inch of his brain matter. A thought that summed up his current understanding of the situation.

What?

“What?”

She rolled her eyes and smiled before shaking her head, silently getting off of him and walking towards the bathroom, “I’ll let you cool down for a bit. Buuuut! If your brain starts workin’, feel free to join me.” She finished off with a wink before leaving the room, grabbing a set of clothes on the way out.

Subaru blinked.

He stared at the door.

He blinked again.

He was staring at the door for a few seconds.

 

It then all hit at once.

 

…Ah. Ana and I. I and Ana.

 

 Ana likes me.

 

No.

 

Ana loves me.

He then remembered everything she just did 30 seconds ago. His face returned to a sharp shade of red.

He then remembered what she just said, right before she left.

Which was accompanied by a very incredible, internal, AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!

 

 

Anastasia stepped out of the bathroom after freshening up and putting on a new kimono set. It was similar to what she usually wore nowadays, wisps and stars, but the colors were a little darker.

Anastasia then looked around briefly before heading towards the kitchen to grab some breakfast. She entered, looked around to see if anyone was there, and then took a deep breath.

 

She covered her mouth and screamed, “MMMMMMMMHHHHHHHHH!”

 

Her face became a vibrant pink as she internally felt her heart almost burst from how fast it was beating ever since she woke up.

AHHHHHHHHHHH! Why is this so hard?! Ah, why am I so stupid? Who even does that?! And why is hugging him while sleeping so difficult now?! We literally slept in the same bed for weeks and it was so easy! Now? My heart feels like it wants to jump out and beat me to death! I could barely close my eyes!!

Anastasia might be on the war path, but she was also completely clueless about how to actually seduce the boy. To be fair, she spent a good amount of her time, surviving and building her company ever since she was a child. She never made romance a priority. So, it kind of made sense that she had absolutely no idea what she was doing.

What is wrong with me?! Why did I think that was a good idea?! He barely reacted! Did he even enjoy the kiss?! I did… but did he? No, he definitely did.
