“You think we’ll ever find people who won’t stare at us for asking that?”
She snorted, “Never. We’re too weird.”

“I like our weird,” he leaned back into his seat, lazily, “It’s nice.”

She leaned in, putting her hands on her chin, smiling cutely, “I agree, feels like we have our own little club of fun.”

“Speaking of club, have you decided what we should name our company finally?”

Anastasia sighed and waved one hand in the air, “Nope. I still can’t decide.”

“I still think Eight Stars would be a great company name.”

“Absolutely not. We don’t even have eight employees.”

“Well, we do have eight stars between the two of us.”

Anastasia raised an eyebrow, “I don’t understand. Don’t you mean two?”

He shook his head before realizing, “No I mean- wait. I never did explain to you exactly what my name means, did I?”

Anastasia felt intensely annoyed, “Your name means something special, and you decided to not tell me until now!”

“To be fair, it’s only been a few months!”

“We are not having this argument again!”

COUGH!

A waiter was smiling at them politely, “Does the young couple need more time?”

They both turned their heads at the waiter and smiled sheepishly before ordering.

After the waiter left, his smile slightly cracked when hearing their requests, they resumed their conversation.

Anastasia poked his nose, “So spill: what does eight stars have to do with your name?”

Subaru poked her nose back, making her giggle, “Spill I shall: my name comes from a collection of stars right next to each other, seven to be exact. It’s why I suggested eight, because you are added as well. As for the stars, they come from a myth from this one country back home called Greece. Back in ancient times, they were called the Seven Sisters or the Pleiades. Fun fact, there is a common misconception about that star cluster, you see…“

The black star suddenly stopped talking mid-explanation.

The boy blinked. And blinked. And blinked. His mouth still open.

Anastasia’s eyes widened in worry, she softly reached for his hand, “Subaru, are you okay?”

“…”

The boy blinked. And blinked. And blinked. Closing his mouth.

 

 

Natsuki Subaru has returned by death, once again.

Notes:

EN: Ah, now we're onto one of my favorite parts. Welcome to hell.

Chapter 19: Abandon All Hope

Summary:

Subaru's date resumes...

Notes:

I'm still trying to recover but I'm almost back to full strength. Kind of sucks getting sick out of nowhere, especially when I want to write but I physically can't...honestly, it makes me realize how much I want to do this full time.

Anyways, enough about me, enjoy the new chapter!

Chapter Text

What are you willing to do to protect what you have?

How far will you go to do so?

How many times will you die for her?

 

And what if it’s not enough?

 

 

Day 1

“You need to tell me more about these ‘constellations,’ Subaru.”
“Sure but there isn’t much point given that the stars are different here.”

“…The stars are different beyond the Great Waterfall?”

“Well, when I look up, the normal locations and clusters are vastly different.”

That doesn’t even account for the fact that stars are not the same here compared to on Earth. Subaru remembered how Beatrice explained how stars were in fact clumps of mana and not giant balls of hydrogen and plasma. It even got freakier when Beatrice and Emilia made him a star and shot it into the sky for him with the others.

It was one of his happiest memories.

It showed that they cared. That they remembered him. Remembered what he told them. Especially Emilia.

 

He always liked telling Emilia about stuff from home. She always looked like a child filled with wonder, just like Beatrice did, though Beatrice was much more curious and thorough about her questions.

He still loved hearing Emilia so enthusiastic about his home. Even if she didn’t quite understand what he said or didn’t quite understand how incredible some of these inventions were. She still loved to listen. Just like he loved to tell.

“Ow! What was that for?”

“You were thinking about another girl, weren’t you?” She said as she pouted.

He was. He immediately felt guilty.

Anastasia was different. She would also listen endlessly to Subaru but would also delve deeper and deeper with boundless questions and infinite curiosity. Even beyond Beatrice.

If Subaru had to compare them: Subaru was like one of those old gramophones and the three were avid listeners of music. Emilia wasn’t a fan of the music per se, but she loved listening because the gramophone was there for her during her worst moments. Beatrice and Anastasia were fans of both the music and the gramophone, only wanting to hear from him and being very territorial of him. He remembers Beatrice giving others whenever they would take away the duo’s ‘story time’.

 

He rubbed his hand where Ana had pinched him as the girl leaned back into his body. After having breakfast at the café, they decided to take a walk around the more scenic areas of Banan. Taking a break, they decided to sit down together in a nearby park, right next to a tree that reminded Subaru of cherry blossoms from home.

It should have been relaxing.

If Anastasia didn’t immediately sit down on his crotch, making the boy flustered beyond belief for a good ten minutes. Could she blame him for making his mind have to wander every few seconds just so he didn’t go crazy!? Especially since he was really trying not to focus on one of Anastasia’s best… assets.

 

Don’t judge! He’s still 18, almost 19! And despite everything, his libido was still normal. And Anastasia definitely noticed because she was doing everything she possibly could to make sure he noticed her physically.

Whether that was bending over at every opportunity, intimately touching and hugging whenever possible, or sneaking kisses from him in the mornings and evenings, he was positively being smothered with affection no matter the time or place.

It felt odd.

Emilia only kissed him once.

…That other one didn’t count.

After Sanctuary, Subaru would hold hands during dates, give hugs, or get lap pillows from his candidate.

And Subaru was satisfied. He didn’t need more. Just having the apple of his eye’s attention was enough… even though a part of him still wished for the day she would return his love to arrive sooner each passing day.

To him, Emilia was like the distant starlight, a comet that will appear when ready.

Anastasia on the other hand, was like a heat seeking meteor, coming right for him, like the dinosaurs way back when.

Some days, Anastasia looked at him with warmth and passion that he could barely understand.

Other days, she looked at him like how Rem would look at him when he woke up in the morning.

…He might have finally realized why Rem stared at him like that.

It kind of freaked him out how close he was to losing his innocence during those days at the mansion and how he barely realized it until now.

Anyways, not the point, he needs to stop reminiscing and start pacifying the angry lollipop on his lap.

“Sorry, that wasn’t right of me. I’m on a date with you. No one else. I promise it won’t happen again.”

He wrapped his arms tightly around Anastasia’s waist while leaning his head on her right shoulder.

He felt Anastasia adjust her position, trying his best to ignore all sensations in his lower body, as she craned her neck and laid her cheek on Subaru’s hair.

She felt so warm.

If he could, he would stay here, in this position, forever.

“And here I thought maybe having your little guy occupied would get you to only focus on me.”

“So, you did do this on purpose!”

She shrugged slightly, making his chin dip up and down, “Can’t blame a gal for trying. Besides, didn’t seem to work given your reaction…well, kind of. You certainly are reacting to me,” she said while winking with her tongue out.

Dear God in heaven. Subaru did not know how he was going to survive this week.

 

Day 2:

“Joshua contacted you?!”

“Tried to contact me. Don’t worry, this gal ain’t a dum dum, unlike how your nickname implies. Though, I will say I am your dum dum~.” She said with a wink before giving him a taste of her strowberry ice cream.

They were sitting on a bench outside an art exhibit. Today’s plan was to check out the visiting artist before trying out some of the exhibition’s activities, such as a ‘Draw Your Partner’ contest. For now, they were waiting for the building to open while enjoying a nice sugary treat.

He frowned but still took a lick. A part of him loved how easily Anastasia took what Subaru said and implemented it into her own life. A part of him kind of hated it because Anastasia would then use that knowledge on him.

The first time he heard Anastasia call him cringe was the first time he realized how Adam must have felt when Eve took a bite of the apple.

Too much knowledge can corrupt.

Of course, Subaru ate the apple as well and proceeded to call Anastasia cringe back at every opportunity. Which Anastasia then returned in kind.

It then developed into a ‘cringe cycle’ where both stars would keep doing the most ludicrous shit imaginable while calling each other ‘cringe.’

It took a whole day and Beatrice banning the word for them to knock it off.

“You know that’s not what I’m talking about…”

Anastasia picked up on what he was saying, she sighed, and her eyes looked weary and tired, “No, he didn’t know who I was.”

Subaru’s eyes narrowed, “Are you sure?”

“Definitely. I’ve been talking to Eridna and she hasn’t remembered a thing yet. He sent a bunch of Hoshin workers scouring the city and asked around about anyone named ‘Anastasia’ and ‘Subaru.’ Halibel and his contacts have been on high alert as a result…”

That was a new thing they also decided, Echidna was now the newly dubbed ‘Eridna,’ to differentiate her from her mother. Subaru still liked calling her Scarfdona. Which Ana hated immensely. Funny thing is that they were basically the same thing, not that Anastasia would ever know. Perks of knowing English and Japanese.

Anyways, not important.

What is important is that for a second after hearing that her name did not return, Subaru felt relieved. Before immense guilt covered his mind.

He hated that he felt relieved.

He hated what has been beginning to plague his mind recently. After the talk with Eridna and Beatrice, he had been thinking about everything. His life, how far he has come, and who he was.

What did he value?

He valued his friends, his loved ones, even himself. Despite it all, he kept his promise to Satella. To cherish his life.

Even when he was in literal hell, in that prison, he never once gave up. Always looked for a way out, never giving into despair.

 

But what was he greedy about? He always assumed his greed was always how he would never compromise himself, always trying to save everyone no matter what, but never giving into the idea that he was infallible.

It’s what made him different from Roswaal. He believed in people and their capacity to change. Roswaal believed only in his damn book.

And Echidna. The greediest witch of all.

…A part of him wondered if Subaru was more similar to the clown than he would like to admit. They were both people who would do anything for their goals, they were people who would give their all for the one they loved, and they both fell for people synonymous for greed.

 

Anastasia.

 

A feeling festered in his heart, it made him feel unpleasant.

A feeling that made him feel hollow.

A feeling that reminded him of how he felt back in the capital…it felt so long ago.

He was jealous. Anxious. Scared.

No matter what Ana would tell him, he didn’t understand why she fell for him. He still didn’t believe it. Like it was a dream.

A dream that he was scared of waking from.

 

What if.

If Anastasia got her name back, things would return to normal.

Normal. She would return to her camp. Without him.

 

That was an insane thought. He knows that isn’t true. He knows Anastasia. She would never. She would hold onto him as long as possible.

 

But what if that changed? She changed once, she could change again. Give it time, maybe she’ll realize how terrible he was. How he had no value beyond his fucked up ability.

Because isn’t that true?

Sure, he had knowledge from home, but what if one day he runs out of ideas or it doesn’t profit? So yeah, his only worth was RBD. It’s what got him out of every situation, it’s why all his friends liked him.

It’s why Emilia liked him. And Rem.

He saved them. Brought them hope. Did it all. And once his name was forgotten, all his deeds gone, they threw him away.

It wasn’t their fault. They didn’t know. He was useless anyhow. He only brought pain anyway. He brought Anastasia pain. Every death she ever experience, it was all his fault. She was never in any danger. Subaru was, and she was simply unlucky enough to be there.

What if she realized this? She’s smart. She can weigh risk versus profit easily. Subaru was too much risk.

And once her name was back, she had so many more options. She didn’t have to rely on him anymore. When they were forgotten, all they had was each other. But once they are remembered, they’ll have other people.

And maybe. Just maybe. Anastasia will realize that she doesn’t have to settle for him. She’ll be Anastasia Hoshin again, rising star of Kararagi and possible future queen of Lugunica. She doesn’t need him.

She never needed-

He felt something soft and sweet touch his lips, entering his mouth at the same time.

Blinking his eyes, Anastasia moved back and licked her lips, “Hm, thought it would taste like a choko strawberry.”

He blinked. Subaru looked down at his chokolate ice cream and then back at Anastasia. He realized what she meant before blushing mad.

She giggled, “I think the greatest part of finally coming clean to you is that I can do that to get your attention now.”

His eyes widened, “Ah. I spiraled again, didn’t I?”
She wrapped her arm around his, snaking it before interlocking fingers, settling her head on his shoulder, “It’s fine. You aren’t scratching yourself that much anymore. You only looked like you were staring off into space again.”

Subaru relaxed before breathing out, “I still don’t know how you can catch that so easily…”

She snorted, “Anyone could do the same if they look hard enough, besides I’m always staring at you~.” She said with a wink. Again.

“…” He stared at her.

“…Okay, that sounded a little creepy.”

“You don’t say?”

Anastasia chuckled, “Oh come on, you love it.”

“Besides the point. Also, ya need to stop winking at me every time.”

“You say that, but I can feel your heart skip a beat every time I do it. I’ll stop when you stop giving me a reaction.”

Subaru opened his mouth to say something before stopping himself.

She was really cute.

And Subaru really didn’t want her to stop being cute.

The problem was that Subaru kept getting mini heart palpitations each time she did so.

So now he was balancing whether to risk a heart attack or to keep being fed endless adorability on mass.

He felt something soft hit his lips once again, a much more concentrated strowberry taste entered his mouth.

He separated and shook his head, “S-stop doing that!” He said that but his tone was very obviously happy.

She giggled before finishing off her ice cream, “Again. I’ll stop when you stop giving me reactions.”

He pouted, “It’s because you surprised me. Nothing else.”

She raised an eyebrow, “Oho~. So does that mean it’s okay if it’s not a surprise?”

He stared at her again, but this time a blush was rising back with a vengeance to his cheeks, “…After I finish my ice cream. Also, what are we going to do about Joshua?”

Anastasia sighed, “Well, given that Julius is on some expedition, my guess is that he isn’t looking for us to take you back to prison. In addition, my sources are telling me that he seems adamant about making a good first impression on us. Which implies that he isn’t here for trouble.”

Subaru’s eyebrows furrowed, “That’s…strange?”

She nodded before using her now free hand to draw circles on the back of his hand, “For now, I’ll look into what else he may want before making contact with him. Who knows? Maybe there is an opportunity there we can exploit.”

He finished off his sugary treat. As the dessert froze his brain, he froze in real life.

…Do you think we should head back?

He wanted to ask that question. But a part of him didn’t want to.

And she evidently noticed. Like she always did.

“What’s wrong?”

“…”

He wanted to ask her about what they should do once their names are back. Obviously, they should go back. Return to their old relationships, old positions.

To old times.

Would you still love me if things returned to normal?

Would she have fallen in love with him if this hadn’t all happened to both of them? Probably not. He was a rival candidate’s knight. And they barely talked before this. Hell, Subaru could argue that they disliked each other.

 

So, what if the one thing connecting them, their shared condition, was no longer holding her back? And what if she sees him with Emilia. And Rem.

She might cut her losses.

She didn’t want to share.

And Subaru can’t decide.

And what if Subaru ended up abandoning her?

He was a piece of shit. It was always a possibility.

Anastasia jolted him out of his thoughts by tenderly caressing his cheek, she looked concerned, “Is it something you can’t tell me?”

Subaru realized what she was implying, “N-no, it isn’t that. I didn’t get a ‘danger sense’ tingle or anything.”

“Then what is it? I won’t push you if you don’t want to…but I’m always here for you,” she ended it with a smile. A soft smile that meant the world to him.

A smile that hurt him so dearly.

But what if you aren’t? What if you choose to leave me? Why do I keep thinking these things?

He hated these thoughts. It reminded him of how gross he was. How possessive he was of Emilia. That he was starting to become for Anastasia. Those thoughts were simply paranoia. Not truthful at all. She would never abandon him.

 

But Emilia was the same. She didn’t abandon him until she had to.

“…Is that offer for a kiss still available?” He joked with his best patented smile. It always worked for everyone before.

Unfortunately, Anastasia frowned at his words, “…I won’t make you say what you actually want to say. And maybe I’m misinterpreting things but let me tell you this: no matter what, I won’t leave you alone. You don’t have to deal with any of this alone.”

She gazed at him resolutely. And his heart felt like it was cracking.

How is it that she is always almost right on the money when it comes to him. Is he that obvious? Was he that obvious before? Did everyone choose to humor him or is Anastasia that perceptive?

…And why can’t he still ask her?

“…I’ll tell you later. I think…I just need some time.”

Her eyes were so beautiful as they concentrated on him, he could stare into them all day, “Okay. But promise me you will.”

“I will. Don’t worry,” she patted his cheek as he responded.

“Good,” Anastasia then grabbed his chin and brought him closer, “And to answer your earlier question, the offer is always available.”

She let passion take hold once more, kissing him softly.

 

They were almost late to the ticket booth.

 

 

Day 5

“Subaru! I got everything set up, come down when you’re ready.”

“I’ll be down in sec! I just gotta clean up,” Subaru yelled as he organized his desk, putting away his quill and ink. He also quickly gathered up the loose paper, each having sketches of a girl with long hair, a fuzzy hat, and a star pin.

After hiding his supplies in a secret spot, he left his room and went down towards the kitchen where Anastasia was wearing an apron with a cartoon version of Halibel giving a thumbs up printed on the front. Otherwise, she was dressed casually, wearing a soft white sweater and shorts with stockings. Subaru himself was just wearing a plain black shirt and shorts as well as sandals.

“I still can’t believe Halibel is letting us use his face for merchandise…”

Anastasia snorted, “Subaru. He’s Kararagian. Of course he would take advantage of anything to make a profit. Especially when he doesn’t even have to do anything.”

“I thought he worked as a bodyguard or an assassin or ninja or something? Doesn’t he have a lot of money?”
She shook her head, “That does pay but being able to make money while being lazy is the highest form of success here. He’s one of the few property managers that can survive off of just collecting rent here.”

“I guess some things stay the same…no matter the place, passive income trumps all.”

He put on his own apron as well, this one had a cartoon version of Patrasche on it. Subaru advocated for Patrasche to be their mascot.

Something that Anastasia vehemently rejected.

He still didn’t understand why she had such a grudge against his Earth Dragon. The staring contests they kept getting into always confused him.

He looked around, “So, what are we making today?”

“Daisukiyaki! Or I guess how you call it, okonomiyaki.”

Anastasia laid out all of their supplies on the countertop. They had a variety of ingredients and the batter was already made, they just had to add what toppings they wanted before cooking it on the stovetop.

Today’s date was simple: a casual day spent cooking and having fun. Subaru had told her stories of how people would bring their girlfriends to their home, cook meals together, and simply hang out in their room throughout the day.

 

It didn’t really work for them because they already lived in the same house, in the same room, but Anastasia was adamant about giving her lover the full ‘girlfriend experience.’

The rest of the house decided to go out and have some fun downtown.

Hopefully they aren’t up to any trouble.

 

 

“Betty has only spent one hour outside with you people, but she already wants to go home, in fact.”

“Oh, come now Bea-bo,” Halibel chuckled, “Lighten up. Think of this as a fun bondin’ moment for us. Ya can’t just attach yerself to Su-san or Ana-bo only.”

“Betty very much can and will.”

“What if the two finally consummate their love, sister? I doubt you would enjoy being there- “

“Betty does not want to think about that!” The spirit face palmed, “Betty thinks you are spending way too much time with that fart spirit, I suppose-OW!”

“I heard that brat!” Beatrice rubbed her head where Tia knuckled her, “Speaking of, maybe we should go and check on them. Maybe a little Su is already running around.”

“That is not how biology works! Babies do not pop out that fast, in fact!!”

“How would you know? Have you seen humans birth before?”

Beatrice raised a finger before pausing. She had, in fact, never seen a baby being born before, “…No.”

Tia crossed her arms, “See. Therefore, little Su should be here any moment now.”

Beatrice blue screened as she tried to comprehend Tia’s words.

She could not, so she defaulted to her usual way of dealing with things, “Betty hates you. So much.”

Tia snorted, “Yeah, so? I’m Su’s spirit, not you.” She blew a raspberry at the little spirit.

“Hate. So! Much!! IN FACT!”

 

 

 

“You think they’ll be alright walking by themselves?”

“Subaru. Two Great Spirits. And The Admirer. It’s like if you mugged Reinhard. You’re basically asking to die.”

“Yeah, but what about those protestors…”

There was a recent uproar regarding spirit independence. The recent event during the rain festival caused heated debate. Despite their best efforts, people know Zarestia was in the area. Halibel made sure everyone involved had tight lips but there was bound to be information leaks. At the very least, no one knew who Tia was, but they knew a high profile spirit was still wandering Banan, uncontested.

Sure, they can’t stop her. It’s impossible. But that doesn’t mean a politician can’t take advantage of the situation and advocate for stricter laws…and that’s what they’re currently doing. One of them has even gotten close to passing, a law that puts higher taxes on spirit users. Which would be annoying on its own, however, it also required many spirit users to register under the government. This would jeopardize the Miko temples, who require some anonymity for their work.  This has led to many protesting the changes, citing that spirit art users may get targeted by groups and that higher taxes would put a strain on any businesses that were to hire them.

 

It was all political nonsense, most of which Subaru could barely wrap his head around and only vaguely understood from Anastasia explaining everything.

Anastasia grabbed some batter and mixed it with some poiison and seafood, “I still wouldn’t worry. Protests rarely get violent in Banan. Often times it’s just performative, most people bargain and negotiate under the table. Despite how passionate they may seem, a lot of those people are just there to stoke public opinion. The real work happens in the background.”

“Well, I’m more worried that someone will go up to Tia, ask her if she wants to support ‘Spirits Rights.’ And then she ends up kicking them in the balls because she misinterpreted it as an insult,” Subaru added some veggies to the mix as she stirred.

“…Oh my Od, you might be right.”

 

 

“Why did you punch him, in fact?!”

“He looked at me funny!”

“That doesn’t mean- “ Beatrice looked at Halibel who just came back from the bathroom with a weird expression, “What did you do?”

The wolfman brought both hands up, “Hey, hey! Tis guy ain’t always up to no good.”

“…”

“…”

“…So, what did you do?”

“I may have. Accidentally. Flirted with a woman who was married. Again.”

“…”

“And her husband might be comin’ with a bunch of his friends to castrate me,” he said this with a smirk, tongue out, and his knuckle hitting his head in faux goofiness.

Beatrice’s face was in her hands, “…”

She was trying her best not to scream.

She failed.

 

 

“So, are we still thinking of hiring some more people?”

They were now cooking the okonomiyaki on a pan, both of their mouths watering, Subaru had his hand already on a bottle of mayonnaise.

Anastasia answered as she flipped the mass of dough and protein, “We did make a decent amount of money from the festival. I’m thinking we expand production while hiring some traders to spread our name and product soon. Well the name of the company once we finally choose it. If we’re lucky, we might even be able to market ourselves to Lugunica through Priestella.”

“…”

“…Subaru?”

“Yeah. I’m here. Um. That’s great.”

“…Do you not want to talk about Lugunica anymore?”

“N-no, that’s not it. It’s just. I’m,” Subaru didn’t know how to explain himself.

Anastasia started paying more attention to him, “Every time we talk about Lugunica, you get quiet again. I’m worried. Does it make you remember bad memories?”

Subaru was touched by her concern, he bit his lip before deciding to bite the bullet, “…Ana-pop. Do you want to go home?”

She looked at him strangely, cocking her head and raising an eyebrow, “Subaru. We are literally home right now.”

He stared back.

He then chuckled, “That’s not what I meant. I mean, do you want to return to Lugunica?”

“…I don’t know.”

That answer surprised him, “Really?”

“I think I’m starting to understand what you’re trying to say. You’re asking whether we should return to Lugunica or not once our names are back. Am I correct on that?”

Sort of. There were broader implications that he actually wanted to ask. But was too much of a coward to do so.

“…Yes.”

“Then yeah. I don’t know.”

“That’s. New. I mean, don’t you want to join the Royal Selection again?”

And get the Dragon’s blood so we can extend your life.

Subaru was already making plans for that. He knows Emilia wants the blood for Elior Forest but he was sure he could find a way for both Emilia and Anastasia to get what they want.

“I do. And trust me, I’m not giving up that election.”

“…I’m guessing there is a ‘but’ there?”

“Oh, how forward~. I guess you have been looking at my-ow!”

“Knock it off,” Subaru tugged at her cheek playfully, “It’s cute that you’re so confident but I’m serious.”

She rubbed her cheek but continued, “But I guess I’m starting to get used to things here. I have you here. Halibel. Tia. Betty. Eridna. And once our names return, the rest of my camp as well. While I’m interested in returning, I’m not in a rush just yet.”

“…”

“…Do you want to return?”

Subaru looked away.

It was a thought that felt so sweet before but now felt bitter. He didn’t understand why. He wanted to have his name back, his friends back, and everything he lost so badly just a few months ago.

What changed?

He looked at Anastasia, straight into her eyes, “I do. But also, I don’t.”

“Is it because of Felix?”

No. In fact, he was kind of worried about what would happen to Felix once their names would return. He was already looking pretty bad around the time Subaru escaped. Add onto the fact that Felix would not react well to torturing an innocent person, much less someone he knew, and well, Subaru did not think Felix was going to have a good time. He hoped the poor guy won’t hurt himself.

“…No. Honestly, I don’t know. I guess I’m just…scared.”

“Subaru- “

“I’m fine it’s just-wait. Is something burning?”

Both stars blinked as they turned their heads.

The daisukiyaki was on fire.

 

“Oh shit!” They both exclaimed.

Both stars panicked as one grabbed the pan and the other grabbed some water. They tried throwing water to douse the fire as the one grabbing the pan simply chucked it into the sink before running the tap, finally extinguishing the flames.

Both were gasping for breath.

They looked at each other.

They then started laughing, “Oh god, we are terrible cooks.”

“Absolute worst, haha!”

Calming down, they looked at the now ruined food and pan.

“Subaru,” the boy turned his head as Anastasia kept staring ahead, she spoke softly, “I’m not ever going to leave you.”

“…”

She continued despite his silence, “Even if you go back to Emilia. Even if you end up choosing them. Or even if anything gets in our way. I won’t give up on you.”

“…Thank you.”

He wanted to ask a billion questions. All of them some variation of ‘why?’

But he didn’t know how to say any of them.

So he just decided to express his gratitude.

“…I hope Beako is having a better time than us.”

 

 

A wolfman, a small drill-haired child, and a beautiful albino woman stared at the restaurant that they were supposed to be eating at.

Which was on fire.

“…Betty blames you both for this, in fact.”

“That’s fair.” “Not my fault.”

 

 

Day 7

Subaru woke up groggily.

Today’s plan was to go relax in the hot springs nearby and have a nice relaxing day while getting massages.

It paired well with the fact that the previous day’s date was a hike. Subaru was worried that Anastasia would not be able to handle it but she somehow managed to pull through. She did almost pass out a couple times, however.

They both slept like a log once they got home, Anastasia was especially tired, most likely due to her lackluster physical condition.

He sat up in bed and looked at his girlfriend, moving some hair from her face.

He smiled. He always did this but still couldn’t help but stare. It was like looking at fine art, you just can’t help but gawk.

For the first time in a while, it seems he woke up before her, she seemed to be completely clocked out.

Which made sense given how strenuous yesterday’s date was.

This week…has been very enjoyable for our brightest black star.

Despite Subaru’s troubled mind, every day had a unique and fun date planned for him. It was a nice change of pace given that usually he was the one planning the outings with Emilia. Anastasia made sure each date was impactful and did her best to make him happy as can be.

He got up and went to the bathroom to freshen up. While brushing his teeth, he looked into the mirror and saw his hair. The white was almost gone, only a few bits here and there. It felt like his body was finally recovering from his time in prison.

The boy checked his body. Despite some lingering scars, he looked vaguely similar to how he was half a year ago. Though he still needed some more fat and muscle here or there, his body quite thin in spite of all the improvements.

He took off his shirt and looked at his chest.

It was dark and black, radiating from the center but getting lighter as it edged out. The dragon’s blood had moved during the torture. He didn’t quite understand it, but it was most likely due to the amount of bodily harm centered near his torso. Perhaps it moved to where Subaru was hurt the most. Or something. He didn’t know and didn’t really care to know.

At the very least, it prevented Anastasia from questioning him about his weird discoloration.

He made sure to keep this a secret from her.

He didn’t want to explain this. It would only worry her.

He felt lucky that his hand and foot no longer looked rancid, though there were some lingering effects: dark veins still barely noticeable beneath the skin. He only hoped that the cursed blood remained near his chest but did worry if it was currently at his heart.

It did help him during the bandit fight, regenerating and keeping his body alive just enough for him to switch injuries before death.

Subaru paused.

 

He clutched at his chest.

He felt a sudden feeling.

 

It was.

 

BURP!

“Ugh, gross…” he muttered to himself. Hopefully he didn’t have indigestion or something. They were supposed to have a nice meal for lunch, and he’d rather not have Anastasia eat everything alone.

Speaking of the girl, has she not woken up yet?

 

He cocked his head out the bathroom and looked at the bed.

Still asleep.

An idea popped in his head and he smirked.

 

He tiptoed to the edge before jumping right on top of it, landing right next to the little lady, making her body slightly bounce in the air, “Rise and shine Ana-pop! It’s time for radio calisthenics!”

He chuckled as he expected her to angrily wake up and smack him.

Which didn’t happen.

Huh, the hike must have really wiped her out.

He then checked to see-

 

 

 

She was not breathing.

 

Subaru stared.

 

He quickly put his fingers on her vein and on her chest where her heart was.

There was no heartbeat.

 

His mind froze. Everything froze. Whatever thoughts he had. Whatever emotions he felt. Whatever feelings were felt.

 

It did not matter.

 

All he knew.

Was that his guiding star, the light of his life, was gone.

 

Anastasia Hoshin was dead.

Chapter 20: Hell

Summary:

No matter what... he won't give up.

Notes:

Enjoy~!

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

He didn’t hesitate for even a second.

 

Loop: 2

“ARGH!”

“Subaru?! Are you alright?” Anastasia got to her lover as quickly as possible. One moment he was explaining to her his name, the next he was violently grabbing at his neck, panting in pain.

He was gasping, his eyes frantically darting everywhere, his mind on fire.

What happened?! She was okay. I checked. She was breathing when we went to bed? Did she get poisoned? Or maybe a curse? But how? I’ve been checking everything! And Beatrice, Eridna, Hal, Tia: they were with us the entire week. No one should have snuck in. Unless… no. They wouldn’t. It wouldn’t make sense. But maybe? NO! Stop. I need to. I need to check.

 

Ana. Ana!

Subaru stopped panicking and quickly calmed down, his eyes locked onto the only thing that mattered at the moment, the woman who was visibly concerned and freaked out about his behavior.

He nearly tackled her off her feet, hugging her.

She was breathing. Her heart was beating. She was okay.

I returned. I came back. She’s alive. She’s here. She’s not…she’s okay. She’s going to be okay.

“Subaru?”

“…”

“…”

“…Are you feeling, okay?” he asked.

Visibly perturbed, “I should be asking you that! What happened? What made you act like that out of nowhere? Was it…was your ‘sense’ activated?”

Subaru’s body tensed, “…Yeah. It was. We need to leave. Now.”

He took her hand, dragging her out of the café, “Is someone following? Are we about to be attacked?”

“I’ll explain later, we need to get home first.”

 

 

“Check again.”

“Subaru, there’s nothing there.”

“Check. Again.”

“Su- “

“Check again!” Subaru yelled in rage.

Beatrice got startled and backed away in fear, “B-betty is sorry-“

He immediately realized his mistake, his eyes widened. He didn’t mean to do that. He felt immense guilt.

He was about to apologize when Anastasia grabbed his hand, “Subaru, calm down. It’s not her fault.”

His eyes softened, “…I’m sorry Beako. I got overwhelmed and took it out on you.”

Beatrice’s eyes were slightly moist but she shook her head, “Betty is okay. Betty will check again, just in case.”

He watched as the little spirit held her hands to Anastasia’s bare skin, trying to find any hint of a curse.

Her face frowned as she worked until finally, “Betty is sorry. There is nothing there out of place, in fact. Her Od is weak but that’s expected, I suppose.”

Subaru’s mind raced, “…And any signs of poison?”

Halibel chimed in from the side, where he was sitting in contemplation, “No. Ana-bo’s body doesn’t look to be affected by any poison. I can get a healer here to check more thoroughly, but my instincts say no. She looks the same as always to me. I’ve also been eyein’ your guys’ food all the time, and one of my subordinates has tracked ya whenever I can’t, no one would have slipped anythin’ past me.”

Tia’s eyes narrowed, her face in a constant frown, “Nothing. I got nothing. The wind doesn’t tell me shit. She’s got a normal complexion.”

Subaru tapped his chin, constantly going through every scenario, “…Change of plans Ana. We need to stay inside this whole week.”

Anastasia got worried, “It was that bad?!”

“I-what?” Subaru was now confused.

“The future you saw.”

Subaru’s alarm bells started going off, his lover was getting dangerously close to the truth.

Before he could say anything, Anastasia cut him off, “You don’t have to say anything. I’ve had my suspicions before. It doesn’t make sense for you to be this rattled by a danger sense and checked all of these things out of nowhere. You saw something. Something that is about to happen. And you can’t confirm or deny anything, because it’s part of your ability. It’s the cost.”

The others were eyeing Anastasia with curiosity, disbelief, and intrigue. All of them darting eyes from her to Subaru and back to her.

Subaru’s heart was beating quickly. He wanted so dearly to tell her that she was right. That he could return by death and saw her dead boy, laying so cold within their bed.

He wanted to tell her so many things.

But he couldn’t.

He couldn’t risk it.

He didn’t want her to die again.

So, he just stood there in silence. But a part of him felt seen.

Perceived.

As if she was seeing everything about him, that no one had ever seen before.

 

And it frightened him. Just as much as it made him feel elated.

 

She took his silence as confirmation as she thought in her head quickly, breathing in deep before sighing, “Alright. We’ll follow your advice. We’ll lock ourselves down here. But we can’t do it for too long. We need to figure out what’s happening. We can’t just hide away from all of our problems.”

Subaru nodded, “I agree. Just gimme one week. We’ll wait here for one week, and then we’ll plan out something.”

“…Okay. That alright with everyone else?”

She looked around the room as each person nodded.

Halibel got up first, “I’ll reinforce our security, get more of my people to look out for anyone or anythin’. Hell, I’ll look over everyone for any spies or traitors.”

Tia also got up, “While Hal does that, I’ll keep watch over the whole area, the wind will tell me if anyone suspicious enters Banan.”

Beatrice walked over to Subaru, “…If you’ll let me, Betty will keep checking Ana for any curses every hour or minute or as much as possible, I suppose.”

Subaru smiled, his guilt permeated his body, he quickly knelt down and hugged his former spirit, “Thank you, Beako. I’m really sorry again.”

“…You didn’t do anything wrong to Betty,” Beatrice lied.

It was going to be okay.

They were ready.

Anastasia was not going to die.

She was never going to die.

Never again.

Under his watch.

 

Day 6: Night.

“Subaru. You need to sleep,” she tugged his sleeve as she was currently hugging her close, keeping his ear on her chest, hearing her heartbeat.

He’s been doing this every night. Making sure there was no sign of her imminent demise.

In addition, the sound was the only thing that could calm him down.

“…I will, Ana-pop. I promise.”

“You said that last night. And I woke up to you still awake.”

“I’m alright.”

“You are not. How can I sleep well, knowing you’re suffering.”

Because unlike me, you can die. Me suffering for a short period is worth it to keep you alive.

“…I’m not.”

“…You’re not a good liar.”

“…I know. I’m just… I don’t want you to die.”

She held him closer as he tightened his grasp, “Oh, Subaru…”

“I know everyone dies. I know that it happens. And I know I can’t stop the inevitable. But I don’t want it to happen now. Not when I can prevent it.”

“…Subaru. I-“

“…Ana?”

“…”

“Ana?!”

 

Her heart started quickening, he felt her breath get shallow, her eyes widening.

Subaru panicked, he yelled quickly, “HAL! TIA! BEAKO! GET IN HERE NOW!”

He quickly looked all over her, checking for any signs, he cursed mentally, “I’m sorry, you can yell at me later.”

He quickly took off her clothes, but there was no sign of any damage, no sign of her body darkening or doing anything. But she looked like she was dying. Was she going through cardiac arrest?!

He put his ear to her bare chest as the three burst into their room, each one with panic in their eyes.

Beatrice hopped onto the bed and started channeling water mana through her, while Tia used her wind magic to check her breathing. Halibel had no experience saving people from certain death, his killing curses and other techniques were useless here.

 

“It’s not working!” Tia cried.

“Betty is trying, Betty is trying!” Beatrice’s eyes filled with tears as she put all of her mana into Anastasia, but her body was going crazy.

“Sister, use me as well!” Eridna yelled as she possessed Beatrice.

Anastasia started screaming in pain.

Subaru’s ears were drumming. He couldn’t feel anything. Everything felt loud. He wanted the noise to stop. He wanted this all to stop. He wanted her screams to stop.

But it kept going.

Wait, maybe-

He concentrated, his eyes darkened the surrounding area as glowing white lights appeared: one on Halibel, one on Tia, one on Beatrice, one on Eridna, and a weak one on Anastasia.

The light was dim and shaking.

It was breaking.

Subaru couldn’t believe his eyes, it had cracks, small bits of light were bursting from the surface.

 

Subaru had a theory.

He channeled whatever feeling he had when he swapped injuries and begged it to switch with him. Take whatever burden she had and give it to him.

 

But it wouldn’t work. Nothing was working!

She was dying.

Dying, screaming.

 

 

It was her Od.

It was falling apart at the seams.

 

And then.

 

Pop.

 

He saw it flicker and disappear.

The screams stopped.

Her body no longer moved.

Everything stopped.

Nobody moved.

 

Subaru wanted the noise back. He wanted to hear it again. So that he could hear her. Anything. From her.

 

He didn’t hesitate.

“Ana…” Beatrice looked back, and her tearful eyes widened in sheer fear, “SUBARU NO!”

He was too quick. Too ready. Too used to this.

 

Loop 3:

“Urgk!” Subaru stifled his reaction, though he still reeled in agony. The pain of cutting into his carotid artery was difficult but quick. They wouldn’t be able to save him if he stabbed deep enough.

“Subaru! Are you alright?!” Anastasia once again quickly ran over to him.

Subaru’s mind raced again.

We were inside the entire time. All of the food was checked. No one in or out of the place besides us. That leaves the others as possible suspects. But everyone was scared. Everyone. They looked surprised. None of them expected this and it all looked genuine. Which means if it wasn’t from this week…what if it was from before?

“Ana? Where did you go last week?”

 

6 hours later.

“I’m sorry. P-please. Don’t kill me,” the Miko begged for her life as she groveled at the feet of two figures emanating bloodlust everywhere.

One was a black- and white-haired man, wearing a black haori and glaring intensely while the other was a Shinigami staring with pure malice, her finger crooked and ready to rip apart anything close to her.

The wind raged violently around them.

SLAM!

“Subaru! What the hell is wrong with you?!”

His pale star and Halibel kicked the door open, the latter expressionless.

Subaru didn’t answer, his eyes still trained on the Miko in front of him.

“Subaru?” Anastasia was worried, she’d never seen him like this before.

“…Tell her what you told me,” the fox demi-human flinched at his words.

She spoked and sputtered, “I-it was me. I-I cursed you.”

“…What?” Anastasia walked up next to Subaru, her voice cold.

“I’m sorry! I had no choice! They would have… I’m so sorry. I didn’t want to. I-I didn’t mean…”

“Cursed? But I-“

“No. You can’t find it. It’s not normal. It works instantly. I apply it when you come and it goes away right after,” the Miko’s voice shook as she laid, prostrated on the ground, “H-he said that it wasn’t supposed to hurt anyone. It only took a little mana from you each time. It should only make you a bit drowsy. He said it shouldn’t kill you! I promise!”

“…”

Anastasia felt the dots connect in her head.

Subaru’s eyes, those omens, were still locked onto the scared woman, “Ana’s gate is defective. She can’t replace her mana.”

The woman stopped shaking, “T-then that means,” her head sprung straight up, her eyes gazed at Anastasia in horror.

“Oh my Od…” tears ran down her face, “I didn’t know. I didn’t. Oh no. I’m so sorry.”

SLASH!

A blade of wind swept right next to the woman, tearing the room of the temple almost in two. The woman couldn’t flinch, she was almost blacked out in shock from the near death experience.

“Sorry?!” Tia snarled.

Subaru held out a hand, her eyes pleaded with him to kill her, but something in his eyes made her back down.

Anastasia walked up slowly and knelt down, her expression was unreadable, “Who was it? Who is in charge?”

The Miko was sobbing, her body shaking with fear, “I-I don’t know. Honest! I don’t know. He didn’t give me a name but he’s from the Fujogeki Company. They came here to negotiate with us but ended up forcing us to put small curse marks using these!” She rummaged through her pocket and spilled out small needles.

Halibel silently walked over and picked them up, examining them carefully, “These ain’t killin’ curses. They’re modified wolgarm curses…they don’t drain all of the mana but take bits at a time. Barely enough to be noticed by anyone not skilled enough to perceive. And it seems to be linked somewhere…the mana is gettin’ sent to one place, but I can’t tell where.”

“I’m sorry! I’m so, so sorry. I didn’t want to hurt anyone. I didn’t want to hurt you. But… but. They have my husband.”

Before Anastasia could ask a question, Beatrice entered the room, Eridna’s body blowing with the wind, as several scared Mikos, hands in the air, walked in behind her.

Beatrice’s fingertips were in a claw formation, the tips glowing with light, aimed at their necks. Her eyes darted towards Subaru, “Su. What shall I do with them?”

The little spirit’s eyes darted towards Ana, widening slightly, before refocusing on the man.

“…Eridna?” Anastasia couldn’t believe how much hatred the spirit was also conveying.

The possessed spirit didn’t speak a word, still eyeing Subaru.

His eyes were still on the Miko in front of him.

 

Anastasia also refocused on the scared woman, “…Do they have a hostage for everyone?”

She said nothing but whimpered, nodding fiercely.

“…Is that why you told me those words that day?”

The woman froze, her eyes were filled with immense shame and guilt, “I. I had a fight with him. It was about something stupid. He stormed out of the house. This always happened. He just needed a breather. Some space from me. And then he would return as soon as he could. But he didn’t this time. An hour passed. A day. A week. A month. And then,” her voice choked.

“I got a letter in the mail with his fingers. Every one of us got the same thing. It came with the needles and instructions. And every month, we are told they are fine.”

“…”

“…I’m sorry. If you want to kill me, I won’t blame you. But please. Please! Save my husband. He’s…he’s everything to me. He’s my light. My other half. I don’t want to live in a world where he doesn’t exist. So please… save him. He didn’t do any of this. These sins are mine!”

“You-“ Tia tried to raise her hand but stopped as Subaru stopped her a second time, “Su! She’s the reason Ana is dying!”

Subaru finally turned to his contracted spirit, his eyes had softened, “She’s just a victim. Just like us. She may have been the one who did it. But she wasn’t the one who pulled the trigger. It’s the bastards who forced her and took her husband that did.”

Subaru turned his head towards Eridna, nodding, she stopped channeling mana and brought her hand down.

Anastasia was despondent. She said nothing, until finally, “Thank you. Despite putting me in this situation…you were one of the reasons I decided to be happy. That I found my happiness,” she stood and felt her hand grasp Subaru’s.

She smiled but her eyes were serious, “…I don’t know if your husband will be alive. But we’ll try. And at the very least, we’ll kill the bastards who did this.”

The Miko stared.

She didn’t understand. Why they are letting her live.

But she knew what she had to do.

She slammed her head onto the ground, her body fully bowing towards the two stars, “Thank you…please. Avenge him.”

The other Mikos all bowed just as deeply as the first, murmurs of ‘thank you’s’ and sobs echoed throughout the destroyed temple.

 

Both stars turned away. Subaru grasped his chest.

That explains why I felt so weird.

We hiked near the temple, the small hills were the only ones that Ana could handle with her physique. We checked in on the Mikos and I must have gotten cursed.

But it seems the curse got nullified by the dragon’s blood and other wolgarm curses.

…Shit. I should have known. I should have been more perceptive. If only…no. It doesn’t matter we need to go find the bastard who’s been taking Ana’s mana. Maybe if we kill him, it will be returned to her. But it can’t be returned to her Od. She still only has seven days.

Or maybe he’ll know how to fix her Od.

“So, what now?” Tia asked as she walked out of the temple behind them, Halibel and Beatrice walked beside them.

“Now we- “

He was cut off as a knife got deflected by Halibel’s kunai.

“Sorry Su-san,” Halibel’s clones started surrounding and protecting the stars as he readied himself, the wind picking up everywhere, “Looks like they found us.”

 

 

3 days later.

 

In the ruins of several charred buildings, Subaru and Anastasia stood over the dying body of a man dressed in dark colors, he was grinning madly even as his blood poured out through the holes.

Beatrice stood nearby, her mana dissipating from her fingers, “Disgusting, I suppose.”

“I can’t believe it… even here they won’t leave us alone!” Subaru’s hand gripped itself.

It was the Witch Cult.

It was always the fucking Witch Cult!

They were occupying the area under Fujogeki Company.

These cult members were smarter though. Less fanatically stupid but still no less unhinged.

“Su-san, Ana-bo. I got bad news,” he dragged the corpse of a cultist behind him before throwing it over to the rest of the bodies, “Every single one I interrogated says that the one who makes the curses ain’t here. They keep sayin’ shit about someone named ‘Mother,’ though.”

Subaru’s eyes widened, “Capella…”

Anastasia recognized the name, “That crazy bitch?”

Subaru nodded, “Yeah…but why is she here? What purpose does she have to be here, trying to control spirits?”

Anastasia began to contemplate before her neurons fired rapidly, “She must be looking for a certain spirit. Remember: back in Priestella, the cult was looking for a book and a spirit. They must be looking for Eridna…”

Subaru’s memories spun, he remembered the conversation they had during the assault, “So she’s looking for us then?!”

“I don’t know. I never understood why she needed an artificial spirit like Eridna…”

Eridna spoke from Beatrice’s shoulder, “I’m sorry child-“

“Don’t say sorry.” “You don’t have to apologize,” both stars shut down any guilt from the white fox.

Subaru spoke once more, “This wasn’t your fault. It was those bastards who keep ruining our lives.”

Anastasia agreed, “Subaru is right. We need to focus on the enemy. Not throw or accept blame. We need to find out where the rest of the Cult is here, and find the guy cursed me.”

 

That was the plan.

 

But they couldn’t achieve it.

The shaman was not here. Capella was not here. Only Fujogeki Company.

And within a few days, Subaru once again had to choose.

And he didn’t hesitate, once again.

 

Loop 4:

“Urgh…”

“Subaru! Are you alright?”

 

He was quicker this time. He gathered his allies. But he had something he needed to check first.

 

“Beako,” Subaru took aside the little spirit after returning, briefly preparing the others to assault the Witch Cult beforehand, “I need you to tell me all you know about Authorities. Specifically, the one held by Lust.”

Beatrice didn’t understand, “Why? Are you afraid the Archbishop’s power, in fact?”

He shook his head, “No…I think I can take it for myself.”

Subaru wasn’t stupid. Over time, he realized where he got his ‘power’ from. It was from that ugly bastard who never shut up back in Priestella. He was right next to him when the guy drowned to death.

Subaru must have picked it up from him.

And if Subaru picked up his Authority, he could pick up others. Including a woman who could regenerate and transform others.

Beatrice quickly understood, “…You want to take her power to fix Ana’s Od?!”

“Shh! I know. It sounds insane but- “

“No,” Beatrice shook her head, “Betty thinks its brilliant. It might work. But the problem is two-fold. One is your compatibility, I suppose.”

Subaru stared at Beatrice as Beatrice stared back.

“…”

“…”

“…Yeah, I don’t think that’s going to be a problem.”

“Betty agrees.”

“So, what’s the second problem.”

The little girl grimaced, “Just because you absorb the Authority, doesn’t mean the power will be the same. You might get a completely different power than the one you want. However, each Authority follows a set of rules. And usually they must follow these rules, despite being so different from each other.”

Subaru didn’t know this, “And these rules are?”

“The one similar rule is that Authorities affect the Od, and by extension the world, on a grand scale. Otherwise, each one has a rule that must be consistent, no matter the user. For example, Sloth often must involve hands in some way.”

That explains Invisible Providence.

“…What about Greed and Lust?”

“Greed involves contracts, each one has to involve a contract in some capacity. Lust involves manipulation of the body through the Od. Perhaps you might still be able to mold Ana’s Od despite having a different power. However, whether it is difficult or costly, is impossible to tell, in fact.”

“…Thank you Beako.”

Beatrice had a suspicion that she needed an answer for, “Which Authority do you have currently?”

“…”

“The only way you would know how to handle one is if you had one already. This would explain why your miasma is so thick, I suppose.”

“…I have two. Greed and Sloth.”

Three actually. Greed, sloth, and maybe envy. He wasn’t quite sure what he had. But it came from Satella, so it must be some witch factor related to her.

Beatrice’s eyes widened and then became morose, “Ah. You really were there, I suppose. And that time as well. You defeated that annoying Archbishop and Guese…”

Subaru was about to comfort her when she suddenly gasped, “That’s what your weird power is! The one that allows you to switch injuries, in fact. It’s greed!”

She started pacing the floor, “But that doesn’t make sense. It’s supposed to be contract based…that’s how Mother’s worked. Even that annoying man enforced contracts on his wives…Unless, Subaru, how does it work exactly?”

Subaru started explaining what he knows, as much as he could.

Beatrice’s brain was on fire, “So, it allows you to see other people’s Ods. And depending on the color, they are an enemy, an ally, or neutral, in fact. And it allows you to switch injuries if they are an enemy. But only when you fight them directly. You can’t sneak attack. And sometimes, the injury doesn’t fully transfer. Is that correct, so far?”

Subaru nodded. He remembered during one loop, he couldn’t switch with Tia-Two until she noticed him. And it only worked once. Afterwards, no matter how much he tried, she somehow managed to avoid it. It just wouldn’t work.

“…”

“Betty understands now. It isn’t just a simple switching of injuries,” Beatrice started pacing faster, she was practically making a hole in the floor, “You are making contracts, in fact.”

“Wait, what? How?”

“Every time you get into a fight. You have to accept them as an enemy. And they too, must accept you as an enemy. Those are the ‘conditions’ where both parties sign the contract. That leads to you giving them your injuries. You both accept the contract to harm each other. Even if it was subconsciously. But let’s say one party isn’t an enemy? Or is unaware of you? They can’t accept the contract. And let’s say one party is aware you can switch injuries. A skilled enough combatant could theoretically reject the contract subconsciously, I suppose.”

It all made sense.

Despite how insane it was, Subaru was basically making mini-contracts with people, all this time.

No wonder he couldn’t fight Tia-Two on his own.

But wait.

“Does that mean I could potentially make contracts with allies?” Subaru felt his heart race there was a possibility there that he needed to be true.

Beatrice understood as well, “Theoretically, yes. And if that was true- “

“I could switch Od’s with Ana.”

Subaru felt his heart soar. Beatrice on the other hand, felt her heart drop.

A silent conversation began in her head.

“…Tsk. Betty knows, sister. The merchant will kill me for this, but what choice does Betty have, I suppose.”

“Huh?”

Beatrice waved her hands out, “Betty will be your test subject. Betty accepts all injuries, no matter what, from her Subaru.”

He reached out, “Betty- “

“Betty is willing to do whatever it takes. Betty also wishes to save Ana. Betty wants both of you happy, no matter what,” she braced herself, still holding her arms open, accepting anything and everything.

Subaru felt cold.

He didn’t want to hurt her.

He really didn’t want to give his little spirit injuries.

But under her resolute gaze, how could he refuse? Especially when he himself is trying so hard as well.

He brought out his knife and nicked his finger.

He then concentrated, a white light appeared within Beatrice. He began to channel his thoughts into passing on his injury to Beatrice, as much as possible.

Everything.

He needed it to work.

Seconds passed.

Minutes.

 

But nothing happened.

He stopped concentrating, gasping and tired, “I-it doesn’t work. I can’t.”

Beatrice drooped, “Betty doesn’t understand. Why only enemies and not your allies? What is preventing you from transferring it to us, in fact? Is it a mental block…?”

Her mind started to race again but Subaru was running out of time, “Beako, this was helpful but I can’t sit here and experiment all day. We need to go find Capella. That’s the only way we can get out of this. The only way to save Ana.”

Subaru knew that the shaman wasn’t the answer. It was just the catalyst. If they found him, they could probably find Capella. And Subaru won’t stop until they find her.

It was the only way.

 

Loop 8:

“…”

“…”

“…I’m sorry Subaru.”

“Please. Don’t apologize.”

Both of the stars were huddled together for warmth, they were currently sitting outside the destroyed base of the Witch Cult situated in Gusteko.

Snow was pouring down on top of them.

It took several loops. Several tries. Pushing Patrasche, Tia, and Beatrice to their limits. But they were able to bypass the border, causing several international crimes, and slaughtering countless cultists.

But they were finally able to find that blasted shaman.

 

And it wasn’t worth a damn thing.

The shaman’s plan was to simply gather enough mana from the populace of Banan, and use it for whatever scheme Capella concocted.

But Capella was nowhere to be found.

She left on a whim based on her Gospel. No one has seen her for weeks. She could be anywhere in Gusteko or in the other three countries.

It was the sixth day, almost night. They were out of time.

 

“Subaru…I love you.”

“…”

“I don’t regret a thing. Living with you, having fun with you, kissing you, going on dates with you. I haven’t had this much fun in my entire life.”

Please. Stop. Don’t.

“…”

“…Move on from me. I’m not that selfless though. Remember me. But I want you to move on. Go find someone else. Become happy some other way.”

No. No. NO!

“…”

“Even if it’s Emilia.”

No.

“Even if it’s Rem.”

NO.

“Or anyone. Be happy for me. Even without me.”

“…That’s not possible.”

“Promise me.”

“…”

“…Please. I don’t want you to die for me.”

 

On the sixth day, Subaru lied to Anastasia.

And on that same day, he didn’t hesitate to begin again.

 

Loop: 12

Capella was not in Gusteko.

 

He needed to check Lugunica.

But he also had a better idea.

And there was another reason.

But there was a problem.

“No.”

“Be reasonable.”

“You are not being reasonable,” Anastasia glared, pointing at Subaru fiercely, “You are not returning to that hellhole for me. I forbid it.”

“It won’t be for that long.”

“How do you know that?! How do you know that they won’t execute you immediately?! Or that fuckstick Felix won’t find a way to assassinate you to keep your mouth shut?! Do you really think your life is that disposable?!”

Yes. It was. Compared to her. Yes. Absolutely. He doesn’t care anymore. Anything. He’ll take anything. Even if it costs him his life. If he can prove Anastasia is a candidate. If he can prove she’s someone they need or want to reward. If they can give her the Dragon’s Blood, they have a chance! And it doesn’t matter if he dies, he’ll figure out a way until he doesn’t. He always finds a way. Always.

“Anastasia. Think rationally. This is the only way we can save you. And I always find a way. Trust me. Please.”

“…You asshole. You absolute…” her eyes were raging, whatever semblance of calm she had was thrown out the window, “Is that what you think that I care about? Living while you suffer?! Is that what this is?! Is this what love is to you?!!”

“Ana-“

She wasn’t listening, “I knew it! Those fuckers. Those bitches made your sense of value all fucked up! They took you for granted and made you think this was love! They made you into some slave for their own purposes!”

“Wait who- “

“Emilia, Rem, and all those assholes from your camp. They made you think that everything is okay if you’re the only one who suffers. That as long as you win. Everything is completely fine. That you suffering in silence is fine! That you going along with everyone’s dreams, fighting for their goals, is fine! Because you are in love! Because you are worthless!! Because you believe that is all you’ll ever be!!”

“Ana calm down- “
Anastasia was hyperventilating, “You think I haven’t noticed?! This isn’t something that comes out of nowhere. They cursed you. Made you think this was something you wanted. That your only value comes from winning. They didn’t notice how you suffered. How you gave up so much. How much effort you put in. They took it for granted and acted like this was expected of you. Like what, you’re some man of great timing?! What a fucking joke! They didn’t give two shits about you. And now that’s all you know. Suffer while the people you love, prosper. Fuck. That.”

“Ana. Please. I’m worried.”

Anastasia was gasping for air, her skin looked pale. Subaru concentrated the whole time, worried that her Od was about to collapse. It still looked stable. But it was vibrating earlier. He needed to-

“Subaru. If you ever even think of doing that again, if you ever even think of sacrificing yourself for me, I will kill myself.”

 

His blood ran cold. His heart started pounding.

“Ana no- “

“Oh, so I can’t do it, but you can?”

“No! Please. Don’t. I wasn’t trying to do that, “Subaru felt like a hypocrite.

Anastasia stared at Subaru, her eyes locking onto his, filled with intense determination and rage beyond anything he had ever seen before, “You were saying. That you wanted to surrender yourself to Lugunica. All so that I had the small chance of being gifted the Dragon’s blood. That is practically suicidal. Don’t fucking argue with me on that!”

“Okay, I won’t-“

“No. I’m going to get this through your thick skull. Because that’s the only way I can convince you. Because I can see it in your eyes, you’re going to find a way to circumvent me. Find a way to go yourself. Find a way to get around my wording. So, I’m going to be clear. If you step into Lugunica without me knowing, I’ll kill myself. If you surrender yourself for my sake, I’ll kill myself. If you even think of making yourself suffer for my sake, I’ll kill myself. And if you die or find some way to die unnaturally, I’ll be right behind you.”

Subaru was absolutely horrified, “…Ana- “

“Yes or no? Do you hear me Natsuki Subaru? I am not joking. I don’t have time to unwrap the bullshit they covered you in. But I’m going to make sure you never ever go through this shit alone. So, know this, I, Anastasia Hoshin, will follow you, even in death. So, stay alive.”

“…Yes.”

 

He had lied once again.

 

Loop: 13

He tried talking to Joshua, perhaps get in touch with Julius or Reinhard. They were too far away. Communication was too slow. They were too late.

He did not hesitate.

Loop: 14

He sent Halibel secretly. Perhaps find a way inside and steal it.

It did not work.

He did not hesitate.

Loop: 15

Tia, Halibel, and Beatrice.

They could not.

He did not hesitate.

Loop: 16

He tried to get Reinhards attention. Threaten the council.

Did not work.

He did not hesitate.

Loop: 17

He was desperate. Tried to send Roswaal letters. Get in contact with him. But the man wouldn’t answer.

He did not hesitate.

Loop: 18

If he tried. He could get to the border. Just barely to Priestella within four days. It required everyone’s effort. But he could arrive.

 

But he couldn’t. He can’t. He wanted to surrender himself. Give Anastasia a chance.

But her words echo in his mind.

He knew Anastasia would try to save him first.

That she wouldn’t end her own life on a whim.

That she valued herself.

 

But he couldn’t.

He was a coward.

The very idea. The very notion. The very possibility.

That she would die for him, made his body seize and his mind scramble.

The idea horrified him too much.

His body wouldn’t allow him to go through with it.

Loop 25:

…What if he slaughtered his way through Lugunica?

He had Tia, Halibel, and Beatrice. It would be easy.

Previously, they tried bargaining. Sending letters. Asking for help. No one would arrive in time. Nothing could be done. Roswaal was out of commission.

 

It would be so easy.

 

He can’t. He felt so disgusted with himself.

 

Loop 30:

Vollachia was impossible.

And there was no point either way, it would take too long.

 

Loop 33:

Getting Odglass’s help would take too long.

Entering the country made them international criminals. They can’t force her either. She won’t listen to them.

Loop 38:

Capella was nowhere to be found.

Wherever she was, she was impossible to find within seven days.

 

Loop 44:

Anastasia stopped him. She won’t let him kill for her.

 

She gave him a similar speech as before.

 

He was such a coward.

 

Loop 55:

It didn’t work.

Loop 72:

He failed. He failed her. Again.

Loop 83:

Why? WHY? WHY?! WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY WHY?!

Why can’t he switch their Ods?! No matter how much he tried. It doesn’t work. He can’t give her his Od…

Loop 131:

Nothing was working. He can’t give up. He needed to find away. He can’t give up. Anastasia is worried. She shouldn’t be worried. She shouldn’t suffer for him. She was mad. She noticed.

No.

Loop 142:

What was the point of this?! Why? WHY?! Only seven days? There was no time to save her. There was no time to even make a plan or try anything. They were stuck in Kararagi. They could barely get into the other countries with Tia’s wind or Beatrice’s Door Crossing. Even then, they were both too limited in range…

 

What was the point in giving him this checkpoint?

Why not earlier?

Make him reset way earlier. It doesn’t matter. It doesn’t matter if Anastasia doesn’t love him. Doesn’t like him. Doesn’t remember him.

Subaru doesn’t care!

 

He just wants her to be alive.

Please.

 

 

 

 

 

Loop: 143

Ah. I get it now.

 

I understand. Satella.

You gave me this checkpoint.

 

So that I could say goodbye.

That’s what this is, isn’t it?

I can’t save her.

She’ll die.

No matter what I do.

She’ll die on the seventh day.

 

Ha. Ha. HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA.

Ha…Fuck you.

 

Even if it takes me forever. Even if I have to loop eternally. I’ll find a way…

 

 

 

 

Or.

 

I’ll make sure Anastasia has the happiest seven days of her life.

 

 

 

 

 

 

Loop: ???

 

The boy blinked.

Still hurts.

And blinked.

And blinked.

His mouth was open

Anastasia’s eyes widened in worry, she softly reached for his hand, “Subaru, are you okay?”

Subaru focused on the woman in front of him. His guiding star.

“…”

The boy blinked.

And blinked.

And blinked. Closing his mouth.

“…Yeah. I’m fine,” his mouth smiled but his eyes were dead.

Anastasia looked at him, her concern only growing, “Are you sure?”

“Yeah. Just excited to make this next week as fun as possible.”

 

It was time.

 

Time to say goodbye.

Notes:

EN1: Oh you guys are going to hate me for this one. I'm very excited.
EN2: The authority talk is based on my own interpretation of how they should work. Sloth was mentioned in canon to all involve hands in some way. So my assumption was that the others were similar. I compared Echidna and Regulus and Subaru, and found that there was a similar strand of something similar to 'contracts' being involved. So take that section with a grain of salt.

Chapter 21: Goodbye, to the Me That Loved You

Summary:

It's time.

Notes:

Thank you for everyone's wonderful responses to last chapter! Seriously, I had the largest smile reading everyone's comments. The way people were so invested in my story, in these two little goobers and their romance, it made me feel amazing... I'm very grateful to you all for this journey.

So now, please enjoy this chapter.

For it's time to say goodbye.

(See the end of the chapter for more notes.)

Chapter Text

“Don’t play it off like that. What’s wrong?”

Anastasia’s eyes gazed all over Subaru, trying to see what had caused the boy to suddenly stop talking.

The boy just smiled, his eyes still lacked life, he shook his head slow, “Worth a shot. I could never get anything past you.”

He then stood and grabbed her hand, leaving some money on the table, before leading her out.

Not resisting but still confused, the merchant looked back before refocusing forward, “Subaru. Where are we going?”

“Just somewhere nice.”

He said nothing more as the boy took his lover’s hand gently and guided her along the city streets.

Time passed as they slowly made it to a scenic hill overlooking the city. It was close to the Miko temple, which was located on top of a taller hill nearby.

The sun was still shining brightly overhead.

He stopped at the apex, and sat down, looking towards the city of wealth and mercantilism.

He patted the space right next to him and glanced at her, “Let’s rest here for a bit before moving on. That okay with you?”

His voice was gentle and sweet, but Anastasia’s instincts were blaring alarms, she didn’t like how it sounded, it made her heart ache, “…Subaru- “

“Please,” his voice cracked a bit, eyes wavering despite lacking their shine.

“…Okay.”

She sat down and massaged his back slowly.

 

Silence waved and flowed, as the wind blew around them.

It was a nice day.

Perfect for a date.

 

“…Let’s go wander the city later.”

She waited for him to respond, but he only stayed silent, “…”

“We can go back home to eat, make some food together. I need to talk with the others quick anyway.”

“…”

“Subaru. What’s wrong?”

She glanced over at him, Subaru just stared forward.

To her…he looked so somber.

So different from this morning.

Why?

“Subaru- “

“Ana,” guess today was ‘interrupt Ana day,’ “Do you think we could have gotten together under different circumstances?”

Her mouth closed shut.

Out of all things, she wasn’t expecting that kind of question today.

Her mind settled on the query as Subaru leaned back, waiting for her to respond.

“…I don’t think so.”

Subaru nodded along, silently telling her to say more.

And she obliged, “I had my company. Perhaps we could have been friends at most. But I wasn’t interested in love. Maybe after the selection. But that would have taken years.”

This time, the boy decided to add more, “And I had Emilia and Rem. We would have no reason to spend a lot of time with each other. Maybe if I started in your camp, but even then, what you said still applies. We wouldn’t have had the chance to do so.”

She chuckled, “You wouldn’t have fallen for me at first sight?”

He chuckled as well, “I probably would have. But I doubt you would have trusted me so fast.”

…I wouldn’t have. I would have thought he was some brown-noser or sycophant or some weirdo. Perhaps he could have grown on me. His ideas would interest me and make me keep him. But it would have taken a long time.

 

Maybe I would have taken advantage of him. Promising the chance at ‘wooing’ me in exchange for staying in my company.

…I would have been just like her.

Stringing him along, with the false hope of love.

 

“Yeah. I guess you’re right…Subaru. Why? Why ask me this?”

Her words held hidden implication, and the boy understood, “…I’ve had a lot of time to think.”

“…About us?”

“Heh. You, me, us, Hal, Tia, Beatrice, Eridna, my old camp, your camp. Everything really.”

He leaned his head over and put it on her shoulder, she took her hand and hugged him close, he continued to speak, “I realized. How rare it must be for us to be in this situation. You and I meeting. Surviving. You falling in love with me. All of it. The events that allowed this all to happen were one in a million…”

She rubbed his shoulder, hugging him more tightly, “Isn’t that wonderful then? Despite the odds, we ended up here. Together.”

She felt him rumble as he laughed softly, “Yeah. Despite the odds. We really did. Here. Alive.”
“…”

“…”

“…”

“…Ana?”

“Yeah?”

“I think…I’m afraid of letting you go. I’m afraid of you dying.”

He gulped, she felt him shake.

 

“I’m afraid…of saying goodbye.”

 

 

Time.

Subaru had nothing but time.

He stopped counting. But the loops continued.

Constantly. Trying. Failing. Dying.

Over time, questions that Subaru had began to be answered.

Some were existential: can a man stay the same when faced with infinity?

 

No. No he cannot.

 

Some were morbid: does the pain ever stop when you die constantly?

 

No. You can never get used to it. You can only control how you react. The pain never gets easier.

 

And some were hard to swallow: can love survive infinity?

 

…No.

It cannot.

 

Do you know how love dies?

Before. Subaru assumed it was because one of them was an asshole. Someone who cheated. Or decided to forget a date. Or even just an anniversary. Or perhaps as time when on, the love dissipated.

 

No.

It’s when you stop caring.

 

Loop: (???) – 1

It was the sixth day. Nightfall.

Everyone was asleep.

Well, everyone except Subaru.

Anastasia was sitting in a chair, in the living room, waiting for him to return.

He made the same mistake. Again.

She must have worried. He was gone too long this time. He’ll try being faster this time. To not worry her before the end.

Experiments are still going nowhere.

Yin or yang spells do not work. None of the magic areas do. Even water. Unfortunately.

Yin-Yang has potential. But needs more time.

He has time.

Beatrice can’t remember, he needs to explain faster.

Cursed arts show no progress. He’ll substitute resources to research Yin-Yang more.

 

Subaru walked over slowly, footsteps practiced and slow, and knelt down next to her.

It should be soon.

Her Od will die. She’s asleep so it should be peaceful. It’s better this way.

No waking her up.

She’ll suffer.

Not worth it.

He instead sat back down on the floor, on his knees, and brought out his knife. Quick. Otherwise, there was a risk of an updated checkpoint.

He waited.

And waited.

And waited.

Hearing her soft breathing.

 

 

 

It’s been a while since he last saw her like this. Sleeping peacefully. He was always too busy.  Cancelled their dates, promised to start next week. Gave excuses that he wanted to give her a surprise.

 

Ha.

 

A surprise that will never come. Until he finally wins. Finds a way for her to live.

 

He stared at her.

 

 

She looks so serene. So peaceful. Without him.

 

Within the silence. The dusk. He asked himself:

 

Why was he doing all of this?

 

Endlessly.

 

Just so he could fail. Again and again.

 

What was it all for?

 

If only…he could just throw away his morals.

Everything that made him. Him.

He could save her.

It could end. He could finally rest.

It would just be so simple-

 

“…baru…”

The boy froze, he lifted his head, and stared at the source.

Mumbling softly, loud within this silent abyss, Anastasia spoke within her dreams, “…Subaru…where…are you…”

 

Oh.

I almost forgot.

Her.

…’No matter what, I won’t give up’.

It wouldn’t matter if he threw himself away …

Because…she wouldn’t be happy if he was no longer him.

Him.

Natsuki Subaru.

But.

Who is Natsuki Subaru?

Who am I?

Self-proclaimed knight of the half-elf, Emilia? Hero of Lugunica, loved by the Oni, Rem?

 

Or.

He looked at the woman before him.

Truly looked at her.

It felt like it’s been years since he last looked at her, deeply.

Always pushing forward. Always running. Always trying to find solutions.

Never speaking more than needed. Never staying more than she wanted. Never stopping to see her.

 

…She’s so beautiful.

Within the moonlight, his eyes carefully traced her. Every feature, every small detail. Her adorable face. Soft, pink, a little too thin. He wanted to hold her cheeks within his hands.

Oh yeah. His eyes became misty.

Her eyes, if only they were awake, he would stare into them forever.

I almost forgot. He felt a droplet.

Her hair was glowing, ethereal, violet. He would run his hands through her soft locks for eons.

After all this time. One became two.

Her lips, her voice. How they felt, how they made his heart warm, and his mind spark fireworks.

This feeling. Two became many.

He almost dropped the knife as he slowly crumpled to the floor, tears spilling.

 

Sobbing. Silently. Still, gazing at her.

 

…How could I have forgotten?
